<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

/*
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| The forward-looking module (FLI module specification v1, 13 October 2026)
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| D-F2  fli_models and fli_model_versions: an approved fit is published as a
|       model version with an effective month; the route reads the version in
|       force at the reporting date, so a month-end applies the model and
|       does not have to re-fit it (D-F1).
| D-F3  ecl_scenario_results: the ECL of each loan under each scenario, so
|       the sensitivity, the impact screen and the booked allowance read the
|       same rows.
| D-F11 fli_run_snapshots: what one month-end ran under, in one row.
| D-F10 published_at on the macro and credit-loss observations: the date the
|       publisher released the figure, which the as-at reader honours.
| D-F9  risk_driver and double_count_review on the overlay register.
| The weighted forecast and the scenario profiles are tied to the governed
| scenario sets (governed_set_id, statistic_code, year_offset).
|
| The approved fits already in the database are published as model versions
| (one per period, effective from that period), so every month that ran
| before this migration keeps the model it ran under.
*/
return new class extends Migration
{
    public function up(): void
    {
        if (! Schema::hasTable('fli_models')) {
            Schema::create('fli_models', function (Blueprint $t) {
                $t->id();
                $t->string('code', 32)->unique();
                $t->string('name', 128);
                $t->string('target_metric', 8)->default('PD');
                $t->string('segment_basis', 32)->default('book');
                $t->string('description', 500)->nullable();
                $t->timestamps();
            });
        }
        if (! Schema::hasTable('fli_model_versions')) {
            Schema::create('fli_model_versions', function (Blueprint $t) {
                $t->id();
                $t->foreignId('model_id');
                $t->unsignedInteger('version');
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('fli_fit_id')->nullable();
                $t->string('statistic_code', 32);
                $t->string('proxy_code', 32);
                $t->integer('lag_months')->default(0);
                $t->decimal('slope', 20, 10);
                $t->decimal('intercept', 20, 10);
                $t->decimal('r_squared', 12, 8)->nullable();
                $t->decimal('p_value', 12, 8)->nullable();
                $t->unsignedInteger('n_obs')->nullable();
                $t->string('calibrated_period', 7)->comment('The month whose data the fit was estimated on');
                $t->string('effective_from', 7)->comment('The first month-end the version governs');
                $t->string('status', 12)->default('PUBLISHED')->comment('PUBLISHED, SUPERSEDED or RETIRED');
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('proposed_by')->nullable();
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('published_by')->nullable();
                $t->string('approver_label', 199)->nullable();
                $t->timestamp('published_at')->nullable();
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('retired_by')->nullable();
                $t->timestamp('retired_at')->nullable();
                $t->string('retired_reason', 500)->nullable();
                $t->string('note', 500)->nullable();
                $t->timestamps();
                $t->unique(['model_id', 'version']);
                $t->index(['status', 'effective_from']);
            });
        }
        if (! Schema::hasTable('fli_run_snapshots')) {
            Schema::create('fli_run_snapshots', function (Blueprint $t) {
                $t->id();
                $t->string('reporting_period', 7)->index();
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('model_version_id')->nullable();
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('fit_id')->nullable();
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('set_id')->nullable();
                $t->unsignedInteger('set_version')->nullable();
                $t->string('route', 64)->nullable();
                $t->string('method', 64)->nullable();
                $t->string('weighting', 64)->nullable();
                $t->text('overlay_ids')->nullable();
                $t->string('macro_vintage', 128)->nullable();
                $t->unsignedInteger('loans')->default(0);
                $t->decimal('pre_fli_ecl', 20, 2)->nullable();
                $t->decimal('model_effect', 20, 2)->nullable();
                $t->decimal('overlay_effect', 20, 2)->nullable();
                $t->decimal('booked_ecl', 20, 2)->nullable();
                $t->decimal('weighted_ecl', 20, 2)->nullable();
                $t->decimal('difference', 20, 2)->nullable();
                $t->boolean('reconciles')->default(false);
                $t->longText('per_scenario')->nullable();
                $t->longText('by_stage')->nullable();
                $t->longText('by_portfolio')->nullable();
                $t->longText('inputs')->nullable();
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('created_by')->nullable();
                $t->timestamps();
            });
        }
        if (! Schema::hasTable('ecl_scenario_results')) {
            Schema::create('ecl_scenario_results', function (Blueprint $t) {
                $t->id();
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('snapshot_id')->index();
                $t->string('reporting_period', 7);
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('loan_book_id');
                $t->string('contract_id', 199)->nullable();
                $t->unsignedBigInteger('loan_portfolio_id')->nullable();
                $t->string('stage', 4)->nullable();
                $t->string('scenario', 64);
                $t->decimal('weight', 7, 3);
                $t->decimal('pd12', 14, 10)->nullable();
                $t->decimal('stage_pd', 14, 10)->nullable();
                $t->decimal('ecl', 20, 2);
                $t->timestamps();
                $t->index(['reporting_period', 'scenario']);
            });
        }
        if (Schema::hasTable('loan_books') && ! Schema::hasColumn('loan_books', 'fli_model_version_id')) {
            Schema::table('loan_books', fn (Blueprint $t) => $t->unsignedBigInteger('fli_model_version_id')->nullable());
        }
        if (Schema::hasTable('macro_statistics_data') && ! Schema::hasColumn('macro_statistics_data', 'published_at')) {
            Schema::table('macro_statistics_data', fn (Blueprint $t) => $t->date('published_at')->nullable()->comment('The date the publisher released the figure (D-F10)'));
        }
        if (Schema::hasTable('macro_credit_loss_data')) {
            Schema::table('macro_credit_loss_data', function (Blueprint $t) {
                if (! Schema::hasColumn('macro_credit_loss_data', 'published_at')) {
                    $t->date('published_at')->nullable()->comment('The date the publisher released the figure');
                }
            });
        }
        if (Schema::hasTable('fli_overlays')) {
            Schema::table('fli_overlays', function (Blueprint $t) {
                if (! Schema::hasColumn('fli_overlays', 'risk_driver')) {
                    $t->string('risk_driver', 64)->nullable()->comment('The driver, sector or event the overlay covers (D-F9)');
                }
                if (! Schema::hasColumn('fli_overlays', 'double_count_review')) {
                    $t->text('double_count_review')->nullable()->comment('Why the model in force does not already carry this risk');
                }
            });
        }
        if (Schema::hasTable('macro_forecast_weighted')) {
            Schema::table('macro_forecast_weighted', function (Blueprint $t) {
                foreach (['governed_set_id' => 'unsignedBigInteger', 'year_offset' => 'integer'] as $c => $type) {
                    if (! Schema::hasColumn('macro_forecast_weighted', $c)) {
                        $t->{$type}($c)->nullable();
                    }
                }
                if (! Schema::hasColumn('macro_forecast_weighted', 'reporting_period')) {
                    $t->string('reporting_period', 7)->nullable();
                }
                if (! Schema::hasColumn('macro_forecast_weighted', 'statistic_code')) {
                    $t->string('statistic_code', 32)->nullable();
                }
                if (! Schema::hasColumn('macro_forecast_weighted', 'scenario_values')) {
                    $t->text('scenario_values')->nullable();
                }
            });
            if (DB::getDriverName() === 'mysql') {
                // the weighted forecast is now per governed set; the legacy keys may be empty
                DB::statement('ALTER TABLE macro_forecast_weighted MODIFY scenario_profile_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL, MODIFY macro_statistic_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL, MODIFY reporting_period_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL');
            }
        }
        if (Schema::hasTable('macro_credit_loss_data') && DB::getDriverName() === 'mysql') {
            // an external series (an industry NPL ratio) belongs to no MAIIC portfolio
            DB::statement('ALTER TABLE macro_credit_loss_data MODIFY portfolio_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL');
        }

        $this->publishApprovedFits();
    }

    /** Every approved fit becomes a published version effective from its own period. */
    private function publishApprovedFits(): void
    {
        if (! Schema::hasTable('fli_fits') || ! Schema::hasTable('fli_relationships')) {
            return;
        }
        $modelId = DB::table('fli_models')->where('code', 'PD-FLI-BOOK')->value('id') ?? DB::table('fli_models')->insertGetId([
            'code' => 'PD-FLI-BOOK', 'name' => 'Book-level PD forward-looking model', 'target_metric' => 'PD', 'segment_basis' => 'book',
            'description' => 'One driver against one credit-loss measure, fitted under the guardrail; its version in force moves every loan\'s PD under each scenario.',
            'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);
        $fits = DB::table('fli_fits as f')->join('fli_relationships as r', 'r.id', '=', 'f.fli_relationship_id')
            ->where('f.approval_status', 'APPROVED')->orderBy('f.reporting_period')
            ->get(['f.id', 'f.reporting_period', 'f.slope', 'f.intercept', 'f.r_squared', 'f.p_value', 'f.n_obs', 'f.proposed_by', 'f.approved_by', 'f.approver_label', 'f.approved_at', 'r.statistic_code', 'r.proxy_code', 'r.lag_months']);
        $version = (int) DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('model_id', $modelId)->max('version');
        foreach ($fits as $f) {
            if (DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('fli_fit_id', $f->id)->exists()) {
                continue;
            }
            $period = substr((string) $f->reporting_period, 0, 4) . '-' . substr((string) $f->reporting_period, 4, 2);
            DB::table('fli_model_versions')->insert([
                'model_id' => $modelId, 'version' => ++$version, 'fli_fit_id' => $f->id, 'statistic_code' => $f->statistic_code, 'proxy_code' => $f->proxy_code,
                'lag_months' => (int) $f->lag_months, 'slope' => $f->slope, 'intercept' => $f->intercept, 'r_squared' => $f->r_squared, 'p_value' => $f->p_value, 'n_obs' => $f->n_obs,
                'calibrated_period' => $period, 'effective_from' => $period, 'status' => 'PUBLISHED', 'proposed_by' => $f->proposed_by, 'published_by' => $f->approved_by,
                'approver_label' => $f->approver_label, 'published_at' => $f->approved_at ?? now(),
                'note' => 'Published from the fit approved for ' . $period . ' when the model registry was introduced (13 October 2026).',
                'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
        }
        // the version each loan ran under
        if (Schema::hasColumn('loan_books', 'fli_model_version_id')) {

--- content ---
<?php

namespace App\Services\Fli;

use App\Services\AuditLoggerService;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * The FLI model registry (FLI module specification v1, decisions D-F1 and
 * D-F2).
 *
 * The fits stay the calibration evidence. When a second person approves a
 * fit it is published here as a model version with an effective month; the
 * forward-looking route reads the version in force at the reporting date,
 * which is the latest published version whose effective month is on or
 * before it. A month-end therefore applies the approved model; it does not
 * have to re-fit it. The model is recalibrated once a year, or when an event
 * breaks the relationship, and the new version takes effect from its month
 * forward. Old versions are never edited: a version that a later one
 * replaces from the same month is marked SUPERSEDED, a version withdrawn is
 * RETIRED, and the months it governed keep pointing at it.
 */
class FliModelRegistry
{
    public const DEFAULT_MODEL = 'PD-FLI-BOOK';

    /** Publish an approved fit as a model version effective from $effectiveFrom (default: the fit's own month). */
    public function publishFromFit(int $fitId, ?int $publishedBy, ?string $label = null, ?string $effectiveFrom = null): int
    {
        $fit = DB::table('fli_fits as f')->join('fli_relationships as r', 'r.id', '=', 'f.fli_relationship_id')->where('f.id', $fitId)
            ->first(['f.id', 'f.reporting_period', 'f.slope', 'f.intercept', 'f.r_squared', 'f.p_value', 'f.n_obs', 'f.proposed_by', 'f.approval_status', 'r.statistic_code', 'r.proxy_code', 'r.lag_months'])
            ?? throw new RuntimeException("No fit {$fitId}.");
        if ($fit->approval_status !== 'APPROVED') {
            throw new RuntimeException("Fit {$fitId} is not approved; only an approved fit can be published as a model version.");
        }
        $calibrated = substr((string) $fit->reporting_period, 0, 4) . '-' . substr((string) $fit->reporting_period, 4, 2);
        $effective = $effectiveFrom ?: $calibrated;
        if (! preg_match('/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/', $effective)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('The effective month must be YYYY-MM.');
        }
        if ($effective < $calibrated) {
            throw new RuntimeException("A version calibrated on {$calibrated} data cannot govern {$effective}: it would use information that was not available then (IFRS 9 B5.5.49).");
        }
        $existing = DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('fli_fit_id', $fitId)->where('effective_from', $effective)->where('status', 'PUBLISHED')->value('id');
        if ($existing) {
            return (int) $existing;
        }
        $modelId = $this->modelId();

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($fit, $modelId, $calibrated, $effective, $publishedBy, $label) {
            // a version published earlier for the same month is replaced, not edited
            $replaced = DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('model_id', $modelId)->where('effective_from', $effective)->where('status', 'PUBLISHED')->pluck('id');
            DB::table('fli_model_versions')->whereIn('id', $replaced)->update(['status' => 'SUPERSEDED', 'updated_at' => now()]);
            $version = (int) DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('model_id', $modelId)->max('version') + 1;
            $id = (int) DB::table('fli_model_versions')->insertGetId([
                'model_id' => $modelId, 'version' => $version, 'fli_fit_id' => $fit->id, 'statistic_code' => $fit->statistic_code, 'proxy_code' => $fit->proxy_code,
                'lag_months' => (int) $fit->lag_months, 'slope' => $fit->slope, 'intercept' => $fit->intercept, 'r_squared' => $fit->r_squared, 'p_value' => $fit->p_value, 'n_obs' => $fit->n_obs,
                'calibrated_period' => $calibrated, 'effective_from' => $effective, 'status' => 'PUBLISHED', 'proposed_by' => $fit->proposed_by, 'published_by' => $publishedBy,
                'approver_label' => $label, 'published_at' => now(), 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
            AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Model Version Published', 'fli_model_versions', $id, ['reporting_period' => $effective,
                'new_values' => ['version' => $version, 'fit' => (int) $fit->id, 'relationship' => "{$fit->statistic_code} -> {$fit->proxy_code} (lag {$fit->lag_months})", 'effective_from' => $effective, 'replaced' => $replaced->all()],
                'meta' => ['user' => $publishedBy, 'label' => $label]]);

            return $id;
        });
    }

    /** The version in force for a month: the latest published one effective on or before it. */
    public function inForce(string $period): ?object
    {
        $period = $this->period($period);

        return DB::table('fli_model_versions as v')->join('fli_models as m', 'm.id', '=', 'v.model_id')
            ->where('m.code', self::DEFAULT_MODEL)->where('v.status', 'PUBLISHED')->where('v.effective_from', '<=', $period)
            ->orderByDesc('v.effective_from')->orderByDesc('v.version')
            ->first(['v.*', 'm.code as model_code', 'm.name as model_name']);
    }

    /** Withdraw a version; the months after it fall back to the version before it, or to none. */
    public function retire(int $versionId, ?int $userId, string $reason): void
    {
        $v = DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('id', $versionId)->first() ?? throw new RuntimeException("No model version {$versionId}.");
        if ($v->status !== 'PUBLISHED') {
            throw new RuntimeException("Version {$v->version} is {$v->status}; only a published version can be retired.");
        }
        if (trim($reason) === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Say why the version is retired.');
        }
        DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('id', $versionId)->update(['status' => 'RETIRED', 'retired_by' => $userId, 'retired_at' => now(), 'retired_reason' => $reason, 'updated_at' => now()]);
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Model Version Retired', 'fli_model_versions', $versionId, ['reporting_period' => $v->effective_from, 'new_values' => ['version' => (int) $v->version, 'reason' => $reason], 'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);
    }

    /** Every version, newest first, with who published it. */
    public function versions(): Collection
    {
        return DB::table('fli_model_versions as v')->join('fli_models as m', 'm.id', '=', 'v.model_id')
            ->leftJoin('users as p', 'p.id', '=', 'v.published_by')->leftJoin('users as r', 'r.id', '=', 'v.retired_by')->leftJoin('users as q', 'q.id', '=', 'v.proposed_by')
            ->orderByDesc('v.effective_from')->orderByDesc('v.version')
            ->get(['v.*', 'm.code as model_code', 'm.name as model_name', 'p.name as publisher', 'r.name as retirer', 'q.name as proposer']);
    }

    /** The months each version governed, from the loans that ran under it. */
    public function monthsGoverned(): array
    {
        if (! DB::getSchemaBuilder()->hasColumn('loan_books', 'fli_model_version_id')) {
            return [];
        }

        return DB::table('loan_books')->whereNotNull('fli_model_version_id')->selectRaw('fli_model_version_id v, reporting_period p')->distinct()->get()
            ->groupBy('v')->map(fn ($g) => $g->pluck('p')->sort()->values()->all())->all();
    }

    private function modelId(): int
    {
        return (int) (DB::table('fli_models')->where('code', self::DEFAULT_MODEL)->value('id') ?? DB::table('fli_models')->insertGetId([
            'code' => self::DEFAULT_MODEL, 'name' => 'Book-level PD forward-looking model', 'target_metric' => 'PD', 'segment_basis' => 'book',
            'description' => 'One driver against one credit-loss measure, fitted under the guardrail; its version in force moves every loan\'s PD under each scenario.',
            'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
        ]));
    }

    private function period(string $p): string
    {
        $p = str_replace('-', '', trim($p));

        return substr($p, 0, 4) . '-' . substr($p, 4, 2);
    }
}

    /** The approved fit for a period, with its relationship. */
    public function approvedFit(string $period): ?object
    {
        $ym = str_replace('-', '', $period);

        return DB::table('fli_fits as f')->join('fli_relationships as r', 'r.id', '=', 'f.fli_relationship_id')
            ->where('f.reporting_period', $ym)->where('f.approval_status', 'APPROVED')->orderByDesc('f.approved_at')
            ->first(['f.id', 'f.slope', 'f.intercept', 'f.correlation_r', 'f.r_squared', 'f.n_obs', 'r.statistic_code', 'r.proxy_code', 'r.lag_months']);
    }""", """        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Fit Approved', 'fli_fits', $fitId, ['meta' => ['approved_by' => $approverId, 'label' => $label]]);
        // the approved fit becomes the model version in force from its month (FLI module D-F2)
        $this->registry->publishFromFit($fitId, $approverId, $label);
    }

    /**
     * The model in force for a period (FLI module D-F1, D-F2): the latest
     * published model version effective on or before it, with the fit it was
     * published from. The coefficients are the version's own, which never
     * change after publication. A month with no version in force has no model.
     */
    public function approvedFit(string $period): ?object
    {
        $v = $this->registry->inForce($period);
        if ($v === null) {
            return null;
        }
        $r = $v->fli_fit_id === null ? null : DB::table('fli_fits')->where('id', $v->fli_fit_id)->value('correlation_r');

        return (object) ['id' => $v->fli_fit_id === null ? null : (int) $v->fli_fit_id, 'model_version_id' => (int) $v->id, 'version' => (int) $v->version,
            'effective_from' => $v->effective_from, 'calibrated_period' => $v->calibrated_period,
            'slope' => $v->slope, 'intercept' => $v->intercept, 'correlation_r' => $r, 'r_squared' => $v->r_squared, 'n_obs' => $v->n_obs,
            'statistic_code' => $v->statistic_code, 'proxy_code' => $v->proxy_code, 'lag_months' => (int) $v->lag_months];
    }

    /**
     * What the route would do for a period, without writing anything: the
     * inputs in force and the adjustment of each scenario. The Apply to Loan
     * Book screen shows it before anyone presses apply.
     *
     * @return array{route:string,method:string,weighting:string,fit:?object,set:?object,scenarios:array,base:?array,overlays:list<array>,problem:?string}
     */
    public function preview(string $period): array
    {
        $asOf = CarbonImmutable::parse($period . '-01')->endOfMonth();
        $route = $this->setting('fli_adjustment_route', 'Regression', $asOf);
        $weighting = $this->setting('scenario_weighting_method', 'Weight the ECL across scenarios', $asOf);
        $set = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereIn('status', ['APPROVED', 'LOCKED'])->orderByDesc('version')->first();
        $fit = str_starts_with($route, 'Regression') ? $this->approvedFit($period) : null;
        $scenarios = [];
        $base = null;
        $problem = null;
        if ($fit !== null && $set !== null) {
            try {
                [$base, $scenarios] = $this->regressionAdjustments($period, $fit, $this->sets->paths((int) $set->id));
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $problem = $e->getMessage();
            }
        }
        $overlays = str_contains($route, 'overlay') ? $this->overlays->inForce($period) : collect();

        return ['route' => $route, 'method' => $this->methods->inForce(), 'weighting' => $weighting, 'fit' => $fit, 'set' => $set, 'scenarios' => $scenarios, 'base' => $base,
            'overlays' => $overlays->map(fn ($o) => ['id' => (int) $o->id, 'scope' => $o->scope, 'scope_value' => $o->scope_value, 'adjustment' => (float) $o->adjustment])->values()->all(), 'problem' => $problem];
    }

    /**
     * The adjustment of each scenario in each forecast year (FLI module D-F4):
     * year y is the twelve months that end 12(y + 1) months after the period,
     * read under the model's lag exactly as the route reads year 0, so year 0
     * here is the adjustment the route books. Years beyond the scenario path
     * hold the path's last year; the caller reverts them to the long-run PD.
     *
     * @return array<string,list<array{year:int,driver:?float,driver_period:string,source:string,predicted_proxy:?float,adjustment:?float}>>
     */
    public function adjustmentsByYear(string $period, object $fit, array $paths, int $years): array
    {
        $p = AsAtSeries::ym($period);
        $code = (string) $fit->statistic_code;
        $lag = (int) $fit->lag_months;
        $actuals = AsAtSeries::macro(null, $p, ['actual'], [$code])[$code] ?? [];
        $basePeriod = SeriesAligner::shiftPeriod($p, $lag);
        if (! array_key_exists($basePeriod, $actuals)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("No {$code} actual for {$basePeriod} is known at the end of {$period}; the model in force cannot be projected.");
        }
        $predBase = (float) $fit->slope * (float) $actuals[$basePeriod] + (float) $fit->intercept;
        if (abs($predBase) <= 1e-12) {
            throw new RuntimeException("The model in force predicts a base of zero for {$period}; no ratio to the base exists.");
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($paths['scenarios'] as $name => $sc) {
            $keys = array_keys(array_filter($sc['path'][$code] ?? [], fn ($v) => $v !== null));
            $last = $keys === [] ? null : max($keys);
            for ($y = 0; $y < $years; $y++) {
                $window = SeriesAligner::shiftPeriod($p, $lag - 12 * ($y + 1));
                $ahead = AsAtSeries::monthsBetween($p, $window);
                if ($ahead <= 0) {
                    $driver = $actuals[$window] ?? null;
                    $source = "actual {$window}";
                } else {
                    $offset = intdiv($ahead - 1, 12);
                    $use = $last === null ? null : min($offset, $last);
                    $driver = $use === null ? null : ($sc['path'][$code][$use] ?? null);
                    $source = $last !== null && $offset > $last ? "scenario path, year {$last} held" : "scenario path, forecast year {$offset}";
                }
                $pred = $driver === null ? null : (float) $fit->slope * (float) $driver + (float) $fit->intercept;
                $out[$name][] = ['year' => $y, 'driver' => $driver === null ? null : round((float) $driver, 6), 'driver_period' => $window, 'source' => $source,
                    'predicted_proxy' => $pred === null ? null : round($pred, 6), 'adjustment' => $pred === null ? null : round($pred / $predBase - 1, 6)];
            }
        }

        return $out;
    }""")

<?php

namespace App\Services\Fli;

use App\Services\AuditLoggerService;
use App\Services\Eir\GovernanceService;
use App\Services\Reports\EclBuildUpService;
use App\Services\Scenario\ScenarioSetService;
use App\Support\Fli\AsAtSeries;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Closing the forward-looking month (FLI module specification v1, decisions
 * D-F3 and D-F11, section 7).
 *
 * record() measures the ECL of every loan under every scenario of the set the
 * route applied, weights it, and checks that the weighted figure equals the
 * allowance booked on the post-FLI PD. Each scenario's ECL is the loan's
 * booked ECL re-based from the booked stage PD to the scenario's stage PD
 * (lifetime for Stage 2, 1 for Stage 3), which is the ECL engine's own
 * measure (EAD x LGD x stage PD) at the scenario's PD. The loan-level rows go
 * to ecl_scenario_results; the totals, the inputs in force and the movement
 * against the previous month-end go to one fli_run_snapshots row.
 *
 * signOff() is the second person's approval of that record. A record whose
 * weighted ECL does not reconcile cannot be signed off, and a movement above
 * the governed tolerance needs a commentary first.
 *
 * Nothing here changes a loan, a PD or an ECL.
 */
class FliCloseService
{
    public function __construct(private EclBuildUpService $buildUp, private FliModelRegistry $registry, private GovernanceService $governance)
    {
    }

    /** @return array<string,mixed> the snapshot row, decoded */
    public function record(string $period, ?int $userId = null): array
    {
        $loans = $this->buildUp->loans($period);
        if ($loans->isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("No loan book is held for {$period}.");
        }
        $up = $this->buildUp->buildUp($loans, $period);
        if (! $up['available'] || $up['basis'] !== 'post_fli') {
            throw new RuntimeException("The ECL of {$period} is not on the PD after FLI, so the month cannot be closed: " . ($up['reason'] ?? 'calculate the ECL on the post-FLI PD first.'));
        }
        $applied = DB::table('audit_logs')->where('action', 'FLI Route Applied')->where('reporting_period', $period)->max('created_at');
        $calculated = DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->max('ecl_calculated_at');
        if ($applied !== null && $calculated !== null && CarbonImmutable::parse($calculated)->lt(CarbonImmutable::parse($applied))) {
            throw new RuntimeException("The ECL of {$period} was calculated at {$calculated}, before the forward-looking route last ran at {$applied}. Calculate the ECL again, then close the month.");
        }
        $setIds = $loans->pluck('fli_set_id')->filter()->unique()->values();
        if ($setIds->count() > 1) {
            throw new RuntimeException("The loans of {$period} ran under more than one scenario set (" . $setIds->implode(', ') . '). Apply the route again so that every loan runs under the set in force.');
        }
        $set = $setIds->isEmpty() ? null : DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('id', $setIds->first())->first();
        $scenarios = $set ? DB::table('governed_scenarios')->where('set_id', $set->id)->orderBy('order_position')->get(['name', 'weight', 'is_base']) : collect();
        if ($scenarios->isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("No scenario set was applied to the loans of {$period}; apply the forward-looking route first.");
        }
        $weights = $scenarios->mapWithKeys(fn ($s) => [$s->name => (float) $s->weight])->all();
        $byScenarioRaw = DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->pluck('fli_by_scenario', 'id');
        $versionIds = DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereNotNull('fli_model_version_id')->distinct()->pluck('fli_model_version_id');
        $version = $versionIds->count() === 1 ? DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('id', $versionIds->first())->first() : null;

        $rows = [];
        $per = array_fill_keys(array_keys($weights), 0.0);
        $byStage = [];
        $byPortfolio = [];
        $booked = 0.0;
        $weighted = 0.0;
        $counted = 0;
        foreach ($loans as $l) {
            $x = EclBuildUpService::lineage($l);
            if ($x['ecl'] === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $counted++;
            $shape = (object) ['stage' => (string) ($x['stage'] ?? ''), 'remaining_tenor' => $l->remaining_tenor];
            $hPost = $x['horizon_pd_post'];
            $by = json_decode((string) ($byScenarioRaw[$l->id] ?? ''), true) ?: [];
            $loanWeighted = 0.0;
            $stage = $x['stage'] === null ? '-' : (string) $x['stage'];
            $portfolio = (int) ($l->loan_portfolio_id ?? 0);
            foreach ($weights as $name => $w) {
                $pd = isset($by[$name]['pd']) ? (float) $by[$name]['pd'] : null;
                if ($stage === '3' || $pd === null || $hPost <= 0) {
                    // Stage 3 is measured on the default that has happened: no scenario moves it
                    $ecl = (float) $x['ecl'];
                    $stagePd = $stage === '3' ? 1.0 : $hPost;
                } else {
                    $stagePd = ScenarioSetService::stagePd($shape, $pd);
                    $ecl = (float) $x['ecl'] * $stagePd / $hPost;
                }
                $per[$name] += $ecl;
                $loanWeighted += $ecl * $w / 100;
                $byStage[$stage][$name] = ($byStage[$stage][$name] ?? 0.0) + $ecl;
                $byPortfolio[$portfolio][$name] = ($byPortfolio[$portfolio][$name] ?? 0.0) + $ecl;
                $rows[] = ['reporting_period' => $period, 'loan_book_id' => $l->id, 'contract_id' => $l->contract_id, 'loan_portfolio_id' => $l->loan_portfolio_id, 'stage' => $stage,
                    'scenario' => mb_substr($name, 0, 64), 'weight' => $w, 'pd12' => $pd, 'stage_pd' => round($stagePd, 10), 'ecl' => round($ecl, 2)];
            }
            $booked += (float) $x['ecl'];
            $weighted += $loanWeighted;
            $byStage[$stage]['_booked'] = ($byStage[$stage]['_booked'] ?? 0.0) + (float) $x['ecl'];
            $byPortfolio[$portfolio]['_booked'] = ($byPortfolio[$portfolio]['_booked'] ?? 0.0) + (float) $x['ecl'];
        }
        $difference = round($weighted - $booked, 2);
        // the post-FLI PD is stored to eight decimals, so the weighted figure ties to the booked one to that rounding
        $reconciles = abs($difference) <= max(1.0, 1e-6 * abs($booked));

        $prior = DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->where('reporting_period', '<', $period)->whereIn('status', ['RECORDED', 'SIGNED_OFF'])->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->orderByDesc('id')->first();
        $priorBooked = $prior ? (float) $prior->booked_ecl : null;
        $movement = $priorBooked && $priorBooked != 0.0 ? ($booked - $priorBooked) / $priorBooked : null;
        $tolerance = $this->tolerance($period);
        $needsCommentary = $movement !== null && $tolerance !== null && abs($movement) > $tolerance;

        $names = DB::table('loan_portfolios')->pluck('name', 'id')->all();
        $round = fn (array $a) => array_map(fn ($v) => round($v, 2), $a);
        $perScenario = [];
        foreach ($weights as $name => $w) {
            $perScenario[] = ['scenario' => $name, 'weight' => $w, 'is_base' => (bool) ($scenarios->firstWhere('name', $name)->is_base ?? false), 'ecl' => round($per[$name], 2), 'contribution' => round($per[$name] * $w / 100, 2)];
        }
        ksort($byStage);
        $inputs = [
            'model_version' => $version ? ['id' => (int) $version->id, 'version' => (int) $version->version, 'relationship' => "{$version->statistic_code} -> {$version->proxy_code} (lag {$version->lag_months})", 'effective_from' => $version->effective_from, 'calibrated_period' => $version->calibrated_period, 'r_squared' => (float) $version->r_squared] : null,
            'scenario_set' => $set ? ['id' => (int) $set->id, 'name' => $set->name, 'version' => (int) $set->version, 'status' => $set->status, 'weights' => $weights] : null,
            'overlays' => $up['overlay_lines'],
            'pd_segment_runs' => DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereNotNull('pd_segment_run_id')->distinct()->pluck('pd_segment_run_id')->all(),
            'ecl_runs' => DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereNotNull('ecl_calculation_run_id')->distinct()->pluck('ecl_calculation_run_id')->all(),
            'loan_book_loads' => DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereNotNull('build_load_id')->distinct()->pluck('build_load_id')->all(),
            'ecl_calculated_at' => $calculated, 'fli_applied_at' => $applied,
            'macro' => $this->vintage($period, $version?->statistic_code),
        ];

        $snapshot = DB::transaction(function () use ($period, $version, $set, $loans, $up, $booked, $weighted, $difference, $reconciles, $perScenario, $byStage, $byPortfolio, $names, $round, $inputs, $priorBooked, $movement, $needsCommentary, $userId, $rows, $counted) {
            // an earlier record of the same month is replaced by this one, and its loan rows with it
            $old = DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereIn('status', ['RECORDED', 'SIGNED_OFF'])->pluck('id');
            DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->whereIn('id', $old)->update(['status' => 'SUPERSEDED', 'updated_at' => now()]);
            DB::table('ecl_scenario_results')->whereIn('snapshot_id', $old)->delete();
            $id = (int) DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->insertGetId([
                'reporting_period' => $period, 'model_version_id' => $version?->id, 'fit_id' => $version?->fli_fit_id, 'set_id' => $set?->id, 'set_version' => $set?->version,
                'route' => $loans->pluck('fli_route')->filter()->unique()->implode(', ') ?: null, 'method' => $loans->pluck('fli_method')->filter()->unique()->implode(', ') ?: null,
                'weighting' => $this->setting('scenario_weighting_method', $period), 'overlay_ids' => json_encode(array_column($up['overlay_lines'], 'overlay_id')),
                'macro_vintage' => mb_substr((string) ($inputs['macro']['label'] ?? ''), 0, 128) ?: null, 'loans' => $counted,
                'pre_fli_ecl' => $up['pre_fli'], 'model_effect' => $up['fli_model'], 'overlay_effect' => $up['overlays'], 'booked_ecl' => round($booked, 2), 'weighted_ecl' => round($weighted, 2),
                'difference' => $difference, 'reconciles' => $reconciles, 'per_scenario' => json_encode($perScenario),
                'by_stage' => json_encode(array_map($round, $byStage)),
                'by_portfolio' => json_encode(collect($byPortfolio)->map(fn ($v, $k) => ['portfolio_id' => (int) $k, 'portfolio' => $names[$k] ?? ($k ? "Portfolio {$k}" : 'No portfolio'), 'values' => $round($v)])->values()->all()),
                'inputs' => json_encode($inputs), 'prior_booked_ecl' => $priorBooked, 'movement_pct' => $movement === null ? null : round($movement, 6), 'needs_commentary' => $needsCommentary,
                'status' => 'RECORDED', 'created_by' => $userId, 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
            foreach (array_chunk($rows, 500) as $chunk) {
                DB::table('ecl_scenario_results')->insert(array_map(fn ($r) => $r + ['snapshot_id' => $id, 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()], $chunk));
            }

            return $id;
        });
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Month Recorded', 'fli_run_snapshots', $snapshot, ['reporting_period' => $period, 'rows_affected' => count($rows),
            'new_values' => ['booked' => round($booked, 2), 'weighted' => round($weighted, 2), 'difference' => $difference, 'reconciles' => $reconciles, 'model_version' => $version?->version, 'set' => $set?->id, 'needs_commentary' => $needsCommentary],
            'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);

        return $this->find($snapshot);
    }

    /** The second person signs the record off; a commentary is needed when the month moved beyond the tolerance. */
    public function signOff(int $snapshotId, ?int $userId, ?string $commentary = null, ?string $label = null): void
    {
        $s = DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->where('id', $snapshotId)->first() ?? throw new RuntimeException("No record {$snapshotId}.");
        if ($s->status !== 'RECORDED') {
            throw new RuntimeException("The record of {$s->reporting_period} is {$s->status}; only a recorded month can be signed off.");
        }
        if (! $s->reconciles) {
            throw new RuntimeException("The weighted ECL of {$s->reporting_period} differs from the booked ECL by {$s->difference}; record the month again after the ECL run before signing it off.");
        }
        $commentary = trim((string) ($commentary ?? $s->commentary ?? ''));
        if ($s->needs_commentary && $commentary === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('The ECL moved by ' . round((float) $s->movement_pct * 100, 1) . ' percent against the previous month-end, more than the governed tolerance: say why before signing off.');
        }
        if ($label === null && $userId !== null && (int) $s->created_by === $userId) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Maker-checker: the person who recorded the month cannot sign it off.');
        }
        DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->where('id', $snapshotId)->update(['status' => 'SIGNED_OFF', 'commentary' => $commentary === '' ? null : $commentary, 'signed_off_by' => $userId, 'approver_label' => $label, 'signed_off_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Month Signed Off', 'fli_run_snapshots', $snapshotId, ['reporting_period' => $s->reporting_period, 'new_values' => ['commentary' => $commentary, 'label' => $label], 'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);
    }

    /** Save the commentary without signing off (the reviewer explains the movement first). */
    public function comment(int $snapshotId, ?int $userId, string $commentary): void
    {
        DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->where('id', $snapshotId)->where('status', 'RECORDED')->update(['commentary' => trim($commentary), 'updated_at' => now()]);
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Month Commentary', 'fli_run_snapshots', $snapshotId, ['new_values' => ['commentary' => trim($commentary)], 'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);
    }

    /** @return array<string,mixed> */
    public function find(int $id): array
    {
        $s = (array) DB::table('fli_run_snapshots as s')->leftJoin('users as c', 'c.id', '=', 's.created_by')->leftJoin('users as o', 'o.id', '=', 's.signed_off_by')
            ->where('s.id', $id)->first(['s.*', 'c.name as recorder', 'o.name as signer']);
        foreach (['per_scenario', 'by_stage', 'by_portfolio', 'inputs', 'overlay_ids'] as $k) {
            $s[$k] = json_decode((string) ($s[$k] ?? ''), true);
        }

        return $s;
    }

    /** The latest record of a month that is not superseded. */
    public function latest(string $period): ?array
    {
        $id = DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereIn('status', ['RECORDED', 'SIGNED_OFF'])->orderByDesc('id')->value('id');

        return $id ? $this->find((int) $id) : null;
    }

    /** The governed movement tolerance as a share (0.10 for ten percent), or null when none is in force. */
    public function tolerance(string $period): ?float
    {
        $v = $this->setting('fli_movement_commentary', $period);

        return $v !== null && preg_match('/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*percent/i', $v, $m) ? (float) $m[1] / 100 : null;
    }

    /** What macro data the month read: the latest observation of each driver knowable at the month-end and its vintage. */
    private function vintage(string $period, ?string $driver): array
    {
        $codes = array_values(array_filter(array_unique([$driver, 'PLR', 'GDP_GROWTH', 'CPI', 'MWK_USD'])));
        $rows = AsAtSeries::macroRows(null, AsAtSeries::ym($period), ['actual', 'estimate', 'forecast'], $codes);
        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $code => $obs) {
            if ($obs === []) {
                continue;
            }
            $actual = array_filter($obs, fn ($r) => ($r['type'] ?? '') === 'actual');
            $forecast = array_filter($obs, fn ($r) => ($r['type'] ?? '') === 'forecast');
            $out[$code] = ['last_actual' => $actual === [] ? null : (string) max(array_keys($actual)), 'forecasts_known' => count($forecast)];
        }
        $vintages = DB::table('macro_series')->whereIn('statistic_code', $codes)->whereNotNull('vintage')->distinct()->pluck('vintage')->take(5)->implode('; ');

        return ['series' => $out, 'label' => $vintages];
    }

    private function setting(string $key, string $period): ?string
    {
        try {
            return $this->governance->get($key, CarbonImmutable::parse($period . '-01')->endOfMonth());
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Fli;

use App\Services\AuditLoggerService;
use App\Services\Eir\GovernanceService;
use App\Services\Scenario\ScenarioSetService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * The scenario projection (FLI module specification v1, decision D-F4).
 *
 * For the model version in force and the approved scenario set of a month it
 * projects, per portfolio and per scenario, the conditional PD of each future
 * year, the probability of surviving to it, the marginal PD (defaulting in
 * that year having survived the ones before) and the cumulative PD:
 *
 *   adjustment(s, y)  the model's predicted proxy for year y under scenario s
 *                     over the predicted base, less one; year 0 is the
 *                     adjustment the route books
 *   PD(s, y)          the transmission method in force applied to the
 *                     portfolio's exposure-weighted PD before FLI
 *   survival(y)       product over earlier years of (1 - PD)
 *   marginal(s, y)    survival(y) x PD(s, y)
 *
 * Inside the governed forecast horizon each year takes the scenario's path;
 * after it the adjustment falls in equal steps to nil over the reversion
 * years (IFRS 9 B5.5.50), and the years after that sit at the long-run PD
 * until the longest remaining term of the portfolio's performing loans.
 *
 * The projection is the evidence for Stage 2 lifetime losses year by year and
 * for the scenario workbooks; the booked Stage 2 ECL is still measured by the
 * ECL engine on the twelve-month PD the route writes, and the screen shows
 * the two lifetime PDs side by side.
 */
class FliProjectionService
{
    public const SOURCE = 'fli-projection';

    public function __construct(private FliRouteService $route, private ScenarioSetService $sets, private TransmissionMethodCatalogue $methods, private GovernanceService $governance)
    {
    }

    /** @return array{horizon:int,reversion:int,label:string} */
    public function horizon(string $period): array
    {
        try {
            $v = $this->governance->get('fli_forecast_horizon', CarbonImmutable::parse($period . '-01')->endOfMonth());
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            throw new RuntimeException('No forecast horizon is in force (Governance Centre, fli_forecast_horizon): the projection cannot run.');
        }
        if (! preg_match('/(\d+)\s*years?,\s*then\s*(\d+)\s*years?/i', $v, $m)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("The forecast horizon in force ('{$v}') does not name the years of the path and of the reversion.");
        }

        return ['horizon' => (int) $m[1], 'reversion' => (int) $m[2], 'label' => $v];
    }

    /** Run the projection for a month and store it; returns the run with its results. */
    public function run(string $period, ?int $userId = null): array
    {
        $fit = $this->route->approvedFit($period) ?? throw new RuntimeException("No model version is in force for {$period}: publish one on Model Versions (approve a fit on Regression) first.");
        $set = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereIn('status', ['APPROVED', 'LOCKED'])->orderByDesc('version')->first()
            ?? throw new RuntimeException("No approved scenario set for {$period}: approve one on Scenario Sets first.");
        $h = $this->horizon($period);
        $method = $this->methods->inForce();
        $paths = $this->sets->paths((int) $set->id);

        // the performing loans of each portfolio: exposure-weighted PD before FLI and the longest remaining term
        $loans = DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereNotNull('pd_prefli')
            ->whereRaw("COALESCE(ifrs9stage_post_qualitative, calculated_ifrs9_stage, ifrs9stage_pre_qualitative) <> '3'")
            ->get(['loan_portfolio_id', 'pd_prefli', 'carrying_amount', 'commitments', 'facility_utilisation_rate', 'remaining_tenor',
                DB::raw("COALESCE(ifrs9stage_post_qualitative, calculated_ifrs9_stage, ifrs9stage_pre_qualitative) as stage")]);
        if ($loans->isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("No performing loan of {$period} carries a PD before FLI: run the PD engine first.");
        }
        $names = DB::table('loan_portfolios')->pluck('name', 'id')->all();
        $segments = [];
        foreach ($loans->groupBy(fn ($l) => (int) ($l->loan_portfolio_id ?? 0)) as $pid => $g) {
            $ead = 0.0; $wpd = 0.0; $stage2 = 0;
            foreach ($g as $l) {
                $e = (float) ($l->carrying_amount ?? 0) + (float) ($l->commitments ?? 0) * (float) ($l->facility_utilisation_rate ?? 1);
                $ead += $e;
                $wpd += $e * (float) $l->pd_prefli;
                $stage2 += (string) $l->stage === '2' ? 1 : 0;
            }
            $pd = $ead > 0 ? $wpd / $ead : (float) $g->avg('pd_prefli');
            $years = max($h['horizon'] + $h['reversion'], (int) ceil(((float) $g->max('remaining_tenor')) / 12));
            $segments[$pid] = ['portfolio_id' => (int) $pid, 'portfolio' => $names[$pid] ?? ($pid ? "Portfolio {$pid}" : 'No portfolio'), 'loans' => $g->count(), 'stage2_loans' => $stage2, 'ead' => round($ead, 2), 'pd_pre' => round($pd, 8), 'years' => min($years, 30)];
        }
        $maxYears = max(array_column($segments, 'years'));
        $byYear = $this->route->adjustmentsByYear($period, $fit, $paths, $h['horizon']);
        $adjustment = function (string $scenario, int $y) use ($byYear, $h): ?float {
            if ($y < $h['horizon']) {
                return $byYear[$scenario][$y]['adjustment'] ?? null;
            }
            $last = $byYear[$scenario][$h['horizon'] - 1]['adjustment'] ?? null;
            if ($last === null) {
                return null;
            }
            $k = $y - $h['horizon'] + 1;

            return $k <= $h['reversion'] ? $last * (1 - $k / ($h['reversion'] + 1)) : 0.0;
        };

        $runId = (string) Str::uuid();
        $projectionDate = fn (int $y) => CarbonImmutable::parse($period . '-01')->endOfMonth()->addMonthsNoOverflow(12 * ($y + 1))->endOfMonth()->toDateString();
        $terms = [];
        $summary = [];
        foreach ($segments as $pid => $seg) {
            foreach ($byYear as $scenario => $_) {
                $survival = 1.0;
                $cum = 0.0;
                for ($y = 0; $y < $seg['years']; $y++) {
                    $a = $adjustment($scenario, $y);
                    if ($a === null) {
                        throw new RuntimeException("Scenario '{$scenario}' has no driver value for forecast year {$y} known at {$period}; the projection stops (load the forecast or extend the set's path).");
                    }
                    $cond = $this->methods->apply($method, $seg['pd_pre'], ['adjustment' => $a, 'segment_adjustment' => $a]);
                    $cond = max(0.0, min(1.0, (float) ($cond ?? $seg['pd_pre'])));
                    $marginal = $survival * $cond;
                    $cum += $marginal;
                    $terms[] = ['contract_id' => 'portfolio:' . $pid, 'reporting_period' => $period, 'scenario_code' => mb_substr($scenario, 0, 30), 'period_index' => $y + 1, 'projection_date' => $projectionDate($y),
                        'conditional_pd' => round($cond, 10), 'survival_open' => round($survival, 10), 'marginal_pd' => round($marginal, 10), 'cumulative_pd' => round(min(1.0, $cum), 10), 'source' => self::SOURCE, 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()];
                    $survival *= (1 - $cond);
                }
                $summary[$pid][$scenario] = ['pd_year1' => $terms[count($terms) - $seg['years']]['conditional_pd'], 'lifetime_pd' => round(min(1.0, $cum), 8)];
            }
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($period, $runId, $terms, $segments, $summary, $fit, $set, $h, $method, $byYear, $userId) {
            $old = DB::table('ecl_projection_runs')->where('reporting_period', $period)->where('methodology_version', self::SOURCE)->pluck('id');
            DB::table('ecl_projection_runs')->whereIn('id', $old)->update(['status' => 'SUPERSEDED', 'updated_at' => now()]);
            DB::table('ecl_pd_term_structures')->where('reporting_period', $period)->where('source', self::SOURCE)->delete();
            foreach (array_chunk($terms, 500) as $chunk) {
                DB::table('ecl_pd_term_structures')->insert($chunk);
            }
            foreach ($segments as $pid => $seg) {
                DB::table('ecl_projection_runs')->insert(['run_id' => $runId, 'reporting_period' => $period, 'scope_type' => 'portfolio', 'scope_value' => (string) $pid,
                    'methodology_version' => self::SOURCE, 'status' => 'COMPLETED', 'contracts_processed' => $seg['loans'], 'contracts_unresolved' => 0,
                    'input_snapshot' => json_encode(['segment' => $seg, 'summary' => $summary[$pid] ?? [], 'model_version' => ['id' => $fit->model_version_id, 'version' => $fit->version, 'relationship' => "{$fit->statistic_code} -> {$fit->proxy_code} (lag {$fit->lag_months})", 'effective_from' => $fit->effective_from],
                        'set' => ['id' => (int) $set->id, 'name' => $set->name, 'version' => (int) $set->version], 'horizon' => $h, 'method' => $method, 'adjustments' => $byYear]),
                    'created_by' => $userId, 'completed_at' => now(), 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
            }
        });
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Scenarios Projected', 'ecl_projection_runs', null, ['reporting_period' => $period, 'rows_affected' => count($terms),
            'new_values' => ['run' => $runId, 'portfolios' => count($segments), 'scenarios' => array_keys($byYear), 'horizon' => $h['label'], 'model_version' => $fit->version, 'set' => (int) $set->id], 'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);

        return $this->latest($period);
    }

    /** The stored projection of a month, shaped for the screen. */
    public function latest(string $period): ?array
    {
        $runs = DB::table('ecl_projection_runs')->where('reporting_period', $period)->where('methodology_version', self::SOURCE)->where('status', 'COMPLETED')->orderBy('id')->get();
        if ($runs->isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        $first = json_decode((string) $runs->first()->input_snapshot, true);
        $segments = [];
        foreach ($runs as $r) {
            $in = json_decode((string) $r->input_snapshot, true);
            $rows = DB::table('ecl_pd_term_structures')->where('reporting_period', $period)->where('source', self::SOURCE)->where('contract_id', 'portfolio:' . $r->scope_value)
                ->orderBy('scenario_code')->orderBy('period_index')->get(['scenario_code', 'period_index', 'projection_date', 'conditional_pd', 'survival_open', 'marginal_pd', 'cumulative_pd']);
            $segments[] = $in['segment'] + ['summary' => $in['summary'] ?? [], 'terms' => $rows->groupBy('scenario_code')->map(fn ($g) => $g->values())->all(),
                'engine_lifetime_pd' => $this->engineLifetime((float) $in['segment']['pd_pre'], (int) $in['segment']['years'])];
        }

        return ['run_id' => $runs->first()->run_id, 'created_at' => (string) $runs->first()->completed_at, 'model_version' => $first['model_version'] ?? null, 'set' => $first['set'] ?? null,
            'horizon' => $first['horizon'] ?? null, 'method' => $first['method'] ?? null, 'adjustments' => $first['adjustments'] ?? [], 'segments' => $segments];
    }

    /** The engine's annualised lifetime PD over the same years, for comparison: 1 - (1 - PD12)^years. */
    private function engineLifetime(float $pd12, int $years): float
    {
        return round(1 - (1 - $pd12) ** max(1, $years), 8);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Fli;

use App\Services\Eir\GovernanceService;
use App\Support\Fli\AsAtSeries;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Throwable;

/**
 * The forward-looking month-end, step by step (FLI module specification v1,
 * section 5 and decision D-F12): what each step needs, whether it is done
 * for the month, and what to do next. The Overview screen shows it and the
 * fli:month-end command follows it; an official close is refused until every
 * step before it is done.
 *
 * Each step returns: key, title, state (done, todo, blocked, warn, optional),
 * a one-line status, the figures behind it, the screen that does it and, for
 * a step the system runs, the command.
 */
class FliMonthEnd
{
    public function __construct(private FliModelRegistry $registry, private FliCloseService $close, private FliProjectionService $projection, private GovernanceService $governance)
    {
    }

    /** @return list<array<string,mixed>> */
    public function steps(string $period): array
    {
        $ym = AsAtSeries::ym($period);
        $book = DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)
            ->selectRaw("count(*) n, sum(pd_prefli is not null) with_pd, sum(coalesce(ifrs9stage_post_qualitative, calculated_ifrs9_stage, ifrs9stage_pre_qualitative) is not null) staged, sum(pd_post_fli is not null) post, max(ecl_calculated_at) ecl_at")
            ->first();
        $steps = [];

        // 1. the month's loan book, staged, with a PD before FLI
        $ok = $book && $book->n > 0 && (int) $book->with_pd === (int) $book->n;
        $steps[] = $this->step('book', 'Loan book staged, PD before FLI', $book && $book->n > 0 ? ($ok ? 'done' : 'blocked') : 'blocked',
            $book && $book->n > 0 ? number_format((int) $book->n) . ' loans, ' . number_format((int) $book->staged) . ' staged, ' . number_format((int) $book->with_pd) . ' with a PD before FLI' : 'No loan book for this month: build it on Imports & Feeds or Maintenance.',
            'maintenance.index', null);

        // 2. the economic data known at the month-end
        $series = AsAtSeries::macroRows(null, $ym, ['actual', 'estimate', 'forecast'], null);
        $actualSeries = 0; $forecasts = 0; $stale = [];
        foreach ($series as $code => $rows) {
            $actual = array_keys(array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => ($r['type'] ?? '') === 'actual'));
            $actualSeries += $actual === [] ? 0 : 1;
            $forecasts += count(array_filter($rows, fn ($r) => ($r['type'] ?? '') === 'forecast'));
            if ($actual !== [] && AsAtSeries::monthsBetween((string) max($actual), $ym) > 15) {
                $stale[] = $code;
            }
        }
        $steps[] = $this->step('macro', 'Economic data as at the month-end', $actualSeries === 0 ? 'blocked' : ($forecasts === 0 || $stale !== [] ? 'warn' : 'done'),
            $actualSeries === 0 ? 'No macro series is known at this month-end: import the series on Macro Statistics.'
                : "{$actualSeries} series with actuals, {$forecasts} forecast values knowable at the month-end" . ($forecasts === 0 ? '; no published forecast is dated on or before it, so the scenario paths carry the last actual forward' : '') . ($stale !== [] ? '; last actual more than 15 months old for ' . implode(', ', array_slice($stale, 0, 5)) : ''),
            'macro-statistics.index', null, ['series' => $actualSeries, 'forecasts' => $forecasts]);

        // 3. the credit-loss history the model is calibrated on
        $proxies = DB::table('credit_loss_series')->where('observation_period', '<=', $ym)->selectRaw('count(distinct proxy_code) p, count(*) n, max(observation_period) last')->first();
        $external = DB::table('credit_loss_series')->where('proxy_code', 'like', 'EXT_%')->distinct()->count('proxy_code');
        $steps[] = $this->step('losses', 'Credit-loss history', ($proxies->n ?? 0) > 0 ? (($proxies->last ?? '') === $ym ? 'done' : 'warn') : 'todo',
            ($proxies->n ?? 0) > 0 ? "{$proxies->p} measures, last month {$proxies->last}" . ($external ? ", {$external} external series" : ', no external (industry) series yet') . (($proxies->last ?? '') !== $ym ? '; refresh it with the correlation sweep' : '')
                : 'No credit-loss measure yet: the correlation sweep derives them from the staged loan books.',
            'credit-loss-data.index', 'fli-correlate');

        // 4. the model version in force
        $version = $this->registry->inForce($period);
        $cadence = $this->setting('fli_model_cadence', $period) ?? '';
        $age = $version ? AsAtSeries::monthsBetween(AsAtSeries::ym($version->effective_from), $ym) : null;
        $monthly = str_starts_with($cadence, 'Every month');
        $vState = $version === null ? 'blocked' : (($monthly && $version->effective_from !== $period) ? 'blocked' : ($age !== null && $age >= 12 ? 'warn' : 'done'));
        $steps[] = $this->step('model', 'Model version in force', $vState,
            $version === null ? 'No model version is in force: run the correlation sweep, then propose and approve a fit on Regression; approval publishes it.'
                : "Version {$version->version}: {$version->statistic_code} to {$version->proxy_code}, lag {$version->lag_months} months, R-squared " . number_format((float) $version->r_squared, 3) . ", in force since {$version->effective_from}"
                    . ($monthly && $version->effective_from !== $period ? '; the governed cadence asks for a version every month' : '')
                    . ($age !== null && $age >= 12 ? '; more than twelve months old, due for its annual review' : ''),
            'fli-models.index', null, ['version_id' => $version?->id]);

        // 5. the scenario set approved for the month
        $set = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->orderByDesc('version')->first();
        $approved = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereIn('status', ['APPROVED', 'LOCKED'])->orderByDesc('version')->first();
        $weights = $approved ? DB::table('governed_scenarios')->where('set_id', $approved->id)->orderBy('order_position')->get(['name', 'weight'])->map(fn ($s) => $s->name . ' ' . rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float) $s->weight, 2), '0'), '.'))->implode(', ') : null;
        $steps[] = $this->step('set', 'Scenario set approved', $approved ? 'done' : ($set ? 'todo' : 'blocked'),
            $approved ? "{$approved->name}, version {$approved->version} ({$approved->status}): {$weights}"
                : ($set ? "Version {$set->version} is {$set->status}: a second person approves it on Scenario Sets." : 'No scenario set for this month: start one from a profile on Scenario Profiles, or on Scenario Sets.'),
            'scenario-sets.index', null, ['set_id' => $approved?->id, 'pending_set_id' => $approved ? null : $set?->id]);

        // 6. overlays reviewed
        $pending = DB::table('fli_overlays')->where('reporting_period', $period)->where('status', 'PROPOSED')->count();
        $inForce = DB::table('fli_overlays')->where('status', 'APPROVED')->where('reporting_period', '<=', $period)->where(fn ($q) => $q->whereNull('expiry_period')->orWhere('expiry_period', '>=', $period))->count();
        $steps[] = $this->step('overlays', 'Overlays reviewed', $pending > 0 ? 'todo' : 'done',
            ($pending > 0 ? "{$pending} overlay(s) proposed and waiting for a second person; " : 'Nothing waiting; ') . "{$inForce} approved overlay(s) in force.",
            'fli-overlays.index', null);

        // 7. the route applied to every loan under the version and the set in force
        $applied = DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereNotNull('pd_prefli')
            ->selectRaw('count(*) n, sum(fli_set_id = ?) on_set, sum(fli_model_version_id = ?) on_version, sum(pd_post_fli is not null) post', [(int) ($approved->id ?? 0), (int) ($version->id ?? 0)])->first();
        $appliedAt = DB::table('audit_logs')->where('action', 'FLI Route Applied')->where('reporting_period', $period)->max('created_at');
        $applyDone = $approved && $version && $applied->n > 0 && (int) $applied->on_set === (int) $applied->n && (int) $applied->on_version === (int) $applied->n;
        $steps[] = $this->step('apply', 'Forward-looking route applied', $applyDone ? 'done' : (($approved && $version) ? 'todo' : 'blocked'),
            $applyDone ? number_format((int) $applied->n) . ' loans carry the post-FLI PD under version ' . $version->version . ' and set ' . $approved->id . ($appliedAt ? ", applied {$appliedAt}" : '')
                : (($approved && $version) ? number_format((int) ($applied->on_set ?? 0)) . ' of ' . number_format((int) $applied->n) . ' loans are on the set and version in force: apply the route.' : 'Needs the model version and the scenario set first.'),
            'fli.external.index', 'fli-apply');

        // 8. the scenario projection (evidence; does not block the close)
        $proj = DB::table('ecl_projection_runs')->where('reporting_period', $period)->where('methodology_version', FliProjectionService::SOURCE)->where('status', 'COMPLETED')->orderByDesc('id')->first();
        $projCurrent = $proj && $appliedAt && $proj->completed_at >= $appliedAt;
        $steps[] = $this->step('project', 'Scenario projection (term structure)', $projCurrent ? 'done' : ($applyDone ? 'optional' : 'blocked'),
            $proj ? 'Projected ' . $proj->completed_at . ($projCurrent ? '' : ', before the route last ran: project again') : 'Not projected yet: the year-by-year PD of each portfolio under each scenario.',
            'forecasting.manual', 'fli-project');

        // 9. the ECL on the post-FLI PD, after the route
        $eclDone = $applyDone && $book->ecl_at && $appliedAt && CarbonImmutable::parse($book->ecl_at)->gte(CarbonImmutable::parse($appliedAt));
        $steps[] = $this->step('ecl', 'ECL calculated on the post-FLI PD', $eclDone ? 'done' : ($applyDone ? 'todo' : 'blocked'),
            $eclDone ? 'Calculated ' . $book->ecl_at : ($applyDone ? 'The route ran after the last ECL calculation: calculate the ECL.' : 'Needs the route applied first.'),
            'expected-credit-loss.index', 'ecl');

        // 10. recorded and signed off
        $snap = $this->close->latest($period);
        $snapCurrent = $snap && $eclDone && $snap['created_at'] >= $book->ecl_at;
        $state = ! $eclDone ? 'blocked' : (! $snapCurrent ? 'todo' : ($snap['status'] === 'SIGNED_OFF' ? 'done' : 'todo'));
        $steps[] = $this->step('close', 'Month recorded and signed off', $state,
            ! $snapCurrent ? ($eclDone ? 'Record the month: the ECL under each scenario, the reconciliation and what it ran under.' : 'Needs the ECL first.')
                : ($snap['status'] === 'SIGNED_OFF' ? 'Signed off by ' . ($snap['signer'] ?? $snap['approver_label'] ?? 'a second person') . ' on ' . $snap['signed_off_at']
                    : 'Recorded ' . $snap['created_at'] . ($snap['reconciles'] ? ', weighted ECL ties to the booked ECL' : ', the weighted ECL does NOT tie to the booked ECL') . ($snap['needs_commentary'] ? '; the movement needs a commentary' : '') . ': a second person signs it off.'),
            'fli.overview', 'fli-close', ['snapshot_id' => $snap['id'] ?? null]);

        return $steps;
    }

    /** The first step that is not done, ignoring the optional one. */
    public function next(array $steps): ?array
    {
        foreach ($steps as $s) {
            if (! in_array($s['state'], ['done', 'optional', 'warn'], true)) {
                return $s;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function step(string $key, string $title, string $state, string $status, ?string $screen, ?string $command, array $extra = []): array
    {
        return ['key' => $key, 'title' => $title, 'state' => $state, 'status' => $status, 'screen' => $screen, 'command' => $command] + $extra;
    }

    private function setting(string $key, string $period): ?string
    {
        try {
            return $this->governance->get($key, CarbonImmutable::parse($period . '-01')->endOfMonth());
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Services\Fli\FliCloseService;
use App\Services\Fli\FliMonthEnd;
use App\Services\Fli\FliProjectionService;
use App\Services\Fli\FliRouteService;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Throwable;

/**
 * The forward-looking month-end on the console (FLI module specification v1,
 * section 5). Each step can be run on its own, or --all runs every automated
 * step that is not done, in order, and stops at the first that cannot run
 * (with the reason). The approvals (the model version, the scenario set, the
 * overlays and the sign-off) stay with people; this command never approves.
 *
 *   php artisan fli:month-end 2026-08                  the steps and where each stands
 *   php artisan fli:month-end 2026-08 --project --user=1
 *   php artisan fli:month-end 2026-08 --close --user=1
 *   php artisan fli:month-end 2026-08 --all --user=1   apply, project, ECL and record
 */
class FliMonthEndCommand extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'fli:month-end {period : YYYY-MM} {--all : Run every automated step that is not done} {--project : Project the scenarios year by year} {--close : Record the month (ECL per scenario and the snapshot)} {--user=}';

    protected $description = 'Show the forward-looking month-end steps for a month, run the projection or the record, or run every remaining automated step';

    public function handle(FliMonthEnd $monthEnd, FliRouteService $route, FliProjectionService $projection, FliCloseService $close): int
    {
        $period = (string) $this->argument('period');
        if (! preg_match('/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/', $period)) {
            $this->error('Period must be YYYY-MM.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        $user = $this->option('user') !== null ? (int) $this->option('user') : null;
        try {
            if ($this->option('project')) {
                $this->project($projection, $period, $user);

                return self::SUCCESS;
            }
            if ($this->option('close')) {
                $this->record($close, $period, $user);

                return self::SUCCESS;
            }
            if ($this->option('all')) {
                return $this->all($monthEnd, $route, $projection, $close, $period, $user);
            }
            $this->show($monthEnd->steps($period));
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->error($e->getMessage());

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function all(FliMonthEnd $monthEnd, FliRouteService $route, FliProjectionService $projection, FliCloseService $close, string $period, ?int $user): int
    {
        $steps = collect($monthEnd->steps($period))->keyBy('key');
        foreach (['book', 'macro', 'model', 'set', 'overlays'] as $k) {
            $s = $steps[$k];
            if (in_array($s['state'], ['blocked', 'todo'], true) && $k !== 'macro') {
                $this->error("{$s['title']}: {$s['status']}");
                $this->line('That step needs a person (an import or an approval). Do it on its screen, then run this again.');

                return self::FAILURE;
            }
            $this->line("<info>ok</info>  {$s['title']}: {$s['status']}");
        }
        if ($steps['apply']['state'] !== 'done') {
            $r = $route->apply($period, $user);
            $this->line("<info>run</info> Forward-looking route: {$r['adjusted']} loans adjusted, {$r['held']} held" . ($r['note'] ? " ({$r['note']})" : ''));
        } else {
            $this->line('<info>ok</info>  Forward-looking route already applied under the version and set in force');
        }
        $this->project($projection, $period, $user);
        $this->line('<info>run</info> ECL on the post-FLI PD ...');
        $code = Artisan::call('ifrs9:segment-ecl', ['from' => $period, '--pd' => 'pd_post_fli']);
        $this->output->write(Artisan::output());
        if ($code !== 0) {
            $this->error('The ECL run stopped; the month is not recorded. Correct what it names and run this again.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        $this->record($close, $period, $user);
        $this->line('Next: a second person signs the month off on Forward-Looking Information, Overview.');

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function project(FliProjectionService $projection, string $period, ?int $user): void
    {
        $p = $projection->run($period, $user);
        $this->line("<info>run</info> Projection: " . count($p['segments']) . ' portfolios, ' . count($p['adjustments']) . " scenarios, {$p['horizon']['label']}");
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($p['segments'] as $s) {
            foreach ($s['summary'] as $name => $v) {
                $rows[] = [$s['portfolio'], $name, number_format($s['pd_pre'] * 100, 2) . '%', number_format($v['pd_year1'] * 100, 2) . '%', number_format($v['lifetime_pd'] * 100, 2) . '%', $s['years']];
            }
        }
        $this->table(['Portfolio', 'Scenario', 'PD before FLI', 'PD year 1', 'Lifetime PD', 'Years'], $rows);
    }

    private function record(FliCloseService $close, string $period, ?int $user): void
    {
        $s = $close->record($period, $user);
        $this->line("<info>run</info> Recorded {$period}: booked " . number_format((float) $s['booked_ecl'], 2) . ', weighted over the scenarios ' . number_format((float) $s['weighted_ecl'], 2)
            . ', difference ' . number_format((float) $s['difference'], 2) . ($s['reconciles'] ? ' (ties)' : ' (DOES NOT TIE)'));
        $this->table(['Scenario', 'Weight', 'ECL', 'Contribution'], array_map(fn ($r) => [$r['scenario'], $r['weight'], number_format($r['ecl'], 2), number_format($r['contribution'], 2)], $s['per_scenario']));
        if ($s['needs_commentary']) {
            $this->warn('The ECL moved by ' . round((float) $s['movement_pct'] * 100, 1) . ' percent against the previous month-end: a commentary is needed before sign-off.');
        }
    }

    private function show(array $steps): void
    {
        $this->table(['#', 'Step', 'State', 'Where it stands'], array_map(fn ($s, $i) => [$i + 1, $s['title'], strtoupper($s['state']), mb_substr($s['status'], 0, 110)], $steps, array_keys($steps)));
    }
}

    public function doubleCount(object $o): ?string

        if ($driver === '') {

    {

    {
        $period = (string) $request->query('period', DB::table('fli_overlays')->max('reporting_period') ?? DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->max('reporting_period') ?? DB::table('loan_books')->max('reporting_period') ?? now()->format('Y-m'));
        $register = $overlays->register($period);
        $set = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereIn('status', ['APPROVED', 'LOCKED'])->orderByDesc('version')->first(['id', 'name', 'version', 'status']);
        $inForce = $register->where('in_force', true);

        return Inertia::render('Governance/Overlays', [
            'period' => $period, 'overlays' => $register->values(), 'rules' => $sets->rules($period), 'approvedSet' => $set,
            'summary' => ['in_force' => $inForce->count(), 'proposed' => $register->where('status', 'PROPOSED')->count(), 'ecl_line' => round((float) $inForce->sum('ecl_line'), 2), 'loans' => $overlays->loansOf($period)->count()],
            'periods' => DB::table('fli_overlays')->distinct()->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->pluck('reporting_period'),

            'users' => DB::table('users')->orderBy('name')->get(['id', 'name']),
            'canGovern' => (bool) (auth()->user()?->can('eir.govern') ?? false),
        ]);
    }

            'expiry_period' => ['required', 'regex:/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/'],

            $id = $overlays->propose(['reporting_period' => $data['reporting_period'], 'scope' => $data['scope'], 'scope_value' => $data['scope_value'] ?? null,
                'adjustment' => (float) $data['adjustment_pct'] / 100, 'reason' => $data['reason'], 'evidence' => $data['evidence'] ?? null,
                'owner_id' => $data['owner_id'] ?? $request->user()->id, 'expiry_period' => $data['expiry_period']], $request->user()->id);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return redirect()->route('fli-overlays.index', ['period' => $data['reporting_period']])->with('success', "Overlay {$id} proposed; a second person approves it before it reaches any loan.");
    }
