    /**
     * Propose a model calibrated outside the system (External Calculations).
     * It reaches no loan until a second person approves it.
     *
     * @param array{statistic_code:string,proxy_code:string,lag_months:int,slope:float|string,intercept:float|string,r_squared?:?float,n_obs?:?int,calibrated_period:string,effective_from:string,evidence:string} $d
     */
    public function proposeExternal(array $d, ?int $userId): int
    {
        foreach (['calibrated_period', 'effective_from'] as $k) {
            if (! preg_match('/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/', (string) ($d[$k] ?? ''))) {
                throw new RuntimeException('The calibration month and the effective month must be YYYY-MM.');
            }
        }
        if ($d['effective_from'] < $d['calibrated_period']) {
            throw new RuntimeException('A model cannot govern a month before the data it was calibrated on (IFRS 9 B5.5.49).');
        }
        if (! is_numeric($d['slope'] ?? null) || ! is_numeric($d['intercept'] ?? null)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('The slope and the intercept must be numbers.');
        }
        if (trim((string) ($d['evidence'] ?? '')) === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Say where the calibration comes from: the workbook, the consultant, the data and the period it was fitted on.');
        }
        if (! DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('statistic_code', $d['statistic_code'])->exists() && ! DB::table('macro_series')->where('statistic_code', $d['statistic_code'])->exists()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("The driver {$d['statistic_code']} is not a series the system holds, so the route could not read it.");
        }
        if (! DB::table('credit_loss_series')->where('proxy_code', $d['proxy_code'])->exists()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("The credit-loss measure {$d['proxy_code']} is not held, so the route could not read it.");
        }
        $modelId = $this->modelId();
        $id = (int) DB::table('fli_model_versions')->insertGetId([
            'model_id' => $modelId, 'version' => (int) DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('model_id', $modelId)->max('version') + 1, 'fli_fit_id' => null,
            'statistic_code' => $d['statistic_code'], 'proxy_code' => $d['proxy_code'], 'lag_months' => (int) $d['lag_months'], 'slope' => $d['slope'], 'intercept' => $d['intercept'],
            'r_squared' => $d['r_squared'] ?? null, 'n_obs' => $d['n_obs'] ?? null, 'calibrated_period' => $d['calibrated_period'], 'effective_from' => $d['effective_from'],
            'status' => 'PROPOSED', 'source' => 'external', 'evidence' => trim((string) $d['evidence']), 'proposed_by' => $userId, 'proposed_at' => now(), 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI External Model Proposed', 'fli_model_versions', $id, ['reporting_period' => $d['effective_from'], 'new_values' => array_diff_key($d, ['evidence' => 1]), 'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);

        return $id;
    }

    /** A second person approves an external proposal; it is published from its effective month. */
    public function approveExternal(int $versionId, ?int $approverId, ?string $label = null): void
    {
        $v = DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('id', $versionId)->first() ?? throw new RuntimeException("No model version {$versionId}.");
        if ($v->status !== 'PROPOSED') {
            throw new RuntimeException("Version {$v->version} is {$v->status}, not proposed.");
        }
        if ($label === null && $approverId !== null && (int) $v->proposed_by === $approverId) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Maker-checker: the approver must be a different person from the proposer.');
        }
        DB::transaction(function () use ($v, $approverId, $label) {
            DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('model_id', $v->model_id)->where('effective_from', $v->effective_from)->where('status', 'PUBLISHED')->update(['status' => 'SUPERSEDED', 'updated_at' => now()]);
            DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('id', $v->id)->update(['status' => 'PUBLISHED', 'published_by' => $approverId, 'approver_label' => $label, 'published_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
        });
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Model Version Published', 'fli_model_versions', $versionId, ['reporting_period' => $v->effective_from,
            'new_values' => ['version' => (int) $v->version, 'source' => 'external', 'relationship' => "{$v->statistic_code} -> {$v->proxy_code} (lag {$v->lag_months})", 'effective_from' => $v->effective_from], 'meta' => ['user' => $approverId, 'label' => $label]]);
    }

    /** Withdraw a proposal that was not approved. */
    public function rejectExternal(int $versionId, ?int $userId, string $reason): void
    {
        $v = DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('id', $versionId)->first() ?? throw new RuntimeException("No model version {$versionId}.");
        if ($v->status !== 'PROPOSED') {
            throw new RuntimeException("Version {$v->version} is {$v->status}, not proposed.");
        }
        DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('id', $versionId)->update(['status' => 'REJECTED', 'retired_by' => $userId, 'retired_at' => now(), 'retired_reason' => $reason, 'updated_at' => now()]);
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI External Model Rejected', 'fli_model_versions', $versionId, ['new_values' => ['reason' => $reason], 'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);
    }

    /** The version in force for a month: the latest published one effective on or before it. */

// A drop-in replacement for the browser's confirm(), showing the shared
// ConfirmDialog instead. It returns a Promise that resolves true (confirmed)

//   import { confirmDialog } from '@/Components/confirmDialog'

//
// A plain string works too: confirmDialog('Delete this template?').
import { createApp, h, ref } from 'vue'
import ConfirmDialog from './ConfirmDialog.vue'

export function confirmDialog(options = {}) {
    const opts = typeof options === 'string' ? { title: options } : { ...options }

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const host = document.createElement('div')
        document.body.appendChild(host)
        const show = ref(true)
        let settled = false
        const onKey = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') finish(false)
        }

        const finish = (answer) => {
            if (settled) return
            settled = true
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
            show.value = false
            resolve(answer)
            // let the leave transition run before the box is removed
            setTimeout(() => {
                app.unmount()
                host.remove()
            }, 200)
        }

<?php

namespace App\Services\Fli;

use App\Services\Reports\EclBuildUpService;
use App\Services\Scenario\ScenarioSetService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Proposed against approved (FLI module specification v1, section 4, Impact
 * Analysis). For a scenario set that is proposed, or any set of the month,
 * the ECL each of its scenarios would give and its probability-weighted ECL,
 * measured exactly as the route and the ECL engine would measure them under
 * the model version in force, and set beside the ECL booked today. Nothing
 * is written: the figure becomes the booked one only when the set is
 * approved and the route is applied.
 */
class FliImpactService
{
    public function __construct(private FliRouteService $route, private TransmissionMethodCatalogue $methods, private EclBuildUpService $buildUp)
    {
    }

    /** @return array<string,mixed> */
    public function simulate(string $period, int $setId): array
    {
        $set = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('id', $setId)->first() ?? throw new RuntimeException("No scenario set {$setId}.");
        if ($set->reporting_period !== $period) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Set {$setId} is for {$set->reporting_period}, not {$period}.");
        }
        $fit = $this->route->approvedFit($period) ?? throw new RuntimeException("No model version is in force for {$period}, so no scenario can be measured.");
        [$base, $scenarios] = $this->route->scenarioAdjustments($period, $fit, $setId);
        $method = $this->methods->inForce();

        $per = array_fill_keys(array_keys($scenarios), 0.0);
        $booked = 0.0;
        $measured = 0;
        foreach ($this->buildUp->loans($period) as $l) {
            $x = EclBuildUpService::lineage($l);
            if ($x['ecl'] === null || ! $x['ties']) {
                continue;
            }
            $measured++;
            $booked += (float) $x['ecl'];
            $shape = (object) ['stage' => (string) ($x['stage'] ?? ''), 'remaining_tenor' => $l->remaining_tenor];
            foreach ($scenarios as $name => $s) {
                if ((string) $x['stage'] === '3' || $x['horizon_pd_post'] <= 0 || $l->pd_prefli === null) {
                    $per[$name] += (float) $x['ecl'];
                    continue;
                }
                $pd = $this->methods->apply($method, (float) $l->pd_prefli, ['adjustment' => $s['adjustment'], 'segment_adjustment' => $s['adjustment']]);
                $pd = max(0.0, min(1.0, (float) ($pd ?? $l->pd_prefli)));
                $per[$name] += (float) $x['ecl'] * ScenarioSetService::stagePd($shape, $pd) / $x['horizon_pd_post'];
            }
        }
        $rows = [];
        $weighted = 0.0;
        foreach ($scenarios as $name => $s) {
            $weighted += $per[$name] * $s['weight'] / 100;
            $rows[] = ['scenario' => $name, 'weight' => (float) $s['weight'], 'driver' => $s['driver'], 'adjustment' => $s['adjustment'], 'ecl' => round($per[$name], 2), 'contribution' => round($per[$name] * $s['weight'] / 100, 2)];
        }

        return ['set' => ['id' => (int) $set->id, 'name' => $set->name, 'version' => (int) $set->version, 'status' => $set->status], 'model_version' => $fit->version,
            'base' => $base, 'scenarios' => $rows, 'weighted' => round($weighted, 2), 'booked' => round($booked, 2), 'difference' => round($weighted - $booked, 2), 'loans' => $measured,
            'note' => 'Measured on the loans whose booked ECL ties to their saved PD, LGD and EAD, without the overlays; Stage 3 does not move with the scenarios.'];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Services\AuditLoggerService;
use App\Services\Fli\FliCloseService;
use App\Services\Fli\FliImpactService;
use App\Services\Fli\FliModelRegistry;
use App\Services\Fli\FliMonthEnd;
use App\Services\Maintenance\CommandRunner;
use App\Services\Reports\EclBuildUpService;
use App\Support\Fli\FliPlainLanguage;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Forward-Looking Information: the month-end Overview, the Impact Analysis
 * and the Model Versions (FLI module specification v1, sections 4 and 5).
 *
 * The Overview walks a month through its ten steps and runs the automated
 * ones in the background (the same runner as Maintenance, so a long ECL run
 * does not hold the browser); the approvals stay with people and are made on
 * the Overview or on their own screens. Viewing needs a login; running a
 * step, signing off and retiring need eir.govern.
 */
class FliModuleController extends Controller
{
    /** The steps the Overview may run, as artisan commands. */
    private const COMMANDS = [
        'fli-correlate' => ['label' => 'Refresh the data and fit the candidates', 'command' => 'fli:correlate {period}'],
        'fli-apply' => ['label' => 'Apply the forward-looking route', 'command' => 'fli:apply {period} --user={user}'],
        'fli-project' => ['label' => 'Project the scenarios year by year', 'command' => 'fli:month-end {period} --project --user={user}'],
        'ecl' => ['label' => 'Calculate the ECL on the post-FLI PD', 'command' => 'ifrs9:segment-ecl {period} --pd=pd_post_fli'],
        'fli-close' => ['label' => 'Record the month', 'command' => 'fli:month-end {period} --close --user={user}'],
        'fli-all' => ['label' => 'Run every remaining automated step', 'command' => 'fli:month-end {period} --all --user={user}'],
    ];

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware('auth');
        $this->middleware('permission:eir.govern')->only(['run', 'signOff', 'comment', 'retire', 'proposeExternal', 'approveExternal', 'rejectExternal']);
    }

    private function period(Request $request): string
    {
        $p = (string) $request->query('period', '');

        return preg_match('/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/', $p) ? $p : (string) (DB::table('loan_books')->whereNotNull('pd_prefli')->max('reporting_period') ?? DB::table('loan_books')->max('reporting_period') ?? now()->format('Y-m'));
    }

    private function periods(): array
    {
        return DB::table('loan_books')->distinct()->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->limit(36)->pluck('reporting_period')->all();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Overview

    public function overview(Request $request, FliMonthEnd $monthEnd, FliCloseService $close, CommandRunner $runner)
    {
        $period = $this->period($request);
        $steps = $monthEnd->steps($period);
        $ym = str_replace('-', '', $period);
        $plain = new FliPlainLanguage();
        $userId = (int) $request->user()->id;

        // what waits for a second person this month
        $pending = [];
        foreach (DB::table('fli_fits as f')->join('fli_relationships as r', 'r.id', '=', 'f.fli_relationship_id')->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'f.proposed_by')
            ->where('f.reporting_period', $ym)->where('f.approval_status', 'PROPOSED')->get(['f.id', 'f.r_squared', 'f.proposed_by', 'u.name as proposer', 'r.statistic_code', 'r.proxy_code', 'r.lag_months']) as $f) {
            $pending[] = ['kind' => 'fit', 'id' => (int) $f->id, 'title' => 'Fit ' . $f->id . ': ' . $plain->driver($f->statistic_code) . ' and ' . $plain->proxy($f->proxy_code)['name'] . ', lag ' . $f->lag_months . ' months, R-squared ' . number_format((float) $f->r_squared, 3),
                'proposer' => $f->proposer, 'own' => (int) $f->proposed_by === $userId, 'route' => 'fli-adjustments.approve', 'note' => 'Approving publishes it as the model version in force from ' . $period . '.'];
        }
        foreach (DB::table('governed_scenario_sets as s')->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 's.proposed_by')->where('s.reporting_period', $period)->where('s.status', 'PROPOSED')->get(['s.id', 's.name', 's.version', 's.proposed_by', 'u.name as proposer']) as $s) {
            $pending[] = ['kind' => 'set', 'id' => (int) $s->id, 'title' => "Scenario set {$s->name}, version {$s->version}", 'proposer' => $s->proposer, 'own' => (int) $s->proposed_by === $userId, 'route' => 'scenario-sets.approve', 'note' => 'See its effect on Impact Analysis before approving.'];
        }
        foreach (DB::table('fli_overlays as o')->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'o.proposed_by')->where('o.reporting_period', $period)->where('o.status', 'PROPOSED')->get(['o.id', 'o.scope', 'o.scope_value', 'o.adjustment', 'o.proposed_by', 'u.name as proposer']) as $o) {
            $pending[] = ['kind' => 'overlay', 'id' => (int) $o->id, 'title' => "Overlay {$o->id} on the {$o->scope}" . ($o->scope_value ? " {$o->scope_value}" : '') . ', ' . round((float) $o->adjustment * 100, 2) . ' percent on the PD', 'proposer' => $o->proposer, 'own' => (int) $o->proposed_by === $userId, 'route' => 'fli-overlays.approve', 'note' => null];
        }
        foreach (DB::table('fli_model_versions as v')->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'v.proposed_by')->where('v.status', 'PROPOSED')->get(['v.id', 'v.version', 'v.statistic_code', 'v.proxy_code', 'v.lag_months', 'v.effective_from', 'v.proposed_by', 'u.name as proposer']) as $v) {
            $pending[] = ['kind' => 'external', 'id' => (int) $v->id, 'title' => "External model, version {$v->version}: {$v->statistic_code} to {$v->proxy_code}, lag {$v->lag_months} months, from {$v->effective_from}", 'proposer' => $v->proposer, 'own' => (int) $v->proposed_by === $userId, 'route' => 'fli-models.approve-external', 'note' => null];
        }

        $snap = $close->latest($period);
        $keys = array_keys(self::COMMANDS);
        $recent = array_values(array_filter($runner->recent(40), fn ($r) => in_array($r['key'] ?? null, $keys, true) || str_contains((string) ($r['label'] ?? ''), 'forward-looking')));

        return Inertia::render('FLI/Overview', [
            'period' => $period, 'periods' => $this->periods(), 'steps' => $steps, 'next' => $monthEnd->next($steps), 'pending' => $pending,
            'snapshot' => $snap, 'tolerance' => $close->tolerance($period), 'recent' => array_slice($recent, 0, 15), 'running' => $runner->running(),
            'commands' => array_map(fn ($c) => $c['label'], self::COMMANDS),
            'canGovern' => (bool) $request->user()?->can('eir.govern'), 'userId' => $userId,
        ]);
    }

    /** Launch one automated step in the background. */
    public function run(Request $request, CommandRunner $runner): JsonResponse
    {
        $key = (string) $request->input('key');
        $period = (string) $request->input('period');
        if (! isset(self::COMMANDS[$key])) {
            return response()->json(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Unknown step.'], 422);
        }
        if (! preg_match('/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/', $period) || ! DB::table('loan_books')->where('reporting_period', $period)->exists()) {
            return response()->json(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Choose a month the system holds a loan book for.'], 422);
        }
        if ($busy = $runner->running()) {
            return response()->json(['ok' => false, 'message' => "\"{$busy['label']}\" is still running. Wait for it to finish."], 409);
        }
        $command = strtr(self::COMMANDS[$key]['command'], ['{period}' => $period, '{user}' => (string) (int) $request->user()->id]);
        $label = self::COMMANDS[$key]['label'] . " ({$period})";
        $id = $runner->launch($command, $label, ['danger' => 'caution', 'group' => 'fli', 'key' => $key]);
        AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Step Launched', 'fli', null, ['reporting_period' => $period, 'new_values' => ['command' => $command, 'run_id' => $id], 'meta' => ['label' => $label]]);

        return response()->json(['ok' => true, 'id' => $id, 'command' => 'php artisan ' . $command]);
    }

    public function output(string $id, CommandRunner $runner): JsonResponse
    {
        $status = $runner->status($id);

        return $status === null ? response()->json(['ok' => false, 'message' => 'Run not found.'], 404) : response()->json(['ok' => true, 'run' => $status]);
    }

    public function signOff(Request $request, int $snapshot, FliCloseService $close)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['commentary' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:4000']]);

        return $this->act(fn () => $close->signOff($snapshot, (int) $request->user()->id, $data['commentary'] ?? null), 'The month is signed off.');
    }

    public function comment(Request $request, int $snapshot, FliCloseService $close)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['commentary' => ['required', 'string', 'max:4000']]);

        return $this->act(fn () => $close->comment($snapshot, (int) $request->user()->id, $data['commentary']), 'Commentary saved.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Impact Analysis

    public function impact(Request $request, FliCloseService $close, FliImpactService $impact, EclBuildUpService $buildUp)
    {
        $period = $this->period($request);
        $snap = $close->latest($period);
        $prior = DB::table('fli_run_snapshots')->where('reporting_period', '<', $period)->whereIn('status', ['RECORDED', 'SIGNED_OFF'])->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->orderByDesc('id')->first();
        $sets = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->orderByDesc('version')->get(['id', 'name', 'version', 'status']);
        $compareId = (int) $request->query('set', $sets->firstWhere('status', 'PROPOSED')->id ?? ($sets->first()->id ?? 0));
        $whatIf = null;
        $whatIfError = null;
        if ($compareId) {
            try {
                $whatIf = $impact->simulate($period, $compareId);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $whatIfError = $e->getMessage();
            }
        }
        // the loans the forward-looking adjustment moved most, for the drill-down
        $names = DB::table('loan_portfolios')->pluck('name', 'id')->all();
        $loans = $buildUp->loans($period)->map(function ($l) use ($names) {
            $x = EclBuildUpService::lineage($l);

            return ['id' => $l->id, 'contract_id' => $l->contract_id, 'customer' => $l->customer_name, 'portfolio' => $names[$l->loan_portfolio_id] ?? '-', 'stage' => $x['stage'],
                'pd_pre' => $x['pd_pre'], 'pd_post' => $x['pd_post'], 'ecl_pre' => $x['ecl_pre'], 'ecl' => $x['ecl'], 'fli_effect' => $x['fli_effect']];
        })->filter(fn ($r) => $r['fli_effect'] !== null)->sortByDesc(fn ($r) => abs((float) $r['fli_effect']))->values()->take(300);

        return Inertia::render('FLI/Impact', [
            'period' => $period, 'periods' => $this->periods(), 'snapshot' => $snap,
            'prior' => $prior ? ['period' => $prior->reporting_period, 'booked' => (float) $prior->booked_ecl, 'pre_fli' => (float) $prior->pre_fli_ecl, 'model_effect' => (float) $prior->model_effect, 'overlay_effect' => (float) $prior->overlay_effect] : null,
            'portfolios' => $names, 'sets' => $sets, 'compareId' => $compareId, 'whatIf' => $whatIf, 'whatIfError' => $whatIfError, 'loans' => $loans,
        ]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Model Versions

    public function models(Request $request, FliModelRegistry $registry)
    {
        $period = $this->period($request);
        $plain = new FliPlainLanguage();
        $governed = $registry->monthsGoverned();
        $inForce = $registry->inForce($period);
        $versions = $registry->versions()->map(fn ($v) => (array) $v + ['driver_name' => $plain->driver($v->statistic_code), 'proxy_name' => $plain->proxy($v->proxy_code)['name'],
            'months' => $governed[$v->id] ?? [], 'in_force' => $inForce && (int) $inForce->id === (int) $v->id])->values();

        return Inertia::render('FLI/ModelVersions', [
            'period' => $period, 'periods' => $this->periods(), 'versions' => $versions, 'inForce' => $inForce,
            'cadence' => $this->setting('fli_model_cadence', $period), 'canGovern' => (bool) $request->user()?->can('eir.govern'), 'userId' => (int) $request->user()->id,
        ]);
    }

    public function retire(Request $request, int $version, FliModelRegistry $registry)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);

        return $this->act(fn () => $registry->retire($version, (int) $request->user()->id, $data['reason']), 'The version is retired; the months after it fall back to the version before it.');
    }

    public function approveExternal(Request $request, int $version, FliModelRegistry $registry)
    {
        return $this->act(fn () => $registry->approveExternal($version, (int) $request->user()->id), 'The external model is published from its effective month.');
    }

    public function rejectExternal(Request $request, int $version, FliModelRegistry $registry)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);

        return $this->act(fn () => $registry->rejectExternal($version, (int) $request->user()->id, $data['reason']), 'The external model is rejected.');
    }

    private function setting(string $key, string $period): ?string
    {
        try {
            return app(\App\Services\Eir\GovernanceService::class)->get($key, \Carbon\CarbonImmutable::parse($period . '-01')->endOfMonth());
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private function act(callable $fn, string $ok)
    {
        try {
            $fn();
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', $ok);
    }
}

    /** Human-friendly duration between two ISO timestamps, or null. */
    private function duration(?string $start, ?string $end): ?string
    {
        if (! $start || ! $end) {
            return null;
        }
        $secs = Carbon::parse($end)->diffInSeconds(Carbon::parse($start), true);
        if ($secs < 60) {
            return $secs . 's';
        }
        $m = intdiv($secs, 60);
        $s = $secs % 60;

        return $s ? "{$m}m {$s}s" : "{$m}m";
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\FLI;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Services\Fli\FliCloseService;
use App\Services\Fli\FliModelRegistry;
use App\Services\Fli\FliRouteService;
use App\Support\Fli\FliPlainLanguage;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Throwable;

/**
 * External Calculations and History (FLI module specification v1).
 *
 * External Calculations is where a forward-looking model calibrated outside
 * the system (by a consultant, or in a validation workbook) is entered: the
 * driver, the credit-loss measure, the lag, the slope and the intercept, the
 * month it was calibrated on and the month it governs from, with the
 * evidence. One person proposes it and a second approves it; it is then a
 * model version like one published from a fit, and the forward-looking route
 * applies it to every loan. The page also shows what the route would do for
 * the month under the version in force, before anyone applies it.
 *
 * History is the record of every month: what it ran under (model version,
 * scenario set, overlays, vintage), the ECL before and after FLI, the
 * weighted ECL against the booked one, the sign-off, and the approvals that
 * led to it.
 *
 * The older one-slope screens wrote fli_adj straight onto the loans outside
 * maker-checker (system audit of 9 October 2026, finding M6); that path is
 * replaced by this one, which reaches the loans only through the governed
 * route.
 */
class ExternalCalculationsController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware('auth');
        $this->middleware('permission:eir.govern')->only(['propose']);
    }

    private function period(Request $request): string
    {
        $p = (string) $request->query('period', '');

        return preg_match('/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/', $p) ? $p : (string) (DB::table('loan_books')->whereNotNull('pd_prefli')->max('reporting_period') ?? now()->format('Y-m'));
    }

    public function index(Request $request, FliRouteService $route)
    {
        $period = $this->period($request);
        $plain = new FliPlainLanguage();
        $versions = DB::table('fli_model_versions as v')->leftJoin('users as p', 'p.id', '=', 'v.proposed_by')->leftJoin('users as a', 'a.id', '=', 'v.published_by')
            ->where('v.source', 'external')->orderByDesc('v.id')
            ->get(['v.*', 'p.name as proposer', 'a.name as approver'])
            ->map(fn ($v) => (array) $v + ['driver_name' => $plain->driver($v->statistic_code), 'proxy_name' => $plain->proxy($v->proxy_code)['name']]);
        $preview = $route->preview($period);

        return Inertia::render('FLI/ExternalCalculations/Index', [
            'period' => $period,
            'periods' => DB::table('loan_books')->distinct()->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->limit(36)->pluck('reporting_period'),
            'versions' => $versions->values(),
            'preview' => $preview,
            'drivers' => DB::table('macro_series')->distinct()->orderBy('statistic_code')->pluck('statistic_code')->map(fn ($c) => ['code' => $c, 'name' => $plain->driver($c)])->values(),
            'proxies' => DB::table('credit_loss_series')->distinct()->orderBy('proxy_code')->pluck('proxy_code')->map(fn ($c) => ['code' => $c, 'name' => $plain->proxy($c)['name']])->values(),
            'canGovern' => (bool) $request->user()?->can('eir.govern'),
            'userId' => (int) $request->user()->id,
        ]);
    }

    public function propose(Request $request, FliModelRegistry $registry)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'statistic_code' => ['required', 'string', 'max:32'],
            'proxy_code' => ['required', 'string', 'max:32'],
            'lag_months' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:36'],
            'slope' => ['required', 'numeric'],
            'intercept' => ['required', 'numeric'],
            'r_squared' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:1'],
            'n_obs' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
            'calibrated_period' => ['required', 'regex:/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/'],
            'effective_from' => ['required', 'regex:/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/'],
            'evidence' => ['required', 'string', 'max:4000'],
        ]);
        try {
            $id = $registry->proposeExternal($data, (int) $request->user()->id);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', "External model proposed (version record {$id}); a second person approves it before it governs any month.");
    }

    public function list(Request $request, FliCloseService $close)
    {
        $snapshots = DB::table('fli_run_snapshots as s')->leftJoin('users as c', 'c.id', '=', 's.created_by')->leftJoin('users as o', 'o.id', '=', 's.signed_off_by')
            ->leftJoin('fli_model_versions as v', 'v.id', '=', 's.model_version_id')->leftJoin('governed_scenario_sets as g', 'g.id', '=', 's.set_id')
            ->orderByDesc('s.reporting_period')->orderByDesc('s.id')
            ->get(['s.id', 's.reporting_period', 's.status', 's.loans', 's.pre_fli_ecl', 's.model_effect', 's.overlay_effect', 's.booked_ecl', 's.weighted_ecl', 's.difference', 's.reconciles',
                's.movement_pct', 's.needs_commentary', 's.commentary', 's.created_at', 's.signed_off_at', 's.approver_label', 'c.name as recorder', 'o.name as signer',
                'v.version as model_version', 'v.statistic_code', 'v.proxy_code', 'v.lag_months', 'g.name as set_name', 'g.version as set_version', 's.set_id']);
        $events = DB::table('audit_logs as l')->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'l.user_id')
            ->where(fn ($q) => $q->where('l.action', 'like', 'FLI %')->orWhere('l.action', 'like', 'Scenario Set %'))
            ->orderByDesc('l.id')->limit(300)->get(['l.id', 'l.action', 'l.entity_type', 'l.entity_id', 'l.reporting_period', 'l.created_at', 'u.name as user', 'l.meta']);
        $events = $events->map(function ($e) {
            $meta = json_decode((string) $e->meta, true) ?: [];
            $by = $e->user ?? (isset($meta['user']) ? DB::table('users')->where('id', $meta['user'])->value('name') : null) ?? (isset($meta['approved_by']) ? DB::table('users')->where('id', $meta['approved_by'])->value('name') : null);

            return ['id' => $e->id, 'action' => $e->action, 'entity' => $e->entity_type, 'entity_id' => $e->entity_id, 'period' => $e->reporting_period, 'at' => (string) $e->created_at, 'by' => $by, 'label' => $meta['label'] ?? null];
        });

        return Inertia::render('FLI/ExternalCalculations/List', [
            'snapshots' => $snapshots,
            'events' => $events->values(),
            'actions' => $events->pluck('action')->unique()->sort()->values(),
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Services\AuditLoggerService;
use App\Services\Scenario\ScenarioSetService;
use App\Support\Fli\FliPlainLanguage;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Weighted Forecast (FLI module specification v1): the probability-weighted
 * path of every driver under a governed scenario set, year by year, beside
 * each scenario's own path and the spread between them.
 *
 * IFRS 9 weights the loss, not the economy (5.5.17(a), B5.5.42): the booked
 * ECL is the weighted ECL of the scenarios. The weighted path is shown for
 * reading the set (where the scenarios sit around the base, how wide the
 * range is) and is the input of the "weight the macro path" method that the
 * Governance Centre keeps for reproducing earlier periods. Calculating it
 * stores the path against the set, so a reviewer sees what was weighted.
 */
class MacroForecastWeightedController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware('auth');
        $this->middleware('permission:eir.govern')->only(['calculate', 'destroy']);
    }

    public function index(Request $request, ScenarioSetService $sets)
    {
        $periods = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->distinct()->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->pluck('reporting_period');
        $period = (string) $request->query('period', $periods->first() ?? now()->format('Y-m'));
        $setsOfPeriod = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->orderByDesc('version')->get(['id', 'name', 'version', 'status']);
        $setId = (int) $request->query('set', $setsOfPeriod->firstWhere('status', 'APPROVED')->id ?? $setsOfPeriod->firstWhere('status', 'LOCKED')->id ?? ($setsOfPeriod->first()->id ?? 0));
        $rows = [];
        $paths = null;
        $error = null;
        if ($setId) {
            try {
                $paths = $sets->paths($setId);
                $rows = $this->weighted($paths);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $error = $e->getMessage();
            }
        }
        $plain = new FliPlainLanguage();
        $saved = DB::table('macro_forecast_weighted')->where('governed_set_id', $setId)->where('is_current', 1)->orderBy('statistic_code')->orderBy('year_offset')->get();

        return Inertia::render('FLI/ForecastWeighted/Index', [
            'period' => $period, 'periods' => $periods, 'sets' => $setsOfPeriod, 'setId' => $setId,
            'rows' => array_map(fn ($r) => $r + ['name' => $plain->driver($r['statistic_code'])], $rows),
            'scenarios' => $paths ? array_map(fn ($n, $s) => ['name' => $n, 'weight' => $s['weight'], 'is_base' => $s['is_base']], array_keys($paths['scenarios']), $paths['scenarios']) : [],
            'year' => (int) substr($period, 0, 4), 'asOf' => $paths['as_of'] ?? null, 'error' => $error,
            'saved' => ['count' => $saved->count(), 'at' => $saved->max('updated_at'), 'revision' => $saved->max('revision')],
            'canGovern' => (bool) $request->user()?->can('eir.govern'),
        ]);
    }

    /** Store the weighted path of a set (a new revision; the previous one is kept, not current). */
    public function calculate(Request $request, ScenarioSetService $sets)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['set_id' => ['required', 'integer', 'exists:governed_scenario_sets,id']]);
        try {
            $set = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('id', $data['set_id'])->first();
            $rows = $this->weighted($sets->paths((int) $set->id));
            $year = (int) substr($set->reporting_period, 0, 4);
            $revision = (int) DB::table('macro_forecast_weighted')->where('governed_set_id', $set->id)->max('revision') + 1;
            DB::transaction(function () use ($rows, $set, $year, $revision) {
                DB::table('macro_forecast_weighted')->where('governed_set_id', $set->id)->update(['is_current' => 0, 'updated_at' => now()]);
                foreach ($rows as $r) {
                    foreach ($r['years'] as $o => $y) {
                        if ($y['weighted'] === null) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        DB::table('macro_forecast_weighted')->insert(['governed_set_id' => $set->id, 'reporting_period' => $set->reporting_period, 'statistic_code' => $r['statistic_code'],
                            'year_offset' => $o, 'start_period' => ($year + $o) . '-01-01', 'end_period' => ($year + $o) . '-12-31', 'weighted_value' => round($y['weighted'], 4),
                            'standard_deviation' => round($y['spread'], 4), 'scenario_values' => json_encode($y['scenarios']), 'revision' => $revision, 'is_current' => 1,
                            'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
                    }
                }
            });
            AuditLoggerService::log('FLI Weighted Forecast Calculated', 'macro_forecast_weighted', (int) $set->id, ['reporting_period' => $set->reporting_period, 'new_values' => ['set' => (int) $set->id, 'revision' => $revision, 'series' => count($rows)], 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id]]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', "Weighted path stored for set {$data['set_id']} (revision {$revision}).");
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, $id)
    {
        DB::table('macro_forecast_weighted')->where('governed_set_id', (int) $id)->delete();

        return back()->with('success', 'The stored weighted path of the set is removed; the set itself is unchanged.');
    }

    /**
     * Per driver and forecast year: the base, each scenario, the weighted value
     * and the weighted spread (standard deviation) of the scenarios around it.
     *
     * @return list<array{statistic_code:string,years:array<int,array{base:?float,weighted:?float,spread:?float,scenarios:array<string,?float>,source:?string}>}>
     */
    private function weighted(array $paths): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach ($paths['base'] as $code => $years) {
            $row = ['statistic_code' => $code, 'years' => []];
            $moved = false;
            foreach ($years as $o => $baseValue) {
                $vals = [];
                $sum = 0.0; $wsum = 0.0;
                foreach ($paths['scenarios'] as $name => $s) {
                    $v = $s['path'][$code][$o] ?? null;
                    $vals[$name] = $v === null ? null : round((float) $v, 4);
                    if ($v !== null) {
                        $sum += (float) $v * $s['weight'];
                        $wsum += $s['weight'];
                    }
                    $moved = $moved || ($v !== null && $baseValue !== null && abs((float) $v - (float) $baseValue) > 1e-9);
                }
                $w = $wsum > 0 ? $sum / $wsum : null;
                $var = 0.0;
                if ($w !== null) {
                    foreach ($paths['scenarios'] as $name => $s) {
                        if ($vals[$name] !== null) {
                            $var += $s['weight'] / $wsum * ((float) $vals[$name] - $w) ** 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
                $row['years'][$o] = ['base' => $baseValue === null ? null : round((float) $baseValue, 4), 'weighted' => $w === null ? null : round($w, 4), 'spread' => $w === null ? null : round(sqrt($var), 4),
                    'scenarios' => $vals, 'source' => $paths['base_source'][$code][$o] ?? null];
            }
            $row['shocked'] = $moved;
            $out[] = $row;
        }
        usort($out, fn ($a, $b) => [$b['shocked'], $a['statistic_code']] <=> [$a['shocked'], $b['statistic_code']]);

        return $out;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Services\Fli\FliProjectionService;
use App\Services\Fli\FliRouteService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Adjusted Forecast (FLI module specification v1, decision D-F4): the
 * forecast of the credit-loss measure and of the PD that the model version
 * in force gives under each scenario, year by year.
 *
 * The screen used to take a typed intercept, slope and macro path and keep
 * the result in the session. It now reads the approved model and the
 * approved scenario set of the month, so the forecast it shows is the one
 * the ECL is built on: year 0 is the adjustment the route books, the later
 * years run to the governed forecast horizon and revert to the long-run PD
 * after it, and each portfolio's PD term structure (conditional, survival,
 * marginal, cumulative) is stored for the month.
 */
class ManualForecastController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware('auth');
        $this->middleware('permission:eir.govern')->only(['process']);
    }

    public function show(Request $request, FliProjectionService $projection, FliRouteService $route)
    {
        $p = (string) $request->query('period', '');
        $period = preg_match('/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/', $p) ? $p : (string) (DB::table('loan_books')->whereNotNull('pd_prefli')->max('reporting_period') ?? now()->format('Y-m'));
        $horizon = null;
        $error = null;
        try {
            $horizon = $projection->horizon($period);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $error = $e->getMessage();
        }
        $model = $route->approvedFit($period);
        $set = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->whereIn('status', ['APPROVED', 'LOCKED'])->orderByDesc('version')->first(['id', 'name', 'version', 'status']);
        $applied = DB::table('audit_logs')->where('action', 'FLI Route Applied')->where('reporting_period', $period)->max('created_at');
        $result = $projection->latest($period);

        return Inertia::render('FLI/ForecastMacroData/Manual', [
            'period' => $period,
            'periods' => DB::table('loan_books')->distinct()->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->limit(36)->pluck('reporting_period'),
            'model' => $model, 'set' => $set, 'horizon' => $horizon, 'error' => $error, 'result' => $result,
            'stale' => $result && $applied && $result['created_at'] < $applied,
            'canGovern' => (bool) $request->user()?->can('eir.govern'),
        ]);
    }

    public function process(Request $request, FliProjectionService $projection)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['period' => ['required', 'regex:/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/']]);
        try {
            $r = $projection->run($data['period'], (int) $request->user()->id);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return redirect()->route('forecasting.manual', ['period' => $data['period']])->with('success', 'Projected ' . count($r['segments']) . ' portfolios under ' . count($r['adjustments']) . ' scenarios.');
    }
}

 * modules also require the suite permission they belong to, by URI prefix.
 * A route that declares its own, stricter permission keeps it.

class RequireLogin
{
    /** Route names, or name prefixes ending in '*', that need no login. */
    public const PUBLIC_ROUTES = [
        'login', 'logout', 'register', 'password.*', 'two-factor.*', 'verification.*',
        'terms.show', 'policy.show', 'captcha', 'captcha.*', 'ebanker-feed.api',
        'sanctum.csrf-cookie', 'livewire.*', 'ignition.*',
    ];

    /** URIs (first segment or full path pattern) that need no login. */
    public const PUBLIC_URIS = [
        'login', 'logout', 'register', 'captcha', 'forgot-password', 'reset-password', 'reset-password/*',
        'two-factor-challenge', 'email/verify/*', 'email/verification-notification', 'user/confirm-password',
        'privacy-policy', 'terms-of-service', 'broadcasting/auth', 'websockets', 'websockets/*', 'livewire/*',
        'sanctum/csrf-cookie', 'api/ebanker-feed/pack', '_ignition/*',
    ];

    /**
     * Legacy financial modules and the suite permission they belong to. The
     * first matching prefix wins; a module absent from the list is gated by
     * the login alone.
     */
    public const MODULE_PERMISSIONS = [
        'loan_application' => 'loans',
        'loan-books' => 'loans',
        'save-loan-book' => 'loans',
        'contracts' => 'loans',
        'groups' => 'loans',
        'collateral' => 'loans',
        'transition-matrix' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'transition-matrix-cummulative' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'transition-profile' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'transition-profiles' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'loss-given-default' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'lgd-calculations' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'lgd-payment-report' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'expected-credit-loss' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'credit-loss-data' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'regression' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'macro-statistics' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'macro-forecast-weighted' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'scenarios' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'scenario-profiles' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'external-calculations' => 'reports.ifrs9',
        'file' => 'loans',
        'communication' => 'settings',
        'docs' => 'manual.view',
    ];

    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next)
    {
        if ($this->isPublic($request)) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        if (! Auth::check()) {
            if ($request->expectsJson()) {
                throw new HttpException(401, 'Login required.');
            }
            return redirect()->guest(route('login'));
        }

        $permission = $this->modulePermission($request);
        if ($permission !== null && ! Auth::user()->can($permission)) {
            throw new HttpException(403, "User does not have the right permissions ({$permission}).");
        }

        return $next($request);
    }

    private function isPublic(Request $request): bool
    {
        $name = (string) optional($request->route())->getName();
        foreach (self::PUBLIC_ROUTES as $pattern) {
            if ($name !== '' && ($pattern === $name || (str_ends_with($pattern, '*') && str_starts_with($name, rtrim($pattern, '*'))))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        foreach (self::PUBLIC_URIS as $uri) {
            if ($request->is($uri)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function modulePermission(Request $request): ?string

    /** The tabs of the section the current route sits in, each with its count. */
    public static function annotate(array $menu, ?string $current): array
    {
        if (! $current) {
            return $menu;
        }
        foreach ($menu as $i => $item) {
            if (! empty($item['tabs']) && self::inSection($item['tabs'], $current)) {
                foreach ($item['tabs'] as $t => $tab) {
                    $key = $tab['route'] . (! empty($tab['params']['tab']) ? '?tab=' . $tab['params']['tab'] : '');
                    $menu[$i]['tabs'][$t]['count'] = self::count($key);
                }
            }
            if (! empty($item['children'])) {
                $menu[$i]['children'] = self::annotate($item['children'], $current);
            }
        }

        return $menu;
    }

    private static function inSection(array $tabs, string $current): bool
    {
        foreach ($tabs as $tab) {
            $route = $tab['route'];
            if ($route === $current) {
                return true;
            }
            if (str_ends_with($route, '.index') && str_starts_with($current, substr($route, 0, -strlen('index')))) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

              <textarea id="commentary" v-model="commentary" rows="3" class="maiic-input w-full" placeholder="Why the ECL moved, and what the forward-looking information added"></textarea>
              <div class="flex justify-end gap-2">
                <button type="button" class="secondary-btn text-sm" :disabled="!commentary.trim()" @click="saveComment">Save commentary</button>
                <button type="button" class="primary-btn text-sm" :disabled="snapshot.created_by === userId || !snapshot.reconciles" :title="snapshot.created_by === userId ? 'A second person signs off the month' : ''" @click="signOff">Sign off the month</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p v-else-if="snapshot.commentary" class="mt-3 rounded bg-gray-50 p-3 text-xs text-gray-700 dark:bg-slate-900/60">{{ snapshot.commentary }}</p>

        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- runs from here -->
      <div class="maiic-panel">
        <div class="border-b border-gray-200 px-5 py-3 dark:border-slate-700"><h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">Recent runs</h3></div>
        <div class="maiic-table-wrap"><table class="maiic-table"><thead><tr><th>Started</th><th>Step</th><th>Run by</th><th>Took</th><th>Status</th><th class="num">Output</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr v-for="r in recent" :key="r.id">
              <td class="whitespace-nowrap">{{ fmt(r.started_at) }}</td><td>{{ r.label }}</td><td>{{ r.started_by || '-' }}</td><td>{{ r.duration || '-' }}</td>
              <td><span class="maiic-badge" :class="runBadge(r.status)">{{ r.status }}</span></td>
              <td class="num"><button type="button" class="maiic-action maiic-action-view" title="View the output" @click="view(r.id)"><font-awesome-icon icon="eye" /></button></td>
            </tr>
            <tr v-if="!recent.length"><td colspan="6" class="maiic-empty">No step has been run from here yet.</td></tr>
          </tbody></table></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="run" class="fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 flex w-full max-w-2xl flex-col border-l border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-gray-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-slate-700">

        <div class="flex flex-none items-center gap-2">
          <span class="maiic-badge" :class="runBadge(run.status)">{{ run.status }}{{ run.duration ? ' · ' + run.duration : '' }}</span>
          <button type="button" class="maiic-action maiic-action-neutral" title="Close" @click="run = null"><font-awesome-icon icon="times" /></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <pre ref="out" class="flex-1 overflow-auto whitespace-pre bg-gray-950 px-5 py-4 font-mono text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-gray-100">{{ run.output }}</pre>

</template>

<script>
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import KpiRow from '@/Components/Maiic/KpiRow.vue'
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3'
import { confirmDialog } from '@/Components/confirmDialog'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, KpiRow, Link },
  props: { period: String, periods: Array, steps: Array, next: Object, pending: Array, snapshot: Object, tolerance: Number, recent: Array, running: Object, commands: Object, canGovern: Boolean, userId: Number },
  data() { return { form: { period: this.period }, run: null, timer: null, commentary: this.snapshot?.commentary || '' } },
  computed: {
    busy() { return !!this.running || (this.run && this.run.status === 'running') },
    kpis() {
      const s = this.snapshot
      const step = (k) => this.steps.find(x => x.key === k)
      const done = this.steps.filter(x => x.state === 'done').length
      return [
        { label: 'Steps done', value: done + ' of ' + this.steps.length, raw: true, accent: '#15803d', bar: done / this.steps.length * 100 },
        { label: 'Model in force', value: (step('model')?.status || '').split(':')[0] || '-', raw: true, accent: '#0284c7', hint: step('model')?.status },
        { label: 'Scenario set', value: step('set')?.state === 'done' ? 'Approved' : 'Not approved', raw: true, accent: '#7c3aed', hint: step('set')?.status },
        { label: 'ECL booked', value: s ? this.short(s.booked_ecl) : '-', raw: true, accent: '#d97706', sub: s ? 'FLI effect ' + this.short(Number(s.model_effect) + Number(s.overlay_effect)) : 'month not recorded' },
        { label: 'Waiting for approval', value: this.pending.length, accent: this.pending.length ? '#dc2626' : '#64748b' },
      ]
    },
  },
  methods: {
    monthLabel(p) { if (!p) return '-'; const [y, m] = String(p).split('-'); return m ? `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1]} ${y}` : p },
    go() { router.get(route('fli.overview'), { period: this.form.period }) },
    screenParams(s) { return s.screen === 'macro-statistics.index' ? { tab: 'dashboard' } : { period: this.period } },
    dot(state) { return { done: 'bg-maiic-600 text-white', todo: 'bg-maiicgold-400 text-maiic-900', blocked: 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-500', warn: 'bg-amber-200 text-amber-900', optional: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-800' }[state] || 'bg-gray-200' },
    badge(state) { return { done: 'maiic-badge-green', todo: 'maiic-badge-gold', blocked: 'maiic-badge-grey', warn: 'maiic-badge-gold', optional: 'maiic-badge-grey' }[state] || 'maiic-badge-grey' },
    stateLabel(state) { return { done: 'Done', todo: 'To do', blocked: 'Waiting on an earlier step', warn: 'Done, with a warning', optional: 'Optional' }[state] || state },
    runBadge(s) { return { done: 'maiic-badge-green', running: 'maiic-badge-gold', failed: 'maiic-badge-red' }[s] || 'maiic-badge-grey' },
    fmt(ts) { return ts ? ts.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16) : '-' },
    mwk(v) { return v === null || v === undefined ? '-' : 'MWK ' + Number(v).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) },
    short(v) { if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v)) return '-'; const n = Number(v); const a = Math.abs(n); const s = a >= 1e9 ? (a / 1e9).toFixed(2) + 'bn' : a >= 1e6 ? (a / 1e6).toFixed(1) + 'm' : a.toLocaleString(); return (n < 0 ? '(' : '') + 'MWK ' + s + (n < 0 ? ')' : '') },
    xsrf() { const m = document.cookie.match(/XSRF-TOKEN=([^;]+)/); return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '' },
    async start(key) {
      if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: `${this.commands[key]} for ${this.monthLabel(this.period)}?`, message: key === 'fli-all' ? 'Runs every automated step that is not done, in order, and stops at the first that needs a person.' : 'It runs in the background; the output opens on the right.', confirmLabel: 'Run' }))) return
      this.run = { label: this.commands[key], command: '', status: 'running', output: 'Starting...' }
      try {
        const res = await fetch(route('fli.run'), { method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json', 'X-XSRF-TOKEN': this.xsrf() }, body: JSON.stringify({ key, period: this.period }) })
        const j = await res.json().catch(() => ({ ok: false, message: res.status === 403 ? 'Refused: running a step needs the governance permission.' : 'The step could not be started.' }))
        if (!j.ok) { this.run = { ...this.run, status: 'failed', output: j.message }; return }
        this.run.command = j.command
        this.poll(j.id)
      } catch (e) { this.run = { ...this.run, status: 'failed', output: 'The step could not be started.' } }
    },
    poll(id) {
      const tick = async () => {
        try {
          const j = await (await fetch(route('fli.run.output', id), { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })).json()
          if (j.ok) {
            this.run = { ...j.run, output: j.run.output || '...' }
            this.$nextTick(() => { if (this.$refs.out) this.$refs.out.scrollTop = this.$refs.out.scrollHeight })
            if (j.run.status === 'running') { this.timer = setTimeout(tick, 1500); return }
            router.reload({ preserveScroll: true })
          }
        } catch (e) { this.timer = setTimeout(tick, 3000) }
      }
      tick()
    },
    async view(id) {
      this.run = { label: '...', command: '', status: 'running', output: 'Loading...' }
      const j = await (await fetch(route('fli.run.output', id), { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })).json()
      if (j.ok) this.run = { ...j.run, output: j.run.output || '(no output)' }
    },
    async approve(p) {
      if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: 'Approve this?', message: p.title + (p.note ? '. ' + p.note : ''), confirmLabel: 'Approve' }))) return
      router.post(route(p.route, p.id), {}, { preserveScroll: true })
    },
    saveComment() { router.post(route('fli.comment', this.snapshot.id), { commentary: this.commentary }, { preserveScroll: true }) },
    async signOff() {
      if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: `Sign off ${this.monthLabel(this.period)}?`, message: 'The record of the month, its scenarios and its reconciliation are signed off in your name.', confirmLabel: 'Sign off' }))) return
      router.post(route('fli.sign-off', this.snapshot.id), { commentary: this.commentary }, { preserveScroll: true })
    },
  },
  beforeUnmount() { if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer) },
}
</script>

'text-maiic-700' : 'text-red-700'">{{ num(l.fli_effect) }}</td></tr>
            <tr v-if="!loans.length"><td colspan="9" class="maiic-empty">No loan has an ECL before and after FLI for this month.</td></tr>

        <RowPager v-model="page" :total="loans.length" class="border-t border-gray-100" />

<script>
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import KpiRow from '@/Components/Maiic/KpiRow.vue'
import RowPager from '@/Components/Maiic/RowPager.vue'
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, KpiRow, RowPager, Link },
  props: { period: String, periods: Array, snapshot: Object, prior: Object, portfolios: Object, sets: Array, compareId: Number, whatIf: Object, whatIfError: String, loans: Array },
  data() { return { form: { period: this.period, set: this.compareId }, page: 1 } },
  computed: {
    scenarioNames() { return (this.snapshot?.per_scenario || []).map(r => r.scenario) },
    maxEcl() { return Math.max(1, ...(this.snapshot?.per_scenario || []).map(r => Number(r.ecl)), Number(this.snapshot?.weighted_ecl || 0)) },
    pagedLoans() { return this.loans.slice((this.page - 1) * 15, this.page * 15) },
    movementLines() {
      const s = this.snapshot, p = this.prior || {}
      if (!s) return []
      return [
        { label: 'ECL before FLI', now: Number(s.pre_fli_ecl), prior: p.pre_fli },
        { label: 'Forward-looking effect', now: Number(s.model_effect), prior: p.model_effect },
        { label: 'Manual overlays', now: Number(s.overlay_effect), prior: p.overlay_effect },
        { label: 'ECL booked', now: Number(s.booked_ecl), prior: p.booked, bold: true },
      ]
    },
    kpis() {
      const s = this.snapshot
      if (!s) return [{ label: 'Month', value: this.monthLabel(this.period), raw: true }]
      const fli = Number(s.model_effect) + Number(s.overlay_effect)
      return [
        { label: 'ECL before FLI', value: this.short(s.pre_fli_ecl), raw: true, accent: '#64748b' },
        { label: 'Forward-looking effect', value: this.short(fli), raw: true, accent: fli < 0 ? '#15803d' : '#dc2626', sub: (fli / Number(s.pre_fli_ecl) * 100).toFixed(1) + '% of the ECL before FLI' },
        { label: 'ECL booked', value: this.short(s.booked_ecl), raw: true, accent: '#d97706' },
        { label: 'Weighted over the scenarios', value: this.short(s.weighted_ecl), raw: true, accent: '#0284c7', sub: s.reconciles ? 'ties to the booked ECL' : 'does not tie' },
        { label: 'Status', value: s.status === 'SIGNED_OFF' ? 'Signed off' : 'Recorded', raw: true, accent: s.status === 'SIGNED_OFF' ? '#15803d' : '#d97706' },
      ]
    },
  },
  methods: {
    monthLabel(p) { if (!p) return '-'; const [y, m] = String(p).split('-'); return m ? `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1]} ${y}` : p },
    go() { router.get(route('fli.impact'), { period: this.form.period, set: this.form.period === this.period ? this.form.set : undefined }) },
    bar(v) { return Math.max(1, Number(v) / this.maxEcl * 100) },
    mwk(v) { return v === null || v === undefined ? '-' : 'MWK ' + Number(v).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) },
    num(v) { return v === null || v === undefined ? '-' : Number(v).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) },
    pct(v) { return v === null || v === undefined ? '-' : (Number(v) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%' },
    short(v) { if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v)) return '-'; const n = Number(v); const a = Math.abs(n); const s = a >= 1e9 ? (a / 1e9).toFixed(2) + 'bn' : a >= 1e6 ? (a / 1e6).toFixed(1) + 'm' : Math.round(a).toLocaleString(); return (n < 0 ? '(' : '') + 'MWK ' + s + (n < 0 ? ')' : '') },
  },
}
</script>

````

        <div class="maiic-table-wrap"><table class="maiic-table">
          <thead><tr><th class="num">Version</th><th>Driver and credit-loss measure</th><th class="num">Lag</th><th class="num">Slope</th><th class="num">R²</th><th>Effective from</th><th>Source</th><th>Status</th><th>Approved by</th><th>Months governed</th><th v-if="canGovern"></th></tr></thead>

              <td class="text-xs">{{ v.publisher || v.approver_label || '-' }}<div v-if="v.published_at" class="text-gray-400">{{ String(v.published_at).slice(0, 10) }}</div></td>

              <td v-if="canGovern" class="num whitespace-nowrap">
                <button v-if="v.status === 'PUBLISHED'" type="button" class="maiic-action maiic-action-delete" title="Retire this version" @click="retire(v)"><font-awesome-icon icon="ban" /></button>
                <template v-if="v.status === 'PROPOSED'">
                  <button v-if="v.proposed_by !== userId" type="button" class="maiic-action maiic-action-view" title="Approve this external model" @click="approve(v)"><font-awesome-icon icon="check" /></button>
                  <button type="button" class="maiic-action maiic-action-delete ml-1" title="Reject" @click="reject(v)"><font-awesome-icon icon="times" /></button>
                </template>

        <RowPager v-model="page" :total="versions.length" class="border-t border-gray-100" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </app-layout>
</template>

<script>
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import RowPager from '@/Components/Maiic/RowPager.vue'
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3'
import { confirmDialog } from '@/Components/confirmDialog'
import { promptReason } from '@/Components/Maiic/promptReason'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, RowPager, Link },
  props: { period: String, periods: Array, versions: Array, inForce: Object, cadence: String, canGovern: Boolean, userId: Number },
  data() { return { form: { period: this.period }, page: 1 } },
  computed: { paged() { return this.versions.slice((this.page - 1) * 15, this.page * 15) } },
  methods: {
    monthLabel(p) { if (!p) return '-'; const [y, m] = String(p).split('-'); return m ? `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1]} ${y}` : p },
    go() { router.get(route('fli-models.index'), { period: this.form.period }) },
    n(v, d) { return v == null ? '' : Number(v).toFixed(d) },
    badge(s) { return { PUBLISHED: 'maiic-badge-green', PROPOSED: 'maiic-badge-gold', SUPERSEDED: 'maiic-badge-grey', RETIRED: 'maiic-badge-red', REJECTED: 'maiic-badge-red' }[s] || 'maiic-badge-grey' },
    statusLabel(s) { return { PUBLISHED: 'Published', PROPOSED: 'Proposed', SUPERSEDED: 'Superseded', RETIRED: 'Retired', REJECTED: 'Rejected' }[s] || s },
    async retire(v) {
      const reason = await promptReason({ title: `Retire version ${v.version}?`, message: 'The months after it fall back to the version before it, or to none. Run the route again for an open month.', label: 'Why it is retired', confirmLabel: 'Retire', tone: 'danger' })
      if (reason) router.post(route('fli-models.retire', v.id), { reason }, { preserveScroll: true })
    },
    async approve(v) {
      if (await confirmDialog({ title: `Approve external version ${v.version}?`, message: `It governs every month from ${this.monthLabel(v.effective_from)} until a later version.`, confirmLabel: 'Approve' })) router.post(route('fli-models.approve-external', v.id), {}, { preserveScroll: true })
    },
    async reject(v) {
      const reason = await promptReason({ title: `Reject external version ${v.version}?`, label: 'Reason', confirmLabel: 'Reject', tone: 'danger' })
      if (reason) router.post(route('fli-models.reject-external', v.id), { reason }, { preserveScroll: true })
    },
  },
}
</script>

````

        <div class="maiic-table-wrap"><table class="maiic-table">

                </template>
              </td>

<script>
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import RowPager from '@/Components/Maiic/RowPager.vue'
import { Link, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/vue3'
import { confirmDialog } from '@/Components/confirmDialog'
import { promptReason } from '@/Components/Maiic/promptReason'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, RowPager, Link },
  props: { period: String, periods: Array, versions: Array, preview: Object, drivers: Array, proxies: Array, canGovern: Boolean, userId: Number },
  data() {
    return {
      periodSel: this.period, page: 1, showForm: false,
      form: useForm({ statistic_code: '', proxy_code: '', lag_months: 0, slope: '', intercept: '', r_squared: '', n_obs: '', calibrated_period: this.period, effective_from: this.period, evidence: '' }),
    }
  },
  computed: { paged() { return this.versions.slice((this.page - 1) * 15, this.page * 15) } },
  methods: {
    monthLabel(p) { if (!p) return '-'; const [y, m] = String(p).split('-'); return m ? `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1]} ${y}` : p },
    go() { router.get(route('fli.external.index'), { period: this.periodSel }) },
    badge(s) { return { PUBLISHED: 'maiic-badge-green', PROPOSED: 'maiic-badge-gold', REJECTED: 'maiic-badge-red', RETIRED: 'maiic-badge-red' }[s] || 'maiic-badge-grey' },
    submit() { this.form.transform(d => ({ ...d, r_squared: d.r_squared === '' ? null : d.r_squared, n_obs: d.n_obs === '' ? null : d.n_obs })).post(route('fli.external.propose'), { preserveScroll: true, onSuccess: () => { this.showForm = false; this.form.reset() } }) },
    async approve(v) { if (await confirmDialog({ title: `Approve external version ${v.version}?`, message: `It governs every month from ${this.monthLabel(v.effective_from)} until a later version.`, confirmLabel: 'Approve' })) router.post(route('fli-models.approve-external', v.id), {}, { preserveScroll: true }) },
    async reject(v) { const reason = await promptReason({ title: `Reject external version ${v.version}?`, label: 'Reason', confirmLabel: 'Reject', tone: 'danger' }); if (reason) router.post(route('fli-models.reject-external', v.id), { reason }, { preserveScroll: true }) },
  },
}
</script>

' ' + e.entity_id : '' }}</td><td class="text-xs">{{ e.by || e.label || '-' }}</td></tr>

<script>
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import KpiRow from '@/Components/Maiic/KpiRow.vue'
import RowPager from '@/Components/Maiic/RowPager.vue'
import { Link } from '@inertiajs/vue3'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, KpiRow, RowPager, Link },
  props: { snapshots: Array, events: Array, actions: Array },
  data() { return { page: 1, eventPage: 1, action: '' } },
  computed: {
    current() { return this.snapshots.filter(s => s.status !== 'SUPERSEDED') },
    pagedSnaps() { return this.snapshots.slice((this.page - 1) * 15, this.page * 15) },
    filtered() { return this.action ? this.events.filter(e => e.action === this.action) : this.events },
    pagedEvents() { return this.filtered.slice((this.eventPage - 1) * 15, this.eventPage * 15) },
    kpis() {
      const c = this.current
      return [
        { label: 'Months recorded', value: c.length, accent: '#0284c7' },
        { label: 'Signed off', value: c.filter(s => s.status === 'SIGNED_OFF').length, accent: '#15803d' },
        { label: 'Waiting for sign-off', value: c.filter(s => s.status === 'RECORDED').length, accent: '#d97706' },
        { label: 'Not reconciling', value: c.filter(s => !s.reconciles).length, accent: '#dc2626' },
      ]
    },
  },
  watch: { action() { this.eventPage = 1 } },
  methods: {
    monthLabel(p) { if (!p) return '-'; const [y, m] = String(p).split('-'); return m ? `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1]} ${y}` : p },
    badge(s) { return { SIGNED_OFF: 'maiic-badge-green', RECORDED: 'maiic-badge-gold', SUPERSEDED: 'maiic-badge-grey' }[s] || 'maiic-badge-grey' },
    statusLabel(s) { return { SIGNED_OFF: 'Signed off', RECORDED: 'Recorded', SUPERSEDED: 'Superseded' }[s] || s },
    short(v) { if (v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v)) return '-'; const n = Number(v); const a = Math.abs(n); const s = a >= 1e9 ? (a / 1e9).toFixed(2) + 'bn' : a >= 1e6 ? (a / 1e6).toFixed(1) + 'm' : Math.round(a).toLocaleString(); return (n < 0 ? '(' : '') + s + (n < 0 ? ')' : '') },
  },
}
</script>

import { confirmDialog } from '@/Components/confirmDialog'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, RowPager },
  props: { period: String, periods: Array, sets: Array, setId: Number, rows: Array, scenarios: Array, year: Number, asOf: String, error: String, saved: Object, canGovern: Boolean },

}

      </select>
      <button v-if="canGovern" type="button" class="primary-btn text-sm" :disabled="!model || !set" @click="project"><font-awesome-icon icon="sync-alt" class="mr-1" />{{ result ? 'Project again' : 'Project the scenarios' }}</button>
    </template>

    <div class="space-y-4">
      <KpiRow :cards="kpis" />
      <p v-if="error" class="maiic-panel px-5 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{{ error }}</p>
      <p v-if="stale" class="maiic-panel border-l-4 !border-l-maiicgold-500 px-5 py-3 text-sm">The route ran after this projection: project again so it reflects the PDs the ECL now uses.</p>
      <div v-if="!model || !set" class="maiic-panel maiic-empty">
        The projection needs {{ !model ? 'a model version in force' : '' }}{{ !model && !set ? ' and ' : '' }}{{ !set ? 'an approved scenario set' : '' }} for {{ monthLabel(period) }}.
      </div>
      <div v-else-if="!result" class="maiic-panel maiic-empty">Not projected yet for {{ monthLabel(period) }}. Use Project the scenarios at the top right.</div>

      <template v-if="result">
        <!-- the forecast of the measure -->
        <div class="maiic-panel">
          <div class="border-b border-gray-200 px-5 py-3 dark:border-slate-700"><h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">The credit-loss measure, forecast by scenario</h3><p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Model version {{ result.model_version?.version }} ({{ result.model_version?.relationship }}); set {{ result.set?.name }}, v{{ result.set?.version }}. Year 1 is the adjustment the route books.</p></div>
          <div class="maiic-table-wrap"><table class="maiic-table">
            <thead><tr><th>Scenario</th><th v-for="y in pathYears" :key="y" class="num">Year {{ y + 1 }}</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr v-for="(rows, name) in result.adjustments" :key="name">
                <td class="font-semibold">{{ name }}</td>
                <td v-for="r in rows" :key="r.year" class="num" :title="r.source + (r.driver !== null ? ', driver ' + r.driver : '')"><div>{{ pct(r.adjustment, 1) }}</div><div class="text-[11px] text-gray-500">measure {{ r.predicted_proxy }}</div></td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table></div>
          <p class="px-5 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">{{ result.horizon?.label }}. After the horizon the adjustment falls in equal steps to nil (IFRS 9 B5.5.50).</p>
        </div>

        <!-- each portfolio's term structure -->
        <div class="maiic-panel">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-gray-200 px-5 py-3 dark:border-slate-700">
            <div><h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">PD term structure by portfolio</h3><p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Conditional PD of each year, the probability of surviving to it, the marginal PD and the cumulative PD, under each scenario.</p></div>
            <select v-model="portfolio" class="maiic-input !w-64" aria-label="Portfolio"><option v-for="s in result.segments" :key="s.portfolio_id" :value="s.portfolio_id">{{ s.portfolio }}</option></select>
          </div>
          <div v-if="seg" class="px-5 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">
            {{ seg.loans }} performing loans ({{ seg.stage2_loans }} in Stage 2), exposure MWK {{ Number(seg.ead).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) }}, PD before FLI {{ pct(seg.pd_pre, 2) }}, projected over {{ seg.years }} years.
          </div>
          <div v-if="seg" class="grid gap-4 px-5 pb-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
            <div v-for="(terms, name) in seg.terms" :key="name" class="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-100 px-3 py-2 text-sm dark:border-slate-700"><span class="font-semibold">{{ name }}</span><span class="text-xs text-gray-500">lifetime PD {{ pct(seg.summary[name]?.lifetime_pd, 2) }}</span></div>
              <table class="maiic-table"><thead><tr><th class="num">Year</th><th class="num">Conditional</th><th class="num">Survival</th><th class="num">Marginal</th><th class="num">Cumulative</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody><tr v-for="t in terms" :key="t.period_index"><td class="num">{{ t.period_index }}</td><td class="num">{{ pct(t.conditional_pd, 2) }}</td><td class="num">{{ pct(t.survival_open, 2) }}</td><td class="num">{{ pct(t.marginal_pd, 2) }}</td><td class="num font-semibold">{{ pct(t.cumulative_pd, 2) }}</td></tr></tbody></table>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p v-if="seg" class="px-5 pb-3 text-xs text-gray-500">For comparison, the ECL engine's annualised lifetime PD over the same {{ seg.years }} years, 1 - (1 - PD before FLI)^years, is {{ pct(seg.engine_lifetime_pd, 2) }}. The booked Stage 2 ECL is measured by the engine on the PD the route writes; this term structure is the evidence year by year.</p>
        </div>
      </template>
    </div>
  </app-layout>
</template>

<script>
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import KpiRow from '@/Components/Maiic/KpiRow.vue'
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, KpiRow },
  props: { period: String, periods: Array, model: Object, set: Object, horizon: Object, error: String, result: Object, stale: Boolean, canGovern: Boolean },
  data() { return { sel: this.period, portfolio: this.result?.segments?.[0]?.portfolio_id ?? null } },
  computed: {
    seg() { return (this.result?.segments || []).find(s => s.portfolio_id === this.portfolio) },
    pathYears() { const f = Object.values(this.result?.adjustments || {})[0]; return f ? f.map(r => r.year) : [] },
    kpis() {
      return [
        { label: 'Model in force', value: this.model ? 'Version ' + this.model.version : 'None', raw: true, accent: '#0284c7', sub: this.model ? this.model.statistic_code + ' to ' + this.model.proxy_code + ', lag ' + this.model.lag_months : '' },
        { label: 'Scenario set', value: this.set ? this.set.name : 'None approved', raw: true, accent: '#7c3aed', sub: this.set ? 'v' + this.set.version + ' ' + this.set.status : '' },
        { label: 'Forecast horizon', value: this.horizon ? this.horizon.horizon + ' + ' + this.horizon.reversion + ' years' : '-', raw: true, accent: '#d97706', sub: 'path, then reversion' },
        { label: 'Projected', value: this.result ? String(this.result.created_at).slice(0, 16) : 'Not yet', raw: true, accent: this.stale ? '#dc2626' : '#15803d' },
      ]
    },
  },
  methods: {
    monthLabel(p) { if (!p) return '-'; const [y, m] = String(p).split('-'); return m ? `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1]} ${y}` : p },
    go() { router.get(route('forecasting.manual'), { period: this.sel }) },
    pct(v, d) { return v === null || v === undefined ? '-' : (Number(v) * 100).toFixed(d) + '%' },
    project() { router.post(route('forecasting.manual.process'), { period: this.period }, { preserveScroll: true }) },
  },
}
</script>

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, KpiRow, RowPager, Pagination, Link },

  data() { return { derivedPage: 1, form: { period: this.filters?.period || '', portfolio_id: this.filters?.portfolio_id || '', definition_id: this.filters?.definition_id || '' } } },

    async destroy(r) {

}
