import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import RowPager from '@/Components/Maiic/RowPager.vue'
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3'
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import ProfileForm from './Components/ProfileForm.vue'
import ScenarioForm from './ScenarioForm.vue'
import { confirmDialog } from '@/Components/confirmDialog'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
const props = defineProps({ profiles: Array, periods: Array, setsByPeriod: Object, canGovern: Boolean })

const page = ref(1)
const period = ref(props.periods?.[0] || '')
const pagedProfiles = computed(() => (props.profiles || []).slice((page.value - 1) * 15, page.value * 15))
const showProfileForm = ref(false)
const currentProfile = ref(null)
const showScenarioForm = ref(false)
const currentScenario = ref(null)

function monthLabel(p) { if (!p) return '-'; const [y, m] = String(p).split('-'); return m ? `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1]} ${y}` : p }
function weight(profile, s) { const p = Number(s.probability); const frac = profile.weights_sum <= 100.01 && profile.scenarios.reduce((a, x) => a + Number(x.probability), 0) <= 1.0001; return (frac ? p * 100 : p).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') }
function shocks(profile, name) { const d = (profile.design || []).find(x => x.name === name); return d && d.shocks ? d.shocks.length : 0 }
function openProfileForm(profile = null) { currentProfile.value = profile; showProfileForm.value = true }
function openScenarioForm() { currentScenario.value = null; showScenarioForm.value = true }
function reload() { router.reload({ only: ['profiles'] }) }
function closeForm() { currentProfile.value = null; showProfileForm.value = false; currentScenario.value = null; showScenarioForm.value = false }
function viewProfile(profile) { router.get(route('scenarios.index', profile.id)) }
function seed() { router.post(route('scenarios.profiles.seed'), {}, { preserveScroll: true }) }
async function start(profile) {
  if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: `Start a scenario set for ${monthLabel(period.value)}?`, message: `A draft set is created from ${profile.name}, with its scenarios, weights and shocks. It reaches no loan until it is proposed and approved on Scenario Sets.`, confirmLabel: 'Start the set' }))) return
  router.post(route('scenarios.profiles.start', profile.id), { period: period.value })
}
</script>

        <div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3">

            <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-100 px-4 py-2 dark:border-slate-700">
              <div><div class="font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ s.name }}</div><div class="text-[11px] text-gray-500">{{ s.code }}{{ s.shocked ? '' : ' · every scenario on the base path' }}</div></div>
            </div>
            <svg :viewBox="`0 0 ${W} ${H}`" class="h-32 w-full px-2" role="img" :aria-label="s.name + ' history and scenario paths'">
              <line :x1="xAt(3.5)" :x2="xAt(3.5)" y1="6" :y2="H - 14" stroke="currentColor" class="text-gray-300" stroke-dasharray="3 3" />
              <polyline :points="histPoints(s)" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2" />
              <polyline v-for="sc in s.scenarios" :key="sc.name" :points="pathPoints(s, sc)" fill="none" :stroke="colour(sc.name)" stroke-width="2" />
              <text v-for="(y, i) in years" :key="y" :x="xAt(i)" :y="H - 2" text-anchor="middle" class="fill-gray-500 text-[9px]">{{ y }}</text>
            </svg>
            <table class="maiic-table text-xs">
              <thead><tr><th></th><th v-for="o in [0, 1, 2]" :key="o" class="num">{{ workbench.year + o }}</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                <tr v-for="sc in s.scenarios" :key="sc.name"><td><span class="mr-1 inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full" :style="{ background: colour(sc.name) }"></span>{{ sc.name }}</td>
                  <td v-for="o in [0, 1, 2]" :key="o" class="num" :class="changed(sc, o) ? 'font-semibold text-amber-700' : ''" :title="sc.previous ? 'Before: ' + fmt(sc.previous[o]) : ''">{{ fmt(sc.values[o]) }}</td></tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
        <RowPager v-model="page" :per-page="9" :total="workbench.series.length" />
      </template>

      <!-- the older named sets, as they were -->
      <details v-if="scenarioSets.length" class="maiic-panel group">
        <summary class="flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center justify-between px-5 py-3"><span class="font-semibold text-gray-900">Named sets from the earlier screens ({{ scenarioSets.length }})</span><span class="text-xs font-semibold text-maiic-700">Show</span></summary>
        <table class="maiic-table"><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Description</th><th>Active</th><th>Created</th><th></th></tr></thead>
          <tbody><tr v-for="s in scenarioSets" :key="s.id"><td>{{ s.name }}</td><td class="text-xs">{{ s.description }}</td><td>{{ s.is_active ? 'Yes' : 'No' }}</td><td class="text-xs">{{ String(s.created_at).slice(0, 10) }}</td>
            <td class="num"><Link :href="route('fli.scenarios.edit', s.id)" class="maiic-action maiic-action-edit" title="Edit"><font-awesome-icon icon="pen" /></Link></td></tr></tbody></table>
      </details>
    </div>
  </app-layout>
</template>

<script>
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import RowPager from '@/Components/Maiic/RowPager.vue'
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
const PALETTE = { Base: '#15803d', Upside: '#0284c7', Downside: '#d97706', Severe: '#dc2626' }
const OTHER = ['#7c3aed', '#db2777', '#0d9488', '#ca8a04']

export default {
  components: { AppLayout, RowPager, Link },
  props: { period: String, periods: Array, sets: Array, setId: Number, workbench: Object, scenarioSets: Array },
  data() { return { sel: { period: this.period, set: this.setId }, page: 1, W: 320, H: 120 } },
  computed: {
    pagedSeries() { return (this.workbench?.series || []).slice((this.page - 1) * 9, this.page * 9) },
    years() { const y = this.workbench?.year || 0; return [y - 4, y - 3, y - 2, y - 1, y, y + 1, y + 2] },
  },
  methods: {
    monthLabel(p) { if (!p) return '-'; const [y, m] = String(p).split('-'); return m ? `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1]} ${y}` : p },
    go(withSet) { router.get(route('fli.scenarios.index'), withSet ? { period: this.sel.period, set: this.sel.set } : { period: this.sel.period }) },
    colour(name) { if (PALETTE[name]) return PALETTE[name]; const i = (this.workbench?.scenarios || []).findIndex(s => s.name === name); return OTHER[Math.max(0, i) % OTHER.length] },
    fmt(v) { return v === null || v === undefined ? '-' : Number(v).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) },
    changed(sc, o) { return sc.previous && sc.previous[o] !== null && sc.values[o] !== null && Math.abs(sc.previous[o] - sc.values[o]) > 1e-9 },
    xAt(i) { return 14 + i * (this.W - 28) / 6 },
    range(s) {
      const vals = [...Object.values(s.history), ...s.scenarios.flatMap(sc => Object.values(sc.values))].filter(v => v !== null).map(Number)
      if (!vals.length) return [0, 1]
      const lo = Math.min(...vals), hi = Math.max(...vals)
      return lo === hi ? [lo - 1, hi + 1] : [lo, hi]
    },
    yAt(s, v) { const [lo, hi] = this.range(s); return 8 + (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo)) * (this.H - 26) },
    histPoints(s) { return Object.values(s.history).map((v, i) => v === null ? null : `${this.xAt(i)},${this.yAt(s, v)}`).filter(Boolean).join(' ') },
    pathPoints(s, sc) {
      const last = Object.values(s.history).filter(v => v !== null).pop()
      const pts = last !== undefined ? [`${this.xAt(3)},${this.yAt(s, last)}`] : []
      Object.values(sc.values).forEach((v, o) => { if (v !== null) pts.push(`${this.xAt(4 + o)},${this.yAt(s, v)}`) })
      return pts.join(' ')
    },
  },
}
</script>

# MAIIC UI overhaul - shared brief (9 Oct 2026)

Read this whole file before you start. Several agents work in the SAME working tree at the same time, each on its own files.

## The system
- Laravel + Inertia + Vue 3 + Tailwind app: `C:\xampp\htdocs\MAICC-IFRS9`, branch `eir_revenue_recognition`. IFRS 9 ECL and EIR platform for MAIIC (Malawi Agricultural and Industrial Investment Corporation). It was cloned from an older generic loans/medical platform, so it carries legacy screens.
- Database: `maiic_ifrs9_demo` (MariaDB, `C:/xampp/mysql/bin/mysql.exe -uroot`, no password). The app's `.env` points at it. NEVER write to `maiic_ifrs9` or any other database. Do not change data unless your task says so.
- Brand: Tailwind palettes `maiic` (green, 50-900) and `maiicgold` (400-600). Shared classes in `resources/css/app.css`: `maiic-panel`, `maiic-table` (+ `maiic-table-wrap`, `num`, `tr.total`), `maiic-badge` (+ `-green`, `-gold`, `-red`, `-grey`, `-solid-green`), `maiic-kpi` (+ `-label`, `-value`), `maiic-filterbar`, `maiic-flabel`, `maiic-input`, `maiic-select`, `maiic-action` (+ `-view` eye, `-edit` pencil, `-delete` bin, `-neutral`), `maiic-section-title`, `maiic-empty`. Light mode only.
- Layout `resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue`: page header comes from the `#header` slot (title left) and the `#actions` slot (buttons, rendered TOP RIGHT), or the `title`/`description` props. Pages are full width now (no `max-w-7xl mx-auto` page wrappers; do not add them back).
- Navigation `config/menu.php`: related screens are grouped as SECTIONS with TABS. The layout draws the tab bar automatically above the page header for any route listed in a section's `tabs`. So a page must NOT draw its own copy of those tabs. Read config/menu.php to see which section/tabs your screens belong to.
- Pagination: every server list is 15 rows a page; `resources/js/Components/Pagination.vue` is the one pager (numbered pages). Use it on every paged list.
- Fontawesome icons must be registered in `resources/js/app.js` (library.add). If you need a new icon, report it to the coordinator instead of editing app.js (shared file) - or use an inline SVG.

## The reference design: TNM Mpamba
`C:\xampp\htdocs\TNMMpamba` (branch feature/ifrs9-ui-overhaul) is the same platform, already overhauled. READ ONLY - never edit it. Look at its pages for the patterns to copy (its classes are `tnm-*`; in MAIIC use the `maiic-*` equivalents and MAIIC colours):
- page header with title + one-line description left, action buttons right;
- tabs on a page that holds more than one job (e.g. its Settings, PD/LGD pages, methodology comparison) instead of one long scrolling page;
- import screens: a short "how to" instructions panel, a "Download sample CSV" button, the upload button, clearly labelled tabs (e.g. Upload / History);
- tables with header band, zebra rows, right-aligned numbers, icon actions (view / edit / delete) using `maiic-action-*`;
- errors and messages in nicely formatted boxes (icon, title, text), not raw text or browser alerts;
- empty states that say what to do next;
- reports and exports (PDF/Excel) branded and formatted.
Find TNM's equivalents with grep/glob under `C:\xampp\htdocs\TNMMpamba\resources\js\Pages` and `resources\views`.

## Standards every screen must meet
1. Header: title + one-line plain-English description left; actions top right.
2. No long scrolling page: if a page holds more than one job, split it into in-page tabs (simple Vue tab state, styled like the layout's tab bar: `border-b` row, active tab `border-b-2 border-maiic-600 text-maiic-800`). Long tables paginate at 15 (server side if the data is server paged; else a small client-side pager showing 15 rows with numbered pages).
3. Tables: `maiic-table` inside `maiic-panel`, numbers right-aligned with `num`, icon action buttons with titles (tooltips), consistent badges.
4. Forms: labelled fields (`maiic-flabel` + `maiic-input`/`maiic-select`), validation errors shown under the field, primary button MAIIC green.
5. Imports: instructions, "Download sample CSV" (a real CSV with the exact headers the importer accepts - build the sample from the importer's code, never guess), upload, history; clearly labelled.
6. Plain English, short, no em dashes (use commas or plain hyphens), no jargon the finance team would not use. Spec references like "(spec v4 section 12.5)" do not belong on screen; remove them from visible text.
7. Correctness: never hardcode figures or fake data to make a screen look full; an empty state is fine.

## Tools (use these, they are serialised/safe)
- App for screenshots: http://127.0.0.1:8070 (NOT 8050, that one is the user's).

(async () => {
  const b = await puppeteer.launch({ headless: 'new' });
  const p = await b.newPage();
  await p.setViewport({ width: Number(width || 1440), height: 900 });
  await p.emulateMediaFeatures([{ name: 'prefers-reduced-motion', value: 'reduce' }]);
  await p.setCookie({ name: c.name, value: c.value, domain: '127.0.0.1', path: '/' });
  const errs = [];
  p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push('pageerror: ' + e.message));
  p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errs.push('console: ' + m.text()); });
  const resp = await p.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 120000 });
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(process.env.WAIT || 2500)));
  await p.screenshot({ path: out, fullPage: true });

  await b.close();
})().catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); });

// node act.cjs <steps.json>
// steps: [{ "as": "a"|"b", "method": "POST", "path": "/x", "body": {...}, "json": false }]
// Runs each request from a logged-in browser page (a = admin c_fli.json, b = demo approver c_b.json),
// with the XSRF token and Inertia headers, and prints the status and the flash message that came back.
const puppeteer = require('C:/xampp/htdocs/MAICC-IFRS9/node_modules/puppeteer');
const T = 'C:/Users/DELL/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/c--xampp-htdocs-Stress-Testing-App/c9a0f915-2064-4f18-9b98-77857ef71421/scratchpad/tools/';
const steps = require(process.argv[2]);
(async () => {
  const b = await puppeteer.launch({ headless: 'new' });
  const pages = {};
  for (const [k, f] of [['a', 'c_fli.json'], ['b', 'c_b.json']]) {
    const ctx = await b.createBrowserContext();
    const p = await ctx.newPage();
    const c = require(T + f);
    await p.setCookie({ name: c.name, value: c.value, domain: '127.0.0.1', path: '/' });
    await p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8070/fli', { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 120000 });
    pages[k] = p;
  }
  for (const s of steps) {
    const p = pages[s.as || 'a'];
    const r = await p.evaluate(async (s) => {
      const m = document.cookie.match(/XSRF-TOKEN=([^;]+)/);
      const version = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('app').dataset.page).version;
      const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: s.json ? 'application/json' : 'text/html, application/xhtml+xml', 'X-XSRF-TOKEN': m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' };
      if (!s.json) { headers['X-Inertia'] = 'true'; headers['X-Inertia-Version'] = version; }
      const res = await fetch(s.path, { method: s.method || 'GET', credentials: 'same-origin', headers, body: s.body ? JSON.stringify(s.body) : undefined });
      const text = await res.text();
      let out = { status: res.status };
      try {
        const j = JSON.parse(text);
        if (s.json) out.body = j; else out.flash = j.props && j.props.flash ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(j.props.flash).filter(([, v]) => v)) : null, out.errors = j.props && j.props.errors && Object.keys(j.props.errors).length ? j.props.errors : undefined, out.component = j.component;
      } catch (e) { out.text = text.slice(0, 300) }
      return out;
    }, s);
    console.log((s.label || s.path) + ' => ' + JSON.stringify(r));
    if (s.pollRun && r.body && r.body.id) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 400; i++) {
        await new Promise(x => setTimeout(x, 2000));
        const o = await p.evaluate(async (id) => (await (await fetch('/fli/run/' + id, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })).json()), r.body.id);
        if (o.run && o.run.status !== 'running') { console.log('   run ' + o.run.status + ' in ' + o.run.duration + '\n' + o.run.output.split('\n').slice(-25).join('\n')); break; }
      }
    }
  }
  await b.close();
})().catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); });

````
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Services\Macro\ImfWeoParserService;
use App\Services\Macro\MacroImportService;
use App\Services\Macro\WorldBankFetcherService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Data Foundation, Macro Statistics (spec v4 section 13): five tabs
 * (Dashboard, Variables, Data Entry, Scenario Assumptions, Import / Export).
 * Every source has a preview the viewer may call and a commit for the
 * manager only; nothing reaches the table until a person has seen the
 * rows. Every commit is a batch with its provenance.
 */
class MacroStatisticsController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware('auth');
        // macro.view and macro.manage are the screen's own permissions (spec v4 section 13;
        // system audit of 9 October 2026, finding M16); the EIR pair still opens the door
        // for a user who holds it, so nobody is locked out by the rename
        $this->middleware('permission:macro.view|eir.view')->only(['index', 'preview', 'export']);
        $this->middleware('permission:macro.manage|eir.govern')->only(['commit', 'manual']);
    }

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $series = DB::table('macro_statistics')->orderBy('statistic_code')->get()->map(function ($s) {
            $agg = DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('macro_stat_definition_id', $s->id)->selectRaw('count(*) n, min(period) first, max(period) last, sum(is_forecast) forecasts')->first();
            $batch = DB::table('macro_statistics_data as d')->join('macro_source_import_batches as b', 'b.id', '=', 'd.source_import_batch_id')->where('d.macro_stat_definition_id', $s->id)->orderByDesc('b.id')->first(['b.source', 'b.fetched_at', 'b.address']);

            return ['id' => $s->id, 'code' => $s->statistic_code, 'name' => $s->statistic_name, 'unit' => $s->unit, 'frequency' => $s->frequency, 'source' => $s->data_source, 'codes' => json_decode($s->external_codes ?? '', true) ?: [], 'country' => $s->country ?? 'MWI',
                'n' => (int) $agg->n, 'first' => $agg->first, 'last' => $agg->last, 'forecasts' => (int) $agg->forecasts, 'last_batch' => $batch ? ['source' => $batch->source, 'fetched_at' => $batch->fetched_at, 'address' => $batch->address] : null, 'why' => $s->statistic_description];
        });
        $selected = (int) $request->query('series', $series->first()['id'] ?? 0);
        $observations = $selected ? DB::table('macro_statistics_data as d')->leftJoin('macro_source_import_batches as b', 'b.id', '=', 'd.source_import_batch_id')->where('d.macro_stat_definition_id', $selected)->orderBy('d.period')
            ->get(['d.id', 'd.period', 'd.value', 'd.is_forecast', 'd.source', 'd.notes', 'b.source as batch_source', 'b.fetched_at']) : collect();
        $batches = DB::table('macro_source_import_batches as b')->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'b.committed_by')->orderByDesc('b.id')->limit(30)->get(['b.*', 'u.name as committed_by_name']);
        $sets = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->orderByDesc('version')->limit(5)->get(['id', 'reporting_period', 'version', 'name', 'status']);

        return Inertia::render('Macro/Index', [
            'series' => $series, 'selected' => $selected, 'observations' => $observations, 'batches' => $batches, 'sets' => $sets,
            'canManage' => (bool) (auth()->user()?->canAny(['macro.manage', 'eir.govern']) ?? false), 'defaultCountry' => config('services.worldbank.country', 'MWI'),
            // Real counts for the section row's chips (config/menu.php, Macro Statistics).
            'tabCounts' => ['dashboard' => $series->count(), 'variables' => $series->count(), 'entry' => $observations ? count($observations) : 0, 'scenarios' => $sets->count(), 'import' => $batches->count()],
        ]);
    }

    /** A preview from a source: World Bank (live), the IMF WEO file, or the RBM policy-rate file. Writes nothing. */
    public function preview(Request $request, WorldBankFetcherService $wb, ImfWeoParserService $imf)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['source' => ['required', 'in:world_bank,imf_weo,rbm_file'], 'series_code' => ['nullable', 'string'], 'country' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:3'], 'from' => ['nullable', 'integer'], 'to' => ['nullable', 'integer'], 'file' => ['nullable', 'file']]);
        try {
            if ($data['source'] === 'rbm_file') {
                $request->validate(['file' => ['required', 'file']]);

                return response()->json($this->rbmPreview($request->file('file')->getRealPath(), $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalName()));
            }
            $series = DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('statistic_code', $data['series_code'] ?? '')->first();
            if ($series === null) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Choose a series.'], 422);
            }
            if ($data['source'] === 'world_bank') {
                return response()->json($wb->fetch($series, $data['country'] ?? null, $data['from'] ?? null, $data['to'] ?? null));
            }
            $request->validate(['file' => ['required', 'file']]);

            return response()->json($imf->parse($request->file('file')->getRealPath(), $series, $data['country'] ?? null, $data['from'] ?? null, $data['to'] ?? null));
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return response()->json(['error' => $e->getMessage()], 422);
        }
    }

    /** Commit a preview the person has seen, as a batch. */
    public function commit(Request $request, MacroImportService $importer)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['preview' => ['required', 'array'], 'source' => ['required', 'in:world_bank,imf_weo,rbm_file,manual'], 'note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255']]);
        try {
            $r = $importer->commit($data['preview'], $request->user()->id, $data['source'], $data['preview']['file_sha256'] ?? null, $data['note'] ?? null);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', "Batch {$r['batch_id']}: {$r['rows']} rows, {$r['new']} new, {$r['updated']} updated, {$r['unchanged']} unchanged.");
    }

    /** A manual entry overrides a source only with a reason, shown on the row and in the audit log (13.5). */
    public function manual(Request $request, MacroImportService $importer)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['series_code' => ['required', 'string'], 'period' => ['required', 'date'], 'value' => ['required', 'numeric'], 'is_forecast' => ['nullable', 'boolean'], 'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255']]);
        $preview = ['series_code' => $data['series_code'], 'indicator_code' => null, 'country' => 'MWI', 'source' => 'Manual entry: ' . $data['reason'], 'address' => null, 'fetched_at' => now()->toDateTimeString(),
            'rows' => [['period' => $data['period'], 'year' => (int) substr($data['period'], 0, 4), 'value' => (float) $data['value'], 'value_type' => ! empty($data['is_forecast']) ? 'forecast' : 'actual']]];
        try {
            $r = $importer->commit($preview, $request->user()->id, 'manual', null, $data['reason']);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', "Manual entry recorded as batch {$r['batch_id']} with its reason.");
    }

    /** The CSV template and the export of every observation. */
    public function export(): StreamedResponse
    {
        return response()->streamDownload(function () {
            $out = fopen('php://output', 'w');
            fputcsv($out, ['series_code', 'period', 'value', 'is_forecast', 'source']);
            foreach (DB::table('macro_statistics_data as d')->join('macro_statistics as s', 's.id', '=', 'd.macro_stat_definition_id')->orderBy('s.statistic_code')->orderBy('d.period')->get(['s.statistic_code', 'd.period', 'd.value', 'd.is_forecast', 'd.source']) as $r) {
                fputcsv($out, [$r->statistic_code, $r->period, $r->value, $r->is_forecast, $r->source]);
            }
            fclose($out);
        }, 'macro statistics ' . now()->toDateString() . '.csv', ['Content-Type' => 'text/csv']);
    }

    public function updateProposed(int $setId, array $changes, ?int $userId): array
    {
        $set = $this->editable($setId, $userId);
        $before = $this->snapshot($setId);
        $result = DB::transaction(function () use ($setId, $set, $changes) {
            $head = array_filter(['name' => $changes['name'] ?? null, 'narrative' => $changes['narrative'] ?? null, 'source_vintage' => $changes['source_vintage'] ?? null], fn ($v) => $v !== null);
            if ($head !== []) {
                if (isset($head['name']) && trim((string) $head['name']) === '') {
                    throw new RuntimeException('The set needs a name.');
                }
                DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('id', $setId)->update($head + ['updated_at' => now()]);
            }
            foreach ($changes['remove'] ?? [] as $removeId) {
                $this->deleteScenario($setId, (int) $removeId);
            }
            foreach ($changes['scenarios'] ?? [] as $s) {
                $this->writeScenario($setId, $s);
            }
            $v = $this->validate($setId);
            if ($set->status === 'PROPOSED' && ! $v['ok']) {
                throw new RuntimeException('The change is refused, the set would no longer pass its rules: ' . implode('; ', $v['problems']));
            }

            return $v;
        });
        AuditLoggerService::log('Scenario Set Edited', 'governed_scenario_sets', $setId, ['reporting_period' => $set->reporting_period, 'old_values' => $before, 'new_values' => $this->snapshot($setId), 'meta' => ['user' => $userId, 'ok' => $result['ok'], 'problems' => $result['problems']]]);

        return $result;
    }

    /** One scenario added to a set not yet approved; the new scenario's id. */
    public function addScenario(int $setId, array $scenario, ?int $userId): int
    {
        unset($scenario['id']);
        $this->updateProposed($setId, ['scenarios' => [$scenario]], $userId);

        return (int) DB::table('governed_scenarios')->where('set_id', $setId)->where('name', $scenario['name'])->orderByDesc('id')->value('id');
    }

    public function removeScenario(int $setId, int $scenarioId, ?int $userId): array
    {
        return $this->updateProposed($setId, ['remove' => [$scenarioId]], $userId);
    }

            throw new RuntimeException('Only the proposer may change a proposed set; a second person approves it or asks for a new version.');
        }

    private function variableRules(?int $id = null): array
    {

    private function variableRow(array $d): array
    {
        $codes = array_filter(['world_bank' => $d['world_bank'] ?? null, 'imf_weo' => $d['imf_weo'] ?? null, 'rbm' => $d['other_code'] ?? null]);

            'external_codes' => $codes === [] ? null : json_encode($codes), 'updated_at' => now()];
    }

    /** A new economic variable: the series the model can be calibrated on and the scenarios can shock. */
    public function variableStore(Request $request)
    {
        $d = $request->validate($this->variableRules(), ['statistic_code.regex' => 'The code is capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (for example MAIZE_PRICE).']);
        $id = DB::table('macro_statistics')->insertGetId($this->variableRow($d) + ['country' => 'MWI', 'is_active' => 1, 'created_at' => now()]);
        \\App\\Services\\AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Variable Created', 'macro_statistics', $id, ['new_values' => $d, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id]]);

        return redirect()->route('macro-statistics.index', ['tab' => 'variables'])->with('success', "Variable {$d['statistic_code']} added. Enter its values on Data Entry or import them.");
    }

    public function variableUpdate(Request $request, int $id)
    {
        $old = DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('id', $id)->first() ?? abort(404);
        $d = $request->validate($this->variableRules($id), ['statistic_code.regex' => 'The code is capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.']);
        if ($d['statistic_code'] !== $old->statistic_code && $this->variableInUse($old->statistic_code) !== null) {
            return back()->with('error', "The code of {$old->statistic_code} cannot change: " . $this->variableInUse($old->statistic_code) . '. Change its name or description instead.');
        }
        DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('id', $id)->update($this->variableRow($d));
        \\App\\Services\\AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Variable Updated', 'macro_statistics', $id, ['old_values' => (array) $old, 'new_values' => $d, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id]]);

        return back()->with('success', "Variable {$d['statistic_code']} updated.");
    }

    /** A variable is deleted only when nothing depends on it; otherwise say what does. */
    public function variableDestroy(Request $request, int $id)
    {
        $v = DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('id', $id)->first() ?? abort(404);
        $n = DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('macro_stat_definition_id', $id)->count();
        if ($n > 0) {
            return back()->with('error', "{$v->statistic_code} holds {$n} observations; delete them on Data Entry first, or keep the variable.");
        }
        if ($why = $this->variableInUse($v->statistic_code)) {
            return back()->with('error', "{$v->statistic_code} cannot be deleted: {$why}.");
        }
        DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('id', $id)->delete();
        DB::table('macro_series')->where('statistic_code', $v->statistic_code)->delete();
        \\App\\Services\\AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Variable Deleted', 'macro_statistics', $id, ['old_values' => (array) $v, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id]]);

        return back()->with('success', "Variable {$v->statistic_code} deleted.");
    }

    private function variableInUse(string $code): ?string
    {
        if (DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('statistic_code', $code)->exists()) {
            return 'a forward-looking model version uses it as its driver';
        }
        if (DB::table('scenario_shocks')->where('statistic_code', $code)->exists()) {
            return 'a scenario set shocks it';
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ observations

    /** Correct one observation, with the reason; the old value goes to the audit log. */
    public function observationUpdate(Request $request, int $id)
    {
        $o = DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('id', $id)->first() ?? abort(404);
        $d = $request->validate(['value' => ['required', 'numeric'], 'is_forecast' => ['nullable', 'boolean'], 'published_at' => ['nullable', 'date'], 'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255']]);
        $new = ['value' => $d['value'], 'is_forecast' => ! empty($d['is_forecast']) ? 1 : 0, 'actual_value' => empty($d['is_forecast']) ? $d['value'] : null,
            'published_at' => $d['published_at'] ?? null, 'notes' => trim(($o->notes ? $o->notes . ' | ' : '') . 'Corrected: ' . $d['reason']), 'updated_at' => now()];
        DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('id', $id)->update($new);
        \\App\\Services\\AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Observation Corrected', 'macro_statistics_data', $id, ['old_values' => ['value' => $o->value, 'is_forecast' => $o->is_forecast, 'published_at' => $o->published_at], 'new_values' => $new, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id, 'reason' => $d['reason']]]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Observation corrected; the old value is kept in the audit log. The model reads it at the next correlation sweep.');
    }

    public function observationDestroy(Request $request, int $id)
    {
        $o = DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('id', $id)->first() ?? abort(404);
        $d = $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255']]);
        DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('id', $id)->delete();
        \\App\\Services\\AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Observation Deleted', 'macro_statistics_data', $id, ['old_values' => (array) $o, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id, 'reason' => $d['reason']]]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Observation deleted; the reason and the old value are in the audit log.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ your own CSV

    /**
     * A CSV of any series the system holds, in the export's own layout:
     * series_code, period, value, is_forecast, source, published_at. Writes
     * nothing; the rows come back grouped by series for the person to see.
     */
    public function csvPreview(Request $request): \\Illuminate\\Http\\JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate(['file' => ['required', 'file', 'max:5120']]);
        $fh = fopen($request->file('file')->getRealPath(), 'r');
        $head = array_map(fn ($h) => strtolower(trim((string) $h, " \\t\\n\\r\\0\\x0B\\xEF\\xBB\\xBF")), fgetcsv($fh) ?: []);
        foreach (['series_code', 'period', 'value'] as $need) {
            if (! in_array($need, $head, true)) {
                return response()->json(['error' => "The file needs a column named {$need}. Download the sample for the layout."], 422);
            }
        }
        $codes = DB::table('macro_statistics')->pluck('statistic_code')->all();
        $groups = []; $errors = []; $line = 1;
        while (($row = fgetcsv($fh)) !== false) {
            $line++;
            if (count(array_filter($row, fn ($v) => trim((string) $v) !== '')) === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $r = array_combine(array_slice($head, 0, count($row)), array_slice($row, 0, count($head))) ?: [];
            $code = strtoupper(trim((string) ($r['series_code'] ?? '')));
            $ts = strtotime(preg_match('/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}$/', trim((string) ($r['period'] ?? ''))) ? trim($r['period']) . '-01' : trim((string) ($r['period'] ?? '')));
            $value = str_replace([',', '%'], '', trim((string) ($r['value'] ?? '')));
            if (! in_array($code, $codes, true)) {
                $errors[] = "Line {$line}: {$code} is not a variable; add it on Variables first.";
                continue;
            }
            if ($ts === false || ! is_numeric($value)) {
                $errors[] = "Line {$line}: the period or the value cannot be read.";
                continue;
            }
            $forecast = in_array(strtolower(trim((string) ($r['is_forecast'] ?? ''))), ['1', 'yes', 'true', 'forecast', 'y'], true);
            $pub = trim((string) ($r['published_at'] ?? ''));
            $groups[$code][] = ['period' => date('Y-m-t', $ts), 'year' => (int) date('Y', $ts), 'value' => (float) $value, 'value_type' => $forecast ? 'forecast' : 'actual',
                'published_at' => $pub !== '' && strtotime($pub) ? date('Y-m-d', strtotime($pub)) : null, 'source' => trim((string) ($r['source'] ?? '')) ?: null];
        }
        fclose($fh);
        $previews = [];
        foreach ($groups as $code => $rows) {
            usort($rows, fn ($a, $b) => strcmp($a['period'], $b['period']));
            $previews[] = ['series_code' => $code, 'indicator_code' => null, 'country' => 'MWI', 'source' => $rows[0]['source'] ?? 'CSV import', 'address' => $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalName(), 'fetched_at' => now()->toDateTimeString(), 'rows' => $rows];
        }

        return response()->json(['previews' => $previews, 'errors' => array_slice($errors, 0, 50), 'error_count' => count($errors), 'rows' => array_sum(array_map(fn ($p) => count($p['rows']), $previews))]);
    }

    public function csvCommit(Request $request, MacroImportService $importer)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['previews' => ['required', 'array'], 'note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255']]);
        $done = [];
        try {
            foreach ($data['previews'] as $p) {
                $r = $importer->commit($p, $request->user()->id, 'manual', null, $data['note'] ?? 'CSV import');
                // the release date of each row (FLI module D-F10)
                $sid = DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('statistic_code', $p['series_code'])->value('id');
                foreach ($p['rows'] as $row) {
                    if (! empty($row['published_at'])) {
                        DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('macro_stat_definition_id', $sid)->where('period', $row['period'])->update(['published_at' => $row['published_at']]);
                    }
                }
                $done[] = "{$p['series_code']} batch {$r['batch_id']} ({$r['new']} new, {$r['updated']} updated)";
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', 'Imported: ' . implode('; ', $done) . '.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ scenario assumptions

    /**
     * The assumptions of a month's scenario sets: per scenario, the shock on
     * each variable in each forecast year and the path it gives, beside the

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ variables

    private function variableRules(?int $id = null): array
    {
        return [
            'statistic_code' => ['required', 'string', 'max:32', 'regex:/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$/', 'unique:macro_statistics,statistic_code' . ($id ? ',' . $id : '')],
            'statistic_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:199'],
            'unit' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'frequency' => ['required', 'in:monthly,quarterly,yearly'],
            'data_source' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:199'],
            'world_bank' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'imf_weo' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'other_code' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'statistic_description' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:199'],
            'website_link' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:199'],
        ];
    }

    private function variableRow(array $d): array
    {
        $codes = array_filter(['world_bank' => $d['world_bank'] ?? null, 'imf_weo' => $d['imf_weo'] ?? null, 'rbm' => $d['other_code'] ?? null]);

        return ['statistic_code' => $d['statistic_code'], 'statistic_name' => $d['statistic_name'], 'unit' => $d['unit'] ?? null, 'frequency' => $d['frequency'],
            'data_source' => $d['data_source'] ?? null, 'statistic_description' => $d['statistic_description'] ?? null, 'website_link' => $d['website_link'] ?? null,
            'external_codes' => $codes === [] ? null : json_encode($codes), 'updated_at' => now()];
    }

    /** A new economic variable: a series the model can be calibrated on and the scenarios can shock. */
    public function variableStore(Request $request)
    {
        $d = $request->validate($this->variableRules(), ['statistic_code.regex' => 'The code is capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (for example MAIZE_PRICE).']);
        $id = DB::table('macro_statistics')->insertGetId($this->variableRow($d) + ['country' => 'MWI', 'is_active' => 1, 'created_at' => now()]);
        AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Variable Created', 'macro_statistics', $id, ['new_values' => $d, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id]]);

        return redirect()->route('macro-statistics.index', ['tab' => 'variables'])->with('success', "Variable {$d['statistic_code']} added. Enter its values on Data Entry, or import them.");
    }

    public function variableUpdate(Request $request, int $id)
    {
        $old = DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('id', $id)->first() ?? abort(404);
        $d = $request->validate($this->variableRules($id), ['statistic_code.regex' => 'The code is capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.']);
        if ($d['statistic_code'] !== $old->statistic_code && ($why = $this->variableInUse($old->statistic_code)) !== null) {
            return back()->with('error', "The code of {$old->statistic_code} cannot change: {$why}. Change its name or description instead.");
        }
        DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('id', $id)->update($this->variableRow($d));
        AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Variable Updated', 'macro_statistics', $id, ['old_values' => (array) $old, 'new_values' => $d, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id]]);

        return back()->with('success', "Variable {$d['statistic_code']} updated.");
    }

    /** A variable is deleted only when nothing depends on it; otherwise the message says what does. */
    public function variableDestroy(Request $request, int $id)
    {
        $v = DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('id', $id)->first() ?? abort(404);
        $n = DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('macro_stat_definition_id', $id)->count();
        if ($n > 0) {
            return back()->with('error', "{$v->statistic_code} holds {$n} observations: delete them on Data Entry first, or keep the variable.");
        }
        if (($why = $this->variableInUse($v->statistic_code)) !== null) {
            return back()->with('error', "{$v->statistic_code} cannot be deleted: {$why}.");
        }
        DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('id', $id)->delete();
        DB::table('macro_series')->where('statistic_code', $v->statistic_code)->delete();
        AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Variable Deleted', 'macro_statistics', $id, ['old_values' => (array) $v, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id]]);

        return back()->with('success', "Variable {$v->statistic_code} deleted.");
    }

    private function variableInUse(string $code): ?string
    {
        if (DB::table('fli_model_versions')->where('statistic_code', $code)->exists()) {
            return 'a forward-looking model version uses it as its driver';
        }
        if (DB::table('scenario_shocks')->where('statistic_code', $code)->exists()) {
            return 'a scenario set shocks it';
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ observations

    /** Correct one observation, with the reason; the old value goes to the audit log. */
    public function observationUpdate(Request $request, int $id)
    {
        $o = DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('id', $id)->first() ?? abort(404);
        $d = $request->validate(['value' => ['required', 'numeric'], 'is_forecast' => ['nullable', 'boolean'], 'published_at' => ['nullable', 'date'], 'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255']]);
        $new = ['value' => $d['value'], 'is_forecast' => ! empty($d['is_forecast']) ? 1 : 0, 'actual_value' => empty($d['is_forecast']) ? $d['value'] : null,
            'published_at' => $d['published_at'] ?? null, 'notes' => mb_substr(trim(($o->notes ? $o->notes . ' | ' : '') . 'Corrected: ' . $d['reason']), 0, 2000), 'updated_at' => now()];
        DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('id', $id)->update($new);
        AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Observation Corrected', 'macro_statistics_data', $id, ['old_values' => ['value' => $o->value, 'is_forecast' => $o->is_forecast, 'published_at' => $o->published_at],
            'new_values' => $new, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id, 'reason' => $d['reason']]]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Observation corrected; the old value is kept in the audit log. The model reads it at the next correlation sweep.');
    }

    public function observationDestroy(Request $request, int $id)
    {
        $o = DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('id', $id)->first() ?? abort(404);
        $d = $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255']]);
        DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('id', $id)->delete();
        AuditLoggerService::log('Macro Observation Deleted', 'macro_statistics_data', $id, ['old_values' => (array) $o, 'meta' => ['user' => $request->user()->id, 'reason' => $d['reason']]]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Observation deleted; the reason and the old value are in the audit log.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ your own CSV

    /**
     * A CSV of any variable the system holds, in the export's own layout:
     * series_code, period, value, is_forecast, source, published_at. Writes
     * nothing; the rows come back grouped by variable for the person to see.
     */
    public function csvPreview(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate(['file' => ['required', 'file', 'max:5120']]);
        $fh = fopen($request->file('file')->getRealPath(), 'r');
        $bom = "\xEF\xBB\xBF";
        $head = array_map(fn ($h) => strtolower(trim(str_replace($bom, '', (string) $h))), fgetcsv($fh) ?: []);
        foreach (['series_code', 'period', 'value'] as $need) {
            if (! in_array($need, $head, true)) {
                fclose($fh);

                return response()->json(['error' => "The file needs a column named {$need}. Download the sample for the layout."], 422);
            }
        }
        $codes = DB::table('macro_statistics')->pluck('statistic_code')->all();
        $groups = [];
        $errors = [];
        $line = 1;
        while (($row = fgetcsv($fh)) !== false) {
            $line++;
            if (count(array_filter($row, fn ($v) => trim((string) $v) !== '')) === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $r = [];
            foreach ($head as $i => $h) {
                $r[$h] = trim((string) ($row[$i] ?? ''));
            }
            $code = strtoupper($r['series_code']);
            $periodText = preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $r['period']) ? $r['period'] . '-01' : (preg_match('/^\d{4}$/', $r['period']) ? $r['period'] . '-12-01' : $r['period']);
            $ts = strtotime($periodText);
            $value = str_replace([',', '%'], '', $r['value']);
            if (! in_array($code, $codes, true)) {
                $errors[] = "Line {$line}: {$code} is not a variable; add it on Variables first.";
                continue;
            }
            if ($ts === false || ! is_numeric($value)) {
                $errors[] = "Line {$line}: the period or the value cannot be read.";
                continue;
            }
            $forecast = in_array(strtolower($r['is_forecast'] ?? ''), ['1', 'yes', 'true', 'forecast', 'y'], true);
            $pub = $r['published_at'] ?? '';
            $groups[$code][] = ['period' => date('Y-m-t', $ts), 'year' => (int) date('Y', $ts), 'value' => (float) $value, 'value_type' => $forecast ? 'forecast' : 'actual',
                'published_at' => $pub !== '' && strtotime($pub) ? date('Y-m-d', strtotime($pub)) : null, 'source' => ($r['source'] ?? '') !== '' ? $r['source'] : null];
        }
        fclose($fh);
        $previews = [];
        foreach ($groups as $code => $rows) {
            usort($rows, fn ($a, $b) => strcmp($a['period'], $b['period']));
            $previews[] = ['series_code' => $code, 'indicator_code' => null, 'country' => 'MWI', 'source' => $rows[0]['source'] ?? 'CSV import',
                'address' => $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalName(), 'fetched_at' => now()->toDateTimeString(), 'rows' => $rows];
        }

        return response()->json(['previews' => $previews, 'errors' => array_slice($errors, 0, 50), 'error_count' => count($errors), 'rows' => array_sum(array_map(fn ($p) => count($p['rows']), $previews))]);
    }

    public function csvCommit(Request $request, MacroImportService $importer)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['previews' => ['required', 'array'], 'note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255']]);
        $done = [];
        try {
            foreach ($data['previews'] as $p) {
                $r = $importer->commit($p, $request->user()->id, 'manual', null, $data['note'] ?? 'CSV import');
                // the publisher's release date of each row (FLI module D-F10)
                $sid = DB::table('macro_statistics')->where('statistic_code', $p['series_code'])->value('id');
                foreach ($p['rows'] as $row) {
                    if (! empty($row['published_at'])) {
                        DB::table('macro_statistics_data')->where('macro_stat_definition_id', $sid)->where('period', $row['period'])->update(['published_at' => $row['published_at']]);
                    }
                }
                $done[] = "{$p['series_code']} batch {$r['batch_id']} ({$r['new']} new, {$r['updated']} updated)";
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', 'Imported: ' . implode('; ', $done) . '.');
    }

    /**

    private function assumptions(string $period): array

        $sets = [];
        $service = app(ScenarioSetService::class);
        foreach (DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('reporting_period', $period)->orderByDesc('version')->get() as $set) {
            try {
                $paths = $service->paths((int) $set->id);
            } catch (Throwable) {
                $paths = ['base' => [], 'scenarios' => [], 'base_source' => []];
            }
            $scenarios = DB::table('governed_scenarios')->where('set_id', $set->id)->orderBy('order_position')->get()->map(function ($sc) use ($paths) {
                $shocks = DB::table('scenario_shocks')->where('scenario_id', $sc->id)->orderBy('statistic_code')->orderBy('year_offset')->get(['statistic_code', 'year_offset', 'kind', 'value', 'note']);

                return ['id' => (int) $sc->id, 'name' => $sc->name, 'weight' => (float) $sc->weight, 'is_base' => (bool) $sc->is_base, 'anchored_to' => $sc->anchored_to,
                    'calibration_note' => $sc->calibration_note, 'shocks' => $shocks, 'path' => $paths['scenarios'][$sc->name]['path'] ?? []];
            });
            $sets[] = ['id' => (int) $set->id, 'name' => $set->name, 'version' => (int) $set->version, 'status' => $set->status, 'proposed_by' => $set->proposed_by,
                'editable' => in_array($set->status, ['DRAFT', 'PROPOSED'], true), 'base' => $paths['base'], 'base_source' => $paths['base_source'], 'scenarios' => $scenarios];
        }

        return ['period' => $period, 'periods' => $periods, 'year' => $period !== '' ? (int) substr($period, 0, 4) : null, 'sets' => $sets,
            'variables' => DB::table('macro_statistics')->orderBy('statistic_code')->get(['statistic_code', 'statistic_name', 'unit'])];
    }

    /** Replace one scenario's shocks (and optionally its weight) on a set that is not approved yet. */
    public function assumptionSave(Request $request, int $set, ScenarioSetService $service)

        }

        return back()->with($v['ok'] ? 'success' : 'warning', 'Assumptions saved.' . ($v['ok'] ? '' : ' The set cannot be proposed yet: ' . implode('; ', $v['problems'])));
    }

    public function show(string $kind)
    {
        [$headers, $file] = match ($kind) {
            'credit-loss-data' => [$this->creditLossHeaders(), 'credit_loss_data_sample.csv'],
            'sicr-groups' => [['name', 'description'], 'sicr_groups_sample.csv'],
            'sicr-items' => [['group', 'name', 'active', 'stage', 'description', 'evidence_required', 'standard_reference'], 'sicr_items_sample.csv'],
            'rbm-policy-rate' => [['date', 'rate'], 'rbm_policy_rate_sample.csv'],
            'imf-weo' => [null, 'imf_weo_sample.tsv'],
            default => abort(404),
        };

        if ($kind === 'imf-weo') {
            return response($this->imfWeoSample(), 200, [
                'Content-Type' => 'text/tab-separated-values; charset=UTF-8',
                'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="' . $file . '"',
                'Cache-Control' => 'no-store',
            ]);
        }

        return response(implode(',', $headers) . "\r\n", 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
            'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="' . $file . '"',
            'Cache-Control' => 'no-store',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * period, then for each definition the first alias the importer accepts
     * (the one written with underscores, which is what a heading slugs to),
     * then source and notes.
     */
    private function creditLossHeaders(): array
    {

    /**
     * The aliases CreditLossDataImport accepts for each definition code, read
     * from the importer itself so the screen and the sample never drift from it.
     *
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    public static function creditLossAliases(): array
    {
        $class = new ReflectionClass(CreditLossDataImport::class);
        $importer = $class->newInstanceWithoutConstructor();
        $method = $class->getMethod('getAliasesForDefinition');
        $method->setAccessible(true);

        return CreditLossDefinition::orderBy('id')->pluck('code')
            ->mapWithKeys(fn ($code) => [$code => array_values($method->invoke($importer, $code))])
            ->all();
    }
}

    saveValue() {
      const f = this.valForm
      const done = { preserveScroll: true, onSuccess: () => { this.valForm = null; this.go() } }
      if (f.id) router.put(route('macro-statistics.observations.update', f.id), { value: f.value, is_forecast: f.is_forecast, published_at: f.published_at || null, reason: f.reason }, done)
      else router.post(route('macro-statistics.manual'), { series_code: this.current.code, period: f.period, value: f.value, is_forecast: f.is_forecast, published_at: f.published_at || null, reason: f.reason }, done)
    },
    async deleteValue(o) {
      const reason = await promptReason({ title: 'Delete this value?', message: `${this.current ? this.current.code : ''} for ${String(o.period).slice(0, 10)}: ${o.value}. The old value is kept in the audit log.`, label: 'Why it is deleted', confirmLabel: 'Delete', tone: 'danger' })
      if (reason) router.delete(route('macro-statistics.observations.destroy', o.id), { data: { reason }, preserveScroll: true, onSuccess: () => this.go() })
    },
    // assumptions
    edit(set, sc) {
      const k = set.id + ':' + sc.id
      if (!this.edits[k]) this.edits[k] = { weight: sc.weight, shocks: (sc.shocks || []).map(s => ({ statistic_code: s.statistic_code, year_offset: Number(s.year_offset), kind: s.kind, value: Number(s.value), note: s.note || '' })) }
      return this.edits[k]
    },
    shocked(set, sh) {
      const b = (set.base[sh.statistic_code] || [])[sh.year_offset]
      if (sh.kind === 'replace') return sh.value
      if (b === null || b === undefined) return null
      return sh.kind === 'pct' ? b * (1 + Number(sh.value) / 100) : b + Number(sh.value)
    },
    saveScenario(set, sc) {
      const e = this.edit(set, sc)
      router.post(route('macro-statistics.assumptions.save', set.id), { scenario_id: sc.id, weight: e.weight, shocks: e.shocks }, { preserveScroll: true, onSuccess: () => this.goAssumptions() })
    },

    xsrf() { const m = document.cookie.match(/XSRF-TOKEN=([^;]+)/); return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '' },
    async previewOwn() {
      this.previewError = null; this.previewData = null; this.ownPreview = null
      const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('file', this.own.file)
      const res = await fetch(route('macro-statistics.csv-preview'), { method: 'POST', body: fd, credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'X-XSRF-TOKEN': this.xsrf(), Accept: 'application/json' } })
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'The file could not be read.' }))
      if (!res.ok || data.error) { this.previewError = data.error || (data.message || 'Preview failed'); return }
      this.ownPreview = data
    },
    commitOwn() { router.post(route('macro-statistics.csv-commit'), { previews: this.ownPreview.previews }, { preserveScroll: true, onSuccess: () => { this.ownPreview = null } }) },
    async preview(source, form) {
      this.previewError = null; this.previewData = null; this.ownPreview = null; this.previewSource = source
      const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('source', source)
      Object.entries(form).forEach(([k, v]) => { if (v !== null && v !== '' && v !== undefined) fd.append(k, v) })
      const res = await fetch(route('macro-statistics.preview'), { method: 'POST', body: fd, credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'X-XSRF-TOKEN': this.xsrf(), Accept: 'application/json' } })
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'The preview could not be read.' }))
      if (!res.ok || data.error) { this.previewError = data.error || 'Preview failed'; return }
      this.previewData = data
    },
    commit() { router.post(route('macro-statistics.commit'), { preview: this.previewData, source: this.previewSource }, { preserveScroll: true, onSuccess: () => { this.previewData = null } }) },
  },
}

    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $recent = $this->runner->recent(40);
        $history = $this->historyWithBootstrapMarker($recent);

        return Inertia::render('Admin/Maintenance', [
            'catalog' => $this->catalog(),
            'recent'  => $history,
            'summary' => $this->summary($history),
            'status'  => $this->datasetStatus($recent),
            // The console is visible to anyone with 'manage settings', but the
            // run route additionally requires super-admin. Without this flag the
            // page offered enabled Run buttons on destructive rebuilds to users
            // the route would then refuse, and the refusal surfaced as a generic
            // "Request failed". Mirrors HealthcheckController::bootstrapEligible.
            'can' => ['run' => (bool) $request->user()?->hasRole('super-admin')],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * The full bootstrap can run in a terminal and wipes the database. The
     * durable profile stamp is therefore the only reliable record of its latest
     * successful completion. Surface it in History without claiming an output
     * log exists, and avoid duplicating a matching console run.
     *
     * @param array<int,array<string,mixed>> $recent
     * @return array<int,array<string,mixed>>
     */
    private function historyWithBootstrapMarker(array $recent): array
    {
285 resources/js/Pages/Admin/Maintenance.vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, reactive, computed, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue'
import { Link } from '@inertiajs/vue3'
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import ZnbsPageHeader from '@/Components/ZnbsPageHeader.vue'
import MaintenanceTabs, { type TabDef } from '@/Components/Maintenance/MaintenanceTabs.vue'
import MaintenanceCommandCard, { type CatalogItem } from '@/Components/Maintenance/MaintenanceCommandCard.vue'
import RunSummaryCards from '@/Components/Maintenance/RunSummaryCards.vue'
import RunHistoryTable, { type RunRow } from '@/Components/Maintenance/RunHistoryTable.vue'
import CommandOutputDrawer, { type ActiveRun } from '@/Components/Maintenance/CommandOutputDrawer.vue'
import ConfirmModal from '@/Components/Maintenance/ConfirmModal.vue'
import SafetyNotice from '@/Components/Maintenance/SafetyNotice.vue'
import MaintenanceIcon from '@/Components/Maintenance/MaintenanceIcon.vue'

interface Summary {
  runs_today: number; successful: number; failed: number; total: number
  last_destructive?: { label: string; at: string | null; status: string } | null
  last_macro?: { at: string | null; status: string } | null
}
interface DatasetStatus {
  real_loaded: boolean; statements: number; database: string | null
  last_bootstrap: string | null; last_macro: string | null
  last_failed?: { label: string; at: string | null } | null
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{ catalog: CatalogItem[]; recent: RunRow[]; summary: Summary; status: DatasetStatus; can?: { run: boolean } }>(),
  { can: () => ({ run: false }) },
)
// Running a command needs super-admin, which is a stricter gate than the one
// that lets a user open this page. Every Run control reads this flag.
const mayRun = computed(() => !!props.can?.run)

const activeTab = ref('overview')
const tabs = computed<TabDef[]>(() => [
  { id: 'overview',  label: 'Overview',         icon: 'grid' },
  { id: 'real',      label: 'Real ZNBS Data',    icon: 'database' },
  { id: 'imports',   label: 'Imports',           icon: 'globe' },
  { id: 'diagnostics', label: 'Diagnostics',     icon: 'doc' },
  { id: 'history',   label: 'Run History',       icon: 'history', count: props.recent.length },
  { id: 'safety',    label: 'Safety Notes',      icon: 'shield' },
])

const byGroup = (g: string) => props.catalog.filter(c => c.group === g)
const lastRunFor = (item: CatalogItem) => props.recent.find(r => r.label === item.label) ?? null

// ── Run execution ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const running = ref(false)
const drawerOpen = ref(false)
const activeRun = ref<ActiveRun | null>(null)
const pending = reactive<{ item: CatalogItem | null; confirm: string }>({ item: null, confirm: '' })
const modalOpen = ref(false)
let pollTimer: number | null = null

function xsrf(): string {
  const m = document.cookie.match(/XSRF-TOKEN=([^;]+)/)
  return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : ''
}

function onCardRun(payload: { item: CatalogItem; confirm: string }) {
  if (payload.item.danger === 'destructive') {
    pending.item = payload.item
    pending.confirm = payload.confirm
    modalOpen.value = true
    return
  }
  execute(payload.item, payload.confirm)
}

function confirmModal() {
  modalOpen.value = false
  if (pending.item) execute(pending.item, pending.confirm)
}

async function execute(item: CatalogItem, confirm: string) {
  running.value = true
  drawerOpen.value = true
  activeRun.value = { id: '', label: item.label, command: item.command, status: 'running', exit_code: null, output: 'Launching…' }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(route('maintenance.run'), {

<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Throwable;

/**
 * The Maintenance console's consolidated jobs: each runs its steps in order,
 * prints each step's output, and stops at the first step that fails, naming
 * it. The single steps remain artisan commands of their own.
 *
 *   php artisan maiic:task update                      migrate, then the permission, governance and SICR seeders
 *   php artisan maiic:task month-end 2026-08 --user=1  stage, PD and LGD, forward-looking route and ECL and record, EIR revenue, Mega Farm
 *   php artisan maiic:task refresh-data                World Bank macro series, then the E-Banker feed folder
 *   php artisan maiic:task health-check                system snapshot, migration status, golden numbers, report smoke test
 */
class MaintenanceTask extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'maiic:task {task : update|month-end|refresh-data|health-check} {period? : YYYY-MM, for month-end} {--user=}';

    protected $description = 'Run one of the Maintenance console jobs: its steps in order, stopping at the first that fails';

    public function handle(): int
    {
        $task = (string) $this->argument('task');
        $period = (string) ($this->argument('period') ?? '');
        $user = (string) ($this->option('user') ?? '');
        if ($task === 'month-end' && ! preg_match('/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/', $period)) {
            $this->error('The month-end needs a month, YYYY-MM.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        $u = $user !== '' ? ['--user' => $user] : [];
        $steps = match ($task) {
            'update' => [
                ['Database update', 'migrate', ['--force' => true]],
                ['Permissions', 'db:seed', ['--class' => 'MaiicAdminPermissionsSeeder', '--force' => true]],
                ['Governance Centre defaults (additive)', 'db:seed', ['--class' => 'GovernanceSettingsSeeder', '--force' => true]],
                ['Qualitative SICR factors (additive)', 'db:seed', ['--class' => 'SicrQualitativeFactorsSeeder', '--force' => true]],
            ],
            'month-end' => [
                ['Stage the book', 'eir:stage', ['period' => $period] + $u],
                ['PD and LGD by segment', 'ifrs9:segment-parameters', ['period' => $period] + $u],
                ['Forward-looking route, projection, ECL and the month record', 'fli:month-end', ['period' => $period, '--all' => true] + $u],
                ['EIR revenue', 'eir:run-revenue', ['period' => $period] + $u],
                ['Mega Farm programme', 'megafarm:ecl', ['period' => $period] + $u],
            ],
            'refresh-data' => [
                ['World Bank macro series', 'macro:import-worldbank', []],
                ['E-Banker packs in the feed folder', 'eir:poll-feed-folder', []],
            ],
            'health-check' => [
                ['System snapshot', 'about', []],
                ['Database update status', 'migrate:status', []],
                ['Golden numbers and acceptance ties', 'eir:baselines', []],
                ['Every report and its PDF', 'ifrs9:smoke-reports', []],
            ],
            default => null,
        };
        if ($steps === null) {
            $this->error("Unknown job {$task}.");

            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        $n = count($steps);
        foreach ($steps as $i => [$label, $command, $args]) {
            $this->line('');
            $this->line(sprintf('<info>Step %d of %d: %s</info>  (php artisan %s)', $i + 1, $n, $label, $command));
            try {
                $code = Artisan::call($command, $args);
                $this->output->write(Artisan::output());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $code = 1;
                $this->error($e->getMessage());
            }
            if ($code !== 0) {
                $this->error("Stopped at step " . ($i + 1) . " ({$label}). Correct what it names and run the job again; the steps before it are done.");

                return self::FAILURE;
            }
        }
        $this->line('');
        $this->info("All {$n} steps done.");

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}

    public function lock(Request $request, int $set, ScenarioSetService $service)

    {

    private function act(callable $fn, string $ok)
    {
        try {

            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', $ok);
    }

    private function service(): FliRouteService
    {
        $gov = new GovernanceService();

        return new FliRouteService($gov, new TransmissionMethodCatalogue($gov), new ScenarioSetService($gov));
    }

    private function approvedSet(string $period = '2026-08'): int
    {
        $sets = new ScenarioSetService(new GovernanceService());
        $id = $sets->create($period, 'Test set', [
            ['name' => 'Base', 'weight' => 50, 'is_base' => true, 'pd_multiplier' => 1, 'calibration_note' => 'base'],
            ['name' => 'Up', 'weight' => 25, 'pd_multiplier' => 0.9, 'calibration_note' => 'up', 'shocks' => [['statistic_code' => 'PLR', 'kind' => 'abs', 'value' => -5]]],
            ['name' => 'Down', 'weight' => 25, 'pd_multiplier' => 1.2, 'calibration_note' => 'down', 'shocks' => [['statistic_code' => 'PLR', 'kind' => 'abs', 'value' => 5]]],
        ], 1);
        $sets->propose($id, 1);
        $sets->approve($id, 2);

        return $id;
    }

    public function test_a_declined_fit_cannot_be_proposed_and_approval_needs_a_second_person(): void
    {
        try {
            $this->service()->proposeFit(11, 1);
            $this->fail('a declined fit was proposed');
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('declined by the guardrail', $e->getMessage());
        }
        $this->service()->proposeFit(10, 1);
        try {
            $this->service()->approveFit(10, 1);
            $this->fail('the proposer approved their own fit');
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('different person', $e->getMessage());
        }
        $this->service()->approveFit(10, 2);
        $this->assertSame('APPROVED', DB::table('fli_fits')->where('id', 10)->value('approval_status'));
        $this->assertSame(10, (int) $this->service()->approvedFit('2026-08')->id);
    }

    public function test_the_approved_fit_runs_once_per_scenario_and_the_loan_carries_its_lineage(): void
    {
        $setId = $this->approvedSet();
        $this->service()->proposeFit(10, 1);
        $this->service()->approveFit(10, 2);
        $r = $this->service()->apply('2026-08', 1);
        $this->assertSame(10, $r['fit']);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(0.0, $r['scenarios']['Base']['adjustment'], 1e-6);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(0.35 / 0.30 - 1, $r['scenarios']['Down']['adjustment'], 1e-6);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(0.25 / 0.30 - 1, $r['scenarios']['Up']['adjustment'], 1e-6);
        $a = DB::table('loan_books')->where('contract_id', 'A')->first();
        $expected = 0.5 * 0.30 + 0.25 * 0.30 * (0.25 / 0.30) + 0.25 * 0.30 * (0.35 / 0.30);   // weighted PD across scenarios under the scalar
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta($expected, (float) $a->pd_post_fli, 1e-6);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta($expected / 0.30 - 1, (float) $a->fli_adj, 1e-6);
        $this->assertSame('Regression', $a->fli_route);
        $this->assertSame(TransmissionMethodCatalogue::SCALAR, $a->fli_method);
        $this->assertSame(10, (int) $a->fli_fit_id);
        $this->assertSame($setId, (int) $a->fli_set_id);
        $this->assertCount(3, json_decode($a->fli_by_scenario, true));
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(1.0, (float) DB::table('loan_books')->where('contract_id', 'B')->value('pd_post_fli'), 1e-9); // Stage 3 at 100 percent
        $this->assertSame(1, $r['adjusted']); // the scalar is linear: symmetric shocks weight back to the pre-FLI PD, so only the Stage 3 loan moved
    }

    public function test_with_no_approved_fit_the_pd_holds_and_the_loan_says_so(): void
    {
        $this->approvedSet();
        $r = $this->service()->apply('2026-08', 1);
        $this->assertNull($r['fit']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('manual overlay at zero', $r['note']);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(0.30, (float) DB::table('loan_books')->where('contract_id', 'A')->value('pd_post_fli'), 1e-9);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(0.0, (float) DB::table('loan_books')->where('contract_id', 'A')->value('fli_adj'), 1e-9);
        $this->assertNull(DB::table('loan_books')->where('contract_id', 'A')->value('fli_overlay_ids'));
    }

    /** A change after lock: a new version, the locked one stays attached to the period. */
    public function newVersion(int $setId, string $reason, ?int $userId): int
    {
        $set = DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('id', $setId)->first() ?? throw new RuntimeException("No scenario set {$setId}.");
        $scenarios = [];
        foreach (DB::table('governed_scenarios')->where('set_id', $setId)->orderBy('order_position')->get() as $s) {
            $scenarios[] = (array) $s + ['shocks' => DB::table('scenario_shocks')->where('scenario_id', $s->id)->get()->map(fn ($x) => (array) $x)->all()];
        }
        $newId = $this->create($set->reporting_period, $set->name, $scenarios, $userId, $set->narrative, $set->source_vintage);
        DB::table('governed_scenario_sets')->where('id', $newId)->update(['supersedes_id' => $setId, 'version_reason' => $reason]);

        return $newId;
    }

    // ----- the paths, the back-test and the sensitivity ----------------------

    /**
     * The base path per series (annual, from macro_series) and each scenario's
     * shocked path, as at the set's reporting period.
     *
     * Only what was knowable by the end of the period is read (IFRS 9
     * 5.5.17(c), B5.5.49 to B5.5.51; AsAtSeries says when a row becomes
     * knowable): an actual dated on or before the period, a forecast whose
     * vintage is dated on or before it. Year offset o is the calendar year of
     * the period plus o, valued at the latest knowable observation in that
     * year. Where no value of that year is knowable (no published forecast
     * held), the latest knowable value is carried forward and the path says
     * so in base_source, so the no-change assumption is visible on the set and
     * in the route's result, never silent.
     */
    public function paths(int $setId): array

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\FLI;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Permission;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * External Calculations and Calculation History (FLI module specification
 * v1). The older one-slope endpoints that wrote fli_adj straight onto the
 * loans (audit finding M6) are gone; an externally calibrated model is
 * proposed here and reaches the loans only as an approved model version.
 */
class ExternalCalculationsTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function user(array $permissions = []): User
    {
        $u = User::create(['name' => 'Test User ' . uniqid(), 'email' => uniqid() . '@example.com', 'password' => bcrypt('password'), 'email_verified_at' => now()]);
        foreach ($permissions as $p) {
            Permission::findOrCreate($p, 'web');
        }
        app(PermissionRegistrar::class)->forgetCachedPermissions();
        if ($permissions !== []) {
            $u->givePermissionTo($permissions);
        }

        return $u;
    }

    public function test_the_page_and_the_history_open(): void
    {
        $u = $this->user(['eir.view', 'reports.ifrs9']);
        $this->actingAs($u)->get(route('fli.external.index'))->assertOk()->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page->component('FLI/ExternalCalculations/Index')->has('preview'));
        $this->actingAs($u)->get(route('fli.external.list'))->assertOk()->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page->component('FLI/ExternalCalculations/List')->has('snapshots')->has('events'));
    }

    public function test_the_old_endpoints_that_wrote_onto_the_loans_are_gone(): void
    {
        foreach (['fli.external.save-parameters', 'fli.external.generate', 'fli.external.save', 'fli.external.update-loanbook', 'fli.regression.index'] as $name) {
            $this->assertFalse(app('router')->has($name), "{$name} should no longer exist");
        }
    }

    public function test_proposing_an_external_model_needs_the_governance_permission(): void
    {
        $payload = ['statistic_code' => 'PLR', 'proxy_code' => 'STAGE3_SHARE', 'lag_months' => 9, 'slope' => 0.017, 'intercept' => -0.01,
            'calibrated_period' => '2026-08', 'effective_from' => '2026-09', 'evidence' => 'validation workbook'];
        $this->actingAs($this->user(['eir.view']))->post(route('fli.external.propose'), $payload)->assertForbidden();
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('fli_model_versions')->count());
    }
}

The seven screens moved to Administration as "Legacy FLI tools" on 9 October
are back under a Forward-Looking Information menu entry, without the legacy

specification v1, docs/MAIIC_FLI_Module_Specification_v1_2026-10-13.md):

- Overview: the ten month-end steps with their state, run buttons (background

  movement, a proposed set measured before approval, loan drill-down.

  them; External Calculations proposes an externally calibrated model under
  maker-checker. The old endpoints that wrote fli_adj onto loans are removed.
- Per-scenario ECL and run snapshot (D-F3, D-F11): fli:month-end --close
  records every loan's ECL under each scenario and checks the weighted figure
  against the booked one (August 2026 ties to 0.60 kwacha).
- Scenario projection (D-F4): Adjusted Forecast shows each portfolio's PD
  term structure per scenario over the governed horizon with reversion.
- Vintages (D-F10): a publisher release date on macro and credit-loss rows;
  the as-at reader honours it. External credit-loss series (D-F7) reach the
  correlation sweep as EXT_ measures.
- Overlay double-count check (D-F9), Weighted Forecast and Scenario Profiles
  on the governed sets, Economic Scenarios as a workbench.
- Macro Statistics: add, edit and delete variables and values, your own CSV
  import (with sample), an assumptions editor with weights, new version and
  discard draft; import moved into a window.
- Maintenance: fifteen commands consolidated into seven jobs (maiic:task).
- Three Governance Centre settings: model cadence, forecast horizon, movement
  commentary tolerance.

Booked ECL for August 2026 unchanged at 11,314,579,806.97 after a full
month-end run from the console.
