### 3.1 Interest is charged for the whole calendar month at one rate

Every month-end interest posting carries a narration of the form "To Trf IntDR Fm 01-JUN-25 To 30-JUN-25 @ 32.65%". Reading all 2,047 of them:

- The period runs from the 1st to the month-end in every ordinary month (299 of the 303 months that had a rate change inside them; the other four are drawdown months). The period is never split at the date the rate changed.
- Where the daily accrual exists, its daily amount is constant through the month and the month-end posting equals the sum of the daily rows to the cent.
- The amount is the previous month-end balance, including interest already capitalised, times the rate, times the days in the month, over 365. Rebuilt this way, 1,595 of 2,047 postings agree within 0.1 percent and 1,828 within 1 percent; the postings that agree within 1 percent are 91.6 percent of the value. The remainder are drawdown months, moratorium months and the 28 year-end adjustments of section 3.4.
- **When the rate changes inside a month, the whole month is charged at the new rate.** In the 229 account-months where the loan-book rate changed from the previous month-end, the narration carries the new rate in 217, the old rate in 2 and neither in 10. A PLR cut on the 20th reduces the whole month's interest. This decides open choice O2 (section 4.2).

### 3.2 The charged rate is the loan book's rate, not the set-up table's

216	    private function yearFraction(CarbonImmutable $from, CarbonImmutable $to, string $basis): float
217	    {
218	        $basis = strtoupper(str_replace([' ', '_'], ['', '/'], $basis));
219	        if (in_array($basis, ['30/360', '30E/360'], true)) {
220	            $days = (($to->year - $from->year) * 360) + (($to->month - $from->month) * 30)
221	                + (min(30, $to->day) - min(30, $from->day));

223	        }

     * keeps its locked rate. A floating-rate loan's EIR moves with the rate E-Banker
     * charged in the month (the loan book's rate, section 3.2 of the specification),
     * keeping the margin the fees add: the nominal EIR is the locked nominal EIR plus

     * loan was lent at is put right: Chipala Investment was lent at 30.0 percent and

    private function eirInForce(ContractEir $contract, object $loan): float
    {
        $locked = (float) $contract->eir_effective_annual;
        $built = (float) ($contract->contractual_rate ?? 0);
        $charged = isset($loan->interest_rate) && is_numeric($loan->interest_rate) ? (float) $loan->interest_rate / 100 : null;

    private function ratesSchema(): void
    {
        Schema::table('contract_eir', function (Blueprint $t) { $t->string('rate_type')->nullable(); $t->double('contractual_rate')->nullable(); });
        Schema::table('loan_books', function (Blueprint $t) { $t->double('interest_rate')->nullable(); $t->string('external_identity_id')->nullable(); });
    }

    public function test_a_floating_rate_loan_accrues_at_the_eir_moved_with_the_rate_charged(): void
    {
        $this->ratesSchema();
        // locked at 12.6825 percent effective (1 percent a month) on a schedule built at 12 percent;
        // E-Banker charged 18 percent in the month, so the EIR moves up six points
        DB::table('contract_eir')->insert(['contract_id' => 'FL', 'eir_effective_annual' => 0.126825, 'rate_type' => 'FLOATING', 'contractual_rate' => 0.12,
            'input_snapshot' => json_encode(['initial_net_investment' => 1000]), 'locked_at' => '2025-01-01', 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
        DB::table('loan_books')->insert(['contract_id' => 'FL', 'reporting_period' => '2025-01', 'calculated_ifrs9_stage' => 1, 'interest_rate' => 18]);

        (new EirRevenueService())->run('FL', '2025-01');
        $row = DB::table('eir_amortisation')->where('contract_id', 'FL')->first();

        $nominal = 12 * (pow(1.126825, 1 / 12) - 1) + 0.06;
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(pow(1 + $nominal / 12, 12) - 1, $row->eir_annual, 1e-6);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(1000 * $nominal / 12, $row->interest_accrued, 0.01);
    }

    public function test_a_fixed_rate_loan_keeps_its_locked_eir(): void
    {
        $this->ratesSchema();
        DB::table('contract_eir')->insert(['contract_id' => 'FX', 'eir_effective_annual' => 0.126825, 'rate_type' => 'FIXED', 'contractual_rate' => 0.12,
            'input_snapshot' => json_encode(['initial_net_investment' => 1000]), 'locked_at' => '2025-01-01', 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
        DB::table('loan_books')->insert(['contract_id' => 'FX', 'reporting_period' => '2025-01', 'calculated_ifrs9_stage' => 1, 'interest_rate' => 18]);

        (new EirRevenueService())->run('FX', '2025-01');

        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(10, DB::table('eir_amortisation')->where('contract_id', 'FX')->value('interest_accrued'), 0.01);
    }

    public function test_arrears_at_the_month_before_are_added_to_the_opening(): void
    {
        $this->ratesSchema();
        Schema::create('audit_logs', function (Blueprint $t) { $t->increments('id'); $t->unsignedBigInteger('user_id')->nullable(); $t->string('action'); $t->string('entity_type')->nullable(); $t->unsignedBigInteger('entity_id')->nullable(); $t->string('scope')->nullable(); $t->string('reporting_period')->nullable(); $t->text('old_values')->nullable(); $t->text('new_values')->nullable(); $t->text('meta')->nullable(); $t->string('ip_address')->nullable(); $t->text('user_agent')->nullable(); $t->timestamps(); });
        DB::table('contract_eir')->insert(['contract_id' => 'AR', 'eir_effective_annual' => 0.126825, 'rate_type' => 'FIXED', 'contractual_rate' => 0.12, 'origination_date' => '2024-06-01',
            'source_day_count_basis' => 'ACT/365', 'input_snapshot' => json_encode(['initial_net_investment' => 1000, 'cash_flows' => [
                ['due_date' => '2025-06-30', 'amount' => 1000],
            ]]), 'locked_at' => '2024-06-01', 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
        $this->loan('AR', '2025-01', 1);
        // the schedule expects about 942.6 owed at 31 December; the ledger owes 1,042.60
        $this->mock(\App\Services\Ebanker\LandingZoneReader::class, fn ($m) => $m->shouldReceive('ledgerByAccount')
            ->andReturn([str_pad('AR', 15, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) => [['payload' => ['TRANSAMT' => '-1042.60']]]]));

        (new EirRevenueService())->run('AR', '2025-01');
        $row = DB::table('eir_amortisation')->where('contract_id', 'AR')->first();

        $this->assertSame('SCHEDULE', $row->opening_basis);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(95, $row->opening_arrears);
        $this->assertLessThan(105, $row->opening_arrears);
        // the schedule and the contractual rate agree, so the opening is the ledger's balance
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(1042.60, $row->opening_gross, 0.5);
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('audit_logs')->where('action', 'EIR Opening Arrears')->count());
    }
}

cd /c/xampp/htdocs/MAICC-IFRS9 && python docs/build-files/spec_render.py docs/MAIIC_EIR_Engine_Specification_v4_2026-10-07.md 2>&1 | tail -1; git add app/Services/Eir/EirRevenueService.php app/Services/Eir/EirGlReconciliationService.php app/Services/Eir/EirAsAtService.php app/Models/EirAmortisation.php app/Models/EirAmortisationHistory.php database/migrations/2026_10_13_160000_eir_amortisation_rate_and_arrears.php tests/Feature/Eir/*.php docs/manuals/technical/06-eir-engine.md docs/MAIIC_EIR_Engine_Specification_v4_2026-10-07.md docs/MAIIC_EIR_Engine_Specification_v4_2026-10-07.docx docs/MAIIC_EIR_Engine_Specification_v4_2026-10-07.pdf && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
EIR: floating-rate loans re-estimated with the rate charged (B5.4.5) and arrears at the opening (spec 6.9)

- D38: a floating-rate loan accrues at the locked nominal EIR moved by the change from the rate its schedule was built on (contract_eir.contractual_rate) to the rate E-Banker charged that month (loan_books.interest_rate); the fee margin is kept; a fixed-rate loan keeps its locked EIR. The floating loans' schedules had been generated at today's rate, not the rate lent at (Chipala: lent at 30.0 percent, schedule at 26.1).
- D39: where the ledger at the end of the month before owes more than the balance the schedule expects (the same flows at the contractual rate) by more than one percent, the difference is booked as arrears and added to the opening, undiscounted, and audit-logged.
- Each row records eir_annual and opening_arrears (migration 2026_10_13_160000); the GL reconciliation's rate effect and EIR as at a date read the rate the month accrued at.
- Demo database at August 2026: amortised cost 11,472.0 million against gross 11,466.2 million (the 21 schedule-basis loans were 479.5 million below, now within 3.2 million); arrears at the opening 363.1 million; EIR revenue shift January to August 2026 -117.7 million.
- Tests: floating re-estimation, fixed rate unchanged, arrears at the opening.
- Spec v4 section 3.10, D38 and D39 and the build plan; Technical Manual 6.9 and 6.12.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

    private function stepLand(string $inputs, int $user): void
    {
        $r = app(PackLandingService::class)->land($inputs, $user, PackLandingService::ROUTE_MANUAL);
        $files = count(array_filter($r['files'] ?? [], fn ($f) => is_array($f) && isset($f['new'])));
        $packGates = array_filter($r['gates']['pack'] ?? [], fn ($g) => is_array($g) && isset($g['result']));
        $this->note('3 land pack', "{$r['status']} (load {$r['load_id']}): {$files} files; gates " . implode(', ', array_map(fn ($name, $g) => "{$name} {$g['result']}" . (isset($g['detail']) ? " ({$g['detail']})" : ''), array_keys($packGates), $packGates))
            . ($r['status'] === 'QUARANTINED' ? ' QUARANTINED: ' . json_encode(array_map(fn ($f) => $f['failures'] ?? [], array_filter($r['gates']['files'] ?? [], fn ($f) => ($f['failures'] ?? []) !== [])) + array_map(fn ($g) => $g['failures'], array_filter($packGates, fn ($g) => $g['result'] === 'FAIL'))) : ''));
        if ($r['status'] === 'QUARANTINED') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('The committed pack did not pass its gates.');
        }
        $takeon = $inputs . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'takeon';
        $original = $this->find($takeon, 'as received');
        $mapping = $this->find($takeon, 'with mapping');
        if ($original && $mapping) {
            $t = app(TakeonLandingService::class)->land($original, $mapping, $user);
            $this->note('4 land take-on', "{$t['status']}: {$t['blocks']} blocks, {$t['lines']} lines; " . json_encode($t['gates']['summary'] ?? []));
        } else {
            $this->note('4 land take-on', 'SKIPPED: workbooks not found under ' . $takeon);
        }
        // the trial balances enter by the same door (spec 6.3; system audit of 9 October 2026, finding M1):
        // one load per file with its hash and gates, the GL lines as raw rows, gl_trial_balance_lines derived
        $tb = $inputs . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'trial-balances' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'monthly';

            $afs = glob($inputs . '/trial-balances/afs-bridge-2025-12/2026-09-10/*.xlsx') ?: [];

                . ($t['failures'] !== [] ? ' QUARANTINED: ' . json_encode($t['failures']) : ''));

### 6.5 The five routes

The printed report is not a route: it enters by method C with no pack, and is the one way in that needs no query. Every route produces the same pack and enters by the same door; the ingester does not know which road a pack came by, and moving from one route to another changes nothing downstream. All five are built and supported, and **MAIIC chooses the route in force at any time**: it is a Governa

| Route | How the pack is produced and delivered | What it needs | Place |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1. Manual pack** | Barry runs the versioned queries in SQL Developer with the RUN 0 settings, zips the CSVs, uploads them on the E-Banker Feed screen; the screen builds the manifest from the files and runs the gates | Nothing new: it is what happened on 7 October, made repeatable | Now. Loads the history (section 6.7) and serves any month until route 2 is in place |
| **2. Scheduled export at MAIIC** | A SQLcl or SQL\*Plus script Dupleix writes, parameterised by period and watermark, run by Windows Task Scheduler on a MAIIC server on the first working day after month-end; it writes the pack to an SFTP folder or a network share; the system's scheduler polls the folder and ingests | A read-only Oracle account for the script; one folder; Barry to install the tas
| **3. Push by API** | The same script posts the pack to an endpoint on the system with an API token over HTTPS; no shared folder | A token, outbound HTTPS from the MAIIC server | The alternative to route 2 where a shared folder is awkward |
| **4. Direct read over the VPN** | The system connects to E-Banker's Oracle database read-only (Laravel's OCI8 driver with the Oracle Instant Client), runs the versioned queries itself on schedule and writes straight into the landing zone; the pack and manifest are generated internally, so the audit trail is identical | Read-only credentials over the VPN already in place (the dictionary query DD_
| **5. Vendor view or API** | Virtual Galaxy exposes a database view or an endpoint carrying the same columns; route 4 reads it | A paid change request to the vendor | Only if route 4 is refused |

Whichever route is in use, the system never writes to E-Banker; the Oracle role is read-only; credentials live in the environment file, not in code; and the extracts carry customer data, so route 2's folder and route 3's endpoint are restricted to the two systems and logged.

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware(['auth', 'permission:eir.view']);
        $this->middleware('permission:eir.govern')->only(['land', 'build', 'approve']);
    }

    public function index(GovernanceService $governance, LoanBookBuildService $build)
    {
        $loads = DB::table('ebanker_loads as l')->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'l.loaded_by')
            ->orderByDesc('l.id')->limit(50)
            ->get(['l.id', 'l.pack_name', 'l.route', 'l.period', 'l.status', 'l.loaded_at', 'l.created_at', 'l.gates', 'l.watermarks', 'l.pack_hash', 'u.name as loaded_by'])
            ->map(function ($l) {
                $gates = json_decode($l->gates ?? '', true) ?? [];
                $files = $gates['files'] ?? [];
                $failed = array_filter($files, fn ($f) => ($f['failures'] ?? []) !== []);
                // the named gates of a pack (accounts in the master, the balance history tie, the month-end rows, ISO dates),
                // and for a single-file load (a trial balance, the take-on workbook) the gates recorded at its top level
                $named = array_filter($gates['pack'] ?? $gates, fn ($g) => is_array($g) && isset($g['result']));
                return [
                    'id' => $l->id, 'pack' => $l->pack_name, 'route' => $l->route, 'period' => $l->period, 'status' => $l->status,
                    'loaded_at' => $l->loaded_at ?? $l->created_at, 'loaded_by' => $l->loaded_by, 'hash' => substr($l->pack_hash, 0, 12),
                    'files' => count($files), 'failed' => count($failed),
                    'failures' => array_map(fn ($name, $f) => ['file' => $name, 'failures' => $f['failures']], array_keys($failed), $failed),
                    'gates' => array_map(fn ($name, $g) => ['gate' => $name, 'level' => $g['level'] ?? null, 'result' => $g['result'], 'detail' => $g['detail'] ?? null, 'failures' => $g['failures'] ?? []], array_keys($named), $named),
                    'accepted_exceptions' => $gates['pack']['accepted_exceptions'] ?? [],
                    'watermarks' => json_decode($l->watermarks ?? '', true) ?? [],
                ];
            });
        $queries = DB::table('ebanker_queries')->orderBy('query_id')->get(['query_id', 'title', 'source_table', 'key_column', 'date_column', 'version', 'incremental']);
        // only rows of landed loads count: a quarantined load keeps its rows but no reader sees them
        $rowsByQuery = DB::table('ebanker_raw_rows')->whereNull('superseded_at')->whereIn('load_id', \App\Services\Ebanker\LandingZoneReader::landedLoadIds())
            ->selectRaw('query_id, count(*) n, max(row_date) last_date')->groupBy('query_id')->get()->keyBy('query_id');
        $builds = DB::table('loan_book_builds as b')->leftJoin('users as r', 'r.id', '=', 'b.requested_by')->leftJoin('users as a', 'a.id', '=', 'b.approved_by')
            ->orderByDesc('b.id')->limit(20)
            ->get(['b.id', 'b.method', 'b.period_from', 'b.period_to', 'b.status', 'b.approver_label', 'b.result', 'b.created_at', 'b.built_at', 'r.name as requested_by', 'a.name as approved_by'])
            ->map(fn ($b) => ['id' => $b->id, 'method' => $b->method, 'from' => $b->period_from, 'to' => $b->period_to, 'status' => $b->status, 'approver' => $b->approved_by ?? $b->approver_label,
                'requested_by' => $b->requested_by, 'created_at' => $b->created_at, 'built_at' => $b->built_at,
                'summary' => collect(json_decode($b->result ?? '', true) ?? [])->map(fn ($p, $period) => ['period' => $period, 'method' => $p['method'] ?? '', 'rows' => $p['rows'] ?? 0, 'flagged' => $p['flagged'] ?? 0, 'changed' => $p['changed'] ?? 0, 'new' => $p['new'] ?? 0])->values()->all()]);
        $periods = DB::table('loan_books')->whereNotNull('build_method')->selectRaw('reporting_period, build_method, count(*) n, sum(build_flag is not null) flagged')->groupBy('reporting_period', 'build_method')->orderBy('reporting_period')->get();
        try {
            $route = $governance->get('ebanker_feed_route');
            $method = $governance->get('loan_book_build_method');
        } catch (Throwable) {
            $route = 'Route 1: manual pack'; $method = 'B: derived from the ledger';
        }

        return Inertia::render('Eir/Feed/Index', [
            'loads' => $loads, 'queries' => $queries->map(fn ($q) => (array) $q + ['rows' => (int) ($rowsByQuery[$q->query_id]->n ?? 0), 'last_date' => $rowsByQuery[$q->query_id]->last_date ?? null]),
            'builds' => $builds, 'periods' => $periods, 'routeInForce' => $route, 'methodInForce' => $method,
            'locks' => DB::table('reporting_period_locks')->orderBy('reporting_period')->pluck('reporting_period'),
            'lastLedgerDate' => (new \App\Services\Ebanker\LandingZoneReader())->lastLedgerDate(),
            'canGovern' => (bool) (auth()->user()?->can('eir.govern') ?? false),
            // the view the section tab opened (config/menu.php) and the count on each tab
            'tab' => in_array(request('tab'), ['loads', 'builds', 'periods', 'queries'], true) ? request('tab') : 'loads',
            'tabCounts' => ['loads' => DB::table('ebanker_loads')->count(), 'builds' => DB::table('loan_book_builds')->count(), 'periods' => $periods->count(), 'queries' => $queries->count()],
        ]);
    }

    /** Route 1: a pack uploaded as a zip of CSV files plus manifest.json. */
    public function land(Request $request, PackLandingService $service)
    {
        $request->validate(['pack' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:zip']]);
        $dir = storage_path('app/ebanker-packs/' . now()->format('Ymd-His') . '-' . substr(md5((string) $request->user()->id), 0, 6));
        mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
        $zip = new \ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($request->file('pack')->getRealPath()) !== true) {
            return back()->with('error', 'The file is not a readable zip.');
        }
        // an entry whose name climbs out of the pack folder is left out and logged (system audit of 9 October 2026, finding M14)
        $extracted = FeedZip::extract($zip, $dir, 'upload');
        $zip->close();
        $packDir = is_file($dir . '/manifest.json') ? $dir : (glob($dir . '/*/manifest.json') ? dirname(glob($dir . '/*/manifest.json')[0]) : null);
        if ($packDir === null) {
            return back()->with('error', 'The zip holds no manifest.json.' . ($extracted['skipped'] !== [] ? ' ' . count($extracted['skipped']) . ' entry name(s) were refused: ' . implode(', ', $extracted['skipped']) : ''));
        }
        try {
            $r = $service->land($packDir, $request->user()->id, PackLandingService::ROUTE_MANUAL);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }
        $note = $extracted['skipped'] !== [] ? ' ' . count($extracted['skipped']) . ' entry name(s) were refused and left out: ' . implode(', ', $extracted['skipped']) . '.' : '';

        return back()->with($r['status'] === 'QUARANTINED' ? 'error' : 'success', "Pack {$r['status']} (load {$r['load_id']}).{$note}");
    }

    /** Propose a build; a second person approves it. */

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\GlTrialBalanceLine;
use App\Services\Ebanker\TrialBalanceLandingService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Finance's monthly trial balance, loaded from the screen (13 October 2026). Until
 * now a trial balance could only be landed with eir:import-trial-balances or the
 * bootstrap. The file goes through the same door: TrialBalanceLandingService lands
 * it with its hash and gates (period known, debits equal credits, the file's own
 * grand total), keeps the GL lines as raw rows in the landing zone and derives
 * gl_trial_balance_lines, which the GL reconciliation and the AFS bridge read.
 * A file already landed is recognised by its hash and not loaded twice.
 */
class EirTrialBalanceController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware(['auth', 'permission:eir.view']);
        $this->middleware('permission:eir.govern')->only(['upload']);
    }

    public function index()
    {
        // the periods held, newest first, one row per period and basis
        $periods = DB::table('gl_trial_balance_lines')
            ->selectRaw('period, basis, COUNT(*) gl_lines, SUM(debit) debit, SUM(credit) credit, MAX(source_file) source_file, MAX(updated_at) updated_at')
            ->groupBy('period', 'basis')->orderByDesc('period')->orderBy('basis')->get()
            ->map(fn ($p) => ['period' => substr((string) $p->period, 0, 7), 'basis' => $p->basis, 'lines' => (int) $p->gl_lines,
                'debit' => (float) $p->debit, 'credit' => (float) $p->credit, 'difference' => round((float) $p->debit - (float) $p->credit, 2),
                'source_file' => $p->source_file, 'updated_at' => $p->updated_at]);

        $loads = DB::table('ebanker_loads as l')->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'l.loaded_by')
            ->where('l.route', TrialBalanceLandingService::ROUTE)->orderByDesc('l.id')->limit(50)
            ->get(['l.id', 'l.pack_name', 'l.period', 'l.status', 'l.gates', 'l.manifest', 'l.loaded_at', 'l.created_at', 'u.name as loaded_by'])
            ->map(function ($l) {
                $gates = json_decode($l->gates ?? '', true) ?? [];
                $m = json_decode($l->manifest ?? '', true) ?? [];

                return ['id' => $l->id, 'file' => $m['file'] ?? preg_replace('/^Trial balance /', '', (string) $l->pack_name), 'period' => $l->period, 'basis' => $m['basis'] ?? null,
                    'status' => $l->status, 'rows' => (int) ($m['rows'] ?? 0), 'loaded_at' => $l->loaded_at ?? $l->created_at, 'loaded_by' => $l->loaded_by,
                    'gates' => collect($gates)->filter(fn ($g) => is_array($g) && isset($g['result']))
                        ->map(fn ($g, $name) => ['gate' => $name, 'result' => $g['result'], 'detail' => $g['detail'] ?? null, 'failures' => $g['failures'] ?? []])->values()->all()];
            });

        $latest = $periods->firstWhere('basis', GlTrialBalanceLine::BASIS_POSTCLOSING);

        return Inertia::render('Eir/TrialBalances/Index', [
            'periods' => $periods->values(),
            'loads' => $loads,
            'summary' => [
                'months' => $periods->where('basis', GlTrialBalanceLine::BASIS_POSTCLOSING)->count(),
                'first' => $periods->where('basis', GlTrialBalanceLine::BASIS_POSTCLOSING)->last()['period'] ?? null,
                'last' => $latest['period'] ?? null,
                'refused' => $loads->where('status', 'QUARANTINED')->count(),
            ],
            'canUpload' => (bool) (auth()->user()?->can('eir.govern') ?? false),
        ]);
    }

    /** One trial balance file, through the landing zone's gates, then the derived GL lines. */
    public function upload(Request $request, TrialBalanceLandingService $service)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'file' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:xls,xlsx', 'max:51200'],
            'basis' => ['required', 'in:' . GlTrialBalanceLine::BASIS_POSTCLOSING . ',' . GlTrialBalanceLine::BASIS_PRECLOSING],
            'period' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m'],
            'sheet' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
        ]);
        $dir = storage_path('app/trial-balances/' . now()->format('Ymd-His'));
        if (! is_dir($dir)) {
            mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
        }
        // keep the file's own name: the importer reads the period from it where the sheet carries no stamp
        $name = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9 ._()-]/', '_', $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalName());
        $path = $request->file('file')->move($dir, $name)->getPathname();

        try {
            $r = $service->landFile($path, $data['basis'], $data['period'] ? $data['period'] . '-01' : null, $data['sheet'] ?: null, $request->user()->id);
            $derived = $r['status'] === 'QUARANTINED' ? null : $service->derive();
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', 'The trial balance could not be read: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }

        if ($r['status'] === 'QUARANTINED') {
            return back()->with('error', "Trial balance refused (load {$r['load_id']}): " . implode('; ', $r['failures']));
        }
        $period = $r['period'] ? substr((string) $r['period'], 0, 7) : 'the month';
        $msg = $r['status'] === 'ALREADY_LANDED'
            ? "This file was already loaded (load {$r['load_id']}); nothing changed."
            : "Trial balance for {$period} loaded (load {$r['load_id']}): {$r['lines']} GL lines, debits " . number_format($r['debit'], 2) . ', credits ' . number_format($r['credit'], 2)
                . '; ' . ($derived['lines'] ?? 0) . ' GL lines now held.';

        return back()->with('success', $msg);
    }
}

````

])

````
    /**
     * gl_trial_balance_lines from the current landed TB_01 rows: one line per
     * period, basis and GL code, the attributes TrialBalanceImportService
     * wrote. A line the zone no longer holds is removed, so the GL side is
     * always exactly the landed files. Idempotent.
     *
     * @return array{lines:int,imported:int,updated:int,removed:int,periods:list<string>}
     */
    public function derive(): array
    {
        $rows = $this->zone->trialBalanceLines();
        if ($rows === []) {
            // nothing landed yet: the GL side is left as it is rather than emptied
            return ['lines' => 0, 'imported' => 0, 'updated' => 0, 'removed' => 0, 'periods' => []];
        }
        $imported = $updated = 0;
        $keep = [];
        $periods = [];
        // the file's own order: by period, basis, then the row in the sheet, so ids follow the print
        uasort($rows, fn ($a, $b) => [$a['payload']['PERIOD'] ?? '', $a['payload']['BASIS'] ?? '', (int) ($a['payload']['ROW'] ?? 0)] <=> [$b['payload']['PERIOD'] ?? '', $b['payload']['BASIS'] ?? '', (int) ($b['payload']['ROW'] ?? 0)]);
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $p = $row['payload'];
            if (empty($p['PERIOD']) || empty($p['GL_CODE'])) {
                continue;
            }
            $attributes = [
                'period' => $p['PERIOD'], 'source_period_stamp' => $p['SOURCE_PERIOD_STAMP'] ?? null,
                'gl_code' => (string) $p['GL_CODE'], 'gl_title' => (string) ($p['GL_TITLE'] ?? ''),
                'debit' => (float) ($p['DEBIT'] ?? 0), 'credit' => (float) ($p['CREDIT'] ?? 0),
                'basis' => (string) ($p['BASIS'] ?? GlTrialBalanceLine::BASIS_POSTCLOSING),
                'source_file' => (string) ($p['SOURCE_FILE'] ?? ''), 'source_sheet' => $p['SOURCE_SHEET'] ?? null,
            ];
            $existing = GlTrialBalanceLine::whereDate('period', $attributes['period'])->where('gl_code', $attributes['gl_code'])->where('basis', $attributes['basis'])->first();
            if ($existing) {
                $existing->update($attributes);
                $updated++;
                $keep[] = $existing->id;
            } else {
                $keep[] = GlTrialBalanceLine::create($attributes)->id;
                $imported++;
            }
            $periods[substr((string) $p['PERIOD'], 0, 7)] = true;
        }
        $removed = GlTrialBalanceLine::whereNotIn('id', array_unique($keep))->delete();

        return ['lines' => count($keep), 'imported' => $imported, 'updated' => $updated, 'removed' => (int) $removed, 'periods' => array_keys($periods)];
    }

    /** @return array{result:string,detail:string,failures:list<string>} */

<pasted_content id="88ea">
ngestion works in two layers. E-Banker data comes in as a "pack" of query results through the E-Banker feed. Everything else (Finance workbooks, fees, rates, collateral, economic data) comes in through file-import screens. The menu paths below are from the app's menu config (config/menu.php).

1. The E-Banker feed: five routes in the spec, three built
Every route delivers the same pack of CSVs and goes through the same checks. The route in force is a setting: EIR & Revenue Recognition → Governance Centre → ebanker_feed_route (currently Route 1).

Route	How data arrives	Status	Where you see or do it
1. Manual pack	Barry's query results zipped and uploaded	Built and in use (the 7 and 8 Oct packs)	Customer & Loan Data → Imports & Feeds → E-Banker Loads tab (upload the zip, land it). Then Loan Book Builds (build and approve a month), Periods Built, and Query Register (the versioned queries)
2. Folder at MAIIC	A scheduled script at MAIIC drops the pack into a folder; the system collects it	Built (eir:poll-feed-folder); MAIIC's side not installed	No upload screen. Collected packs appear under E-Banker Loads
3. Push by API	MAIIC's script posts the zip to /api/ebanker-feed/pack with a token	Built; needs the token set up	Same: results show under E-Banker Loads
4. Direct read over the VPN	The system queries E-Banker's Oracle database itself	Not built. The name exists in code, but there's no Oracle connection or query runner	n/a
5. Vendor view or API	Virtual Galaxy, the E-Banker vendor, exposes a view	Not built (also a paid vendor change)	n/a
The spec (section 6.5 and decision D22) says "all five routes are built". The code shows routes 1 to 3 only, so the spec overstates it.

2. Other ingestion screens
What	Menu path
Take-on workbook (amortisation schedules at migration)	Customer & Loan Data → Imports & Feeds → Take-on Blocks (upload, build, confirm per block, fees per block) / Take-on Population
General file imports (template-based, with a log and failed-row download)	Customer & Loan Data → Imports & Feeds → Imports
Loan books (Finance format, or the E-Banker template)	Customer & Loan Data → Loan Book (import buttons on the page)
Clients	Customer & Loan Data → Clients → Import
EIR data intake: contract master, schedules, fees, contract transactions, GL interest, reference rates, drawdowns	No menu entry of its own. Reached from EIR Data → Contract Master ("EIR Data Intake" button), Reference Rates ("Import reference rates"), Drawdowns ("Import drawdowns") and EIR Rules → Fee Classification (fee import). Finance users with fee permission see the fee type only
Collateral register	Collateral Management → Collateral Register → Import
SICR groups and alert items	IFRS 9 Model Setup → Staging & SICR Rules → import on each tab
Economic data	Forward-Looking Information → Macro Statistics → Import / Export (also World Bank download by command)
Credit loss history (for the forward-looking model)	Forward-Looking Information → Forward-Looking Model → Credit Loss Data → Import

## CLAUDE  (2026-10-13 13:58:08 UTC)

The trial balance screen and the spec correction are done and pushed (commit `91f567d`). The updated spec is also copied to OneDrive.

**Trial Balances:** a new tab under EIR & Revenue Recognition → EIR Data.
- Finance uploads the month's E-Banker trial balance from **Upload trial balance** at the top right. The dialog has instructions.
- The file goes through the same checks as the command line: a known month, debits equal to credits, and the report's grand total.
- The tab lists the months held and every load with the result of each check.
- I tested it by uploading April 2025, and it landed cleanly.
- There's a User Manual article for it, and the help button on the tab opens it.

**I also fixed a data-loss bug the screen would have triggered.** Loading any one trial balance deleted every month not loaded through the landing zone. On the demo database that would have wiped the other 19 months. Now a load only replaces the month it carries, and there's a test for it.

**Spec:** sections 6.5 and D22 now say routes 1 to 3 are built and routes 4 and 5 are not. Route 4 needs ICT to agree read-only access over the VPN; route 5 is a paid vendor change. Each route's status is spelled out, along with the new trial balance screen.

**Still running:**

- **The ingestion check:** it's walking every import screen on your list. It opens each screen, checks the dialogs and sample files, and runs the preview steps without committing sample data.

When both finish I'll update the bootstrap, save the demo database to OneDrive, and send you the combined results.

    private function find(string $dir, string $needle): ?string
    {

    private function stepBuild(int $user): string
    {
        $zone = app(LandingZoneReader::class);
        $ends = $zone->runMonthEnds();
        $last = $zone->lastLedgerDate();
        $to = $this->option('to') ?? substr(end($ends) ?: substr((string) $last, 0, 7), 0, 7);
        $from = (string) $this->option('from');
        $build = app(LoanBookBuildService::class);
        $r = $build->build($from, $to, null, null, null, LoanBookBuildService::BOOTSTRAP_LABEL, false, true);
        $rows = array_sum(array_map(fn ($p) => $p['rows'], $r['periods']));
        $flagged = array_sum(array_map(fn ($p) => $p['flagged'], $r['periods']));
        $methods = implode(',', array_unique(array_map(fn ($p) => $p['method'], $r['periods'])));
        $this->note('5a loan books', "{$r['status']} (build {$r['build_id']}): " . count($r['periods']) . " periods {$from}..{$to} by {$methods}, {$rows} rows, {$flagged} flagged");

        try {
            $t = app(TakeonLandingService::class)->build($user);
            $this->note('5b take-on population', "{$t['accounts']} accounts: {$t['recomputed']} recomputed, {$t['takeon_balance']} at take-on balance, {$t['refused']} refused");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->note('5b take-on population', 'SKIPPED: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }

        $inputs = app(ContractInputsBuildService::class);
        $cm = $inputs->contractMaster();
        $this->note('5c contract master', "{$cm['rows']} rows: {$cm['result']['created']} created, {$cm['result']['updated']} updated, {$cm['result']['unchanged']} unchanged, " . count($cm['result']['held']) . ' held, ' . count($cm['result']['skipped']) . ' skipped');
        $rr = $inputs->referenceRates($user);
        $this->note('5d PLR series', "{$rr['rows']} rows: " . ($rr['result']['loaded_rows'] ?? 0) . ' loaded, ' . ($rr['result']['rate_changes'] ?? 0) . ' rate changes');
        $fe = $inputs->fees();
        $this->note('5e fees', "{$fe['rows']} rows: {$fe['result']['loaded_rows']} loaded, {$fe['result']['skipped_rows']} skipped; " . json_encode($fe['result']['totals_by_type'] ?? []));
        // the rulebook suggests each fee's treatment; the bootstrap applies the
        // rule and reviews under its label, leaving a line with no rule PENDING
        // The rulebook suggests; it does not review. Fee Classification is a
        // Governance Centre screen (spec 11.3) and the bootstrap gives no
        // approval there (spec 6.10; audit M8): a suggestion stays a suggestion
        // until a person reviews it, and the rulebook itself suggests nothing
        // until MAIIC approves it.
        $sweep = app(FeeRuleMatcher::class)->sweepPending();
        $this->note('5e fee rulebook', "{$sweep['examined']} examined, {$sweep['matched']} matched an approved rule (suggested, not reviewed: the review is a person's), " . ContractFee::where('classification_status', 'PENDING')->count() . ' PENDING');
        $gi = $inputs->glInterest($from, null);
        $this->note('5f interest posted (ledger)', "{$gi['rows']} account-months: {$gi['result']['loaded_rows']} loaded, {$gi['result']['restated_rows']} restated, total " . number_format($gi['result']['total_posted'], 2));

        $tx = $inputs->actualTransactions();
        $this->note('5f cash movements (ledger)', "{$tx['rows']} postings: " . ($tx['result']['actual_rows_loaded'] ?? json_encode(array_intersect_key($tx['result'], array_flip(['actual_rows_loaded', 'held', 'duplicate_source_rows'])))) . ' actual transactions loaded, ' . count($tx['result']['held'] ?? []) . ' accounts held (not in the loan book)');
        $dd = $inputs->disbursements();
        $this->note('5f drawdowns (ledger)', "{$dd['rows']} type-301 postings: " . json_encode(array_intersect_key($dd['result'], array_flip(['loaded_rows', 'already_stored', 'contracts', 'total_amount']))) . '; facilities drawn in more than one tranche: ' . DB::table('contract_disbursements')->selectRaw('contract_id, count(*) n')->groupBy('contract_id')->havingRaw('count(*) > 1')->get()->count());
        Artisan::call('eir:derive-spreads', ['--user' => $user]);
        $this->note('5g spreads', trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', substr(Artisan::output(), 0, 200))));

        $workflow = app(ScheduleWorkflowService::class);
        $gen = $workflow->generateEligible();
        $approved = 0; $refused = [];
        foreach (ContractEir::query()->whereIn('schedule_approval_status', ['DRAFT', 'PENDING_REVIEW'])->get() as $c) {

                $approved++;

        return $to;

    private function stepEngines(int $user, ?string $to): void
    {
        // 1 macro statistics: live from the World Bank, else the committed snapshot
        Artisan::call('macro:import-worldbank', ['--user' => $user, '--from' => 2000]);
        $out = Artisan::output();
        $this->note('6.1 macro statistics', trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', (string) (preg_match('/(\d+ series fetched live.*?skipped\.)/s', $out, $m) ? $m[1] : substr($out, -200)))));

        $build = app(LoanBookBuildService::class);
        $from = (string) $this->option('from');
        $to ??= $this->option('to') ?? (string) DB::table('loan_books')->whereNotNull('build_method')->max('reporting_period');
        $periods = $build->periods($from, $to);

        // 3 staging first: the revenue roll-forward reads the stage (Stage 3 interest on the net basis)
        $staging = app(StagingService::class);
        $s = ['stage1' => 0, 'stage2' => 0, 'stage3' => 0];
        foreach ($periods as $p) {
            $c = $staging->stage($p, $user);
            foreach ($s as $k => $v) { $s[$k] += $c[$k]; }
        }
        $this->note('6.3 staging', count($periods) . ' periods; row-months by stage ' . json_encode($s));

        // 8-9 EIR before the ECL: the ECL is discounted at it
        $calc = app(EirCalculationService::class);
        $solved = 0; $locked = 0; $failed = [];
        foreach (ContractEir::query()->where('schedule_approval_status', 'APPROVED')->whereNull('locked_at')->get() as $c) {
            try {
                $calc->calculate($c->contract_id, $user);
                $solved++;
                $calc->lock($c->contract_id, $user, true);
                $locked++;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $failed[] = $c->contract_id . ': ' . substr($e->getMessage(), 0, 80);
            }
        }
        $this->note('6.9 EIR solved and locked', "{$solved} solved, {$locked} locked (administrator override under the bootstrap label); " . count($failed) . ' not solved' . ($failed !== [] ? ': ' . implode(' | ', array_slice($failed, 0, 3)) : ''));
        // 4, 5, 7 for every period, pre-FLI: the PD, the LGD and the ECL of each
        // month, so the revenue step that follows nets the opening allowance on
        // Stage 3 (audit C6) and the chain runs from the first full month, not
        // the last (spec 6.10, audit M17). A month without a twelve-month window
        // or a Stage 3 cohort is noted and left without an allowance.

    private function landLaterPacks(string $inputs, int $user): void
    {
        $packs = [];
        foreach (glob($inputs . '/ebanker-pack-*/manifest.json') ?: [] as $m) {

        }
        foreach (glob($inputs . '/packs/ebanker-pack-*.zip') ?: [] as $zipPath) {

            if (isset($packs[$name])) {

            }
            $dir = storage_path('app/bootstrap-packs');
            if (! is_dir($dir . '/' . $name)) {
                if (! is_dir($dir)) {
                    mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
                }
                $zip = new \\ZipArchive();
                if ($zip->open($zipPath) !== true) {
                    throw new \\RuntimeException("The committed pack {$name}.zip is not a readable zip.");

                \\App\\Support\\FeedZip::extract($zip, $dir, 'bootstrap');

            }
            if (is_file($dir . '/' . $name . '/manifest.json')) {
                $packs[$name] = $dir . '/' . $name;
            }
        }
        ksort($packs);
        foreach ($packs as $name => $dir) {

# Bootstrap inputs

The client input files a clean install of MAICC-IFRS9 is bootstrapped from, committed so that a
server builds the whole EIR data foundation without an external file (spec v4, section 6.11).
The committed copy is read first; a OneDrive path is only a local fallback.

|---|---|---|

| `data-dictionary-2026-10-06/` | The 24 data-dictionary results of 6 October 2026 (tables, columns, keys, schemes, codes, row counts, samples) | reference; `DD_09` schemes read for product names |

| `trial-balances/monthly/` | The 20 monthly trial balances, January 2025 to August 2026, as received from Finance | `eir:bootstrap` step 3 (landed as `ebanker_trial_balances`; the GL side of the reconciliation is derived from them) |
| `trial-balances/afs-bridge-2025-12/` | The December 2025 AFS bridge in its two received versions (19 Aug 2026, amounts as text; 10 Sep 2026, amounts numeric, the one that is loaded): final AFS TB, initial TB to the auditor, TB December 2025, final E-Banker TB mapped | step 3; sheet 'Final E-Banker TB Dec 2025' |
| `trial-balances/afs-mapping-2023-to-2026-08/` | Every GL line mapped to its audited-accounts category with year-end balances Dec 2023, Dec 2024, Dec 2025 and Aug 2026 | step 3; the category bridge to the audited accounts (F17) |
| `queries/` | The SQL that produced the pack, version 1 | the E-Banker Feed's query register |
| `manifest.json` | Every file with its query id, row count and SHA-256; the accepted exceptions the gates allow | the gates |

Every file is exactly as received. None is opened or re-saved in Excel. A replacement (for example the
workbook returned by Finance with the fees filled in) is a new file beside the old one and a new manifest
entry; nothing here is edited in place.

## CLAUDE  (2026-10-13 14:07:12 UTC)

The bootstrap test is running into the empty test database, and the ingestion-screen check is still running. Done so far this round:

**Fees file:**
- **Saved in two places.** OneDrive: `2. Documents from clients\New Doc Received 13 Oct\Take-on schedules with mapping - fees completed by MAIIC - received 13 Oct 2026.xlsx`. Repo: the bootstrap's take-on folder. The 7 October copy moved to `takeon/superseded`, and the manifest is updated.
- **Landed through the take-on gates** (load 6). The take-on population was rebuilt, and 73 of the 78 take-on loans now have their EIR recomputed from origination with their fees (280.0m).
- **Not all of them are fit to use yet:**
  - 44 are plausible.
  - 20 need review: 5 to 15 points above the contract rate.
  - 9 are implausible, up to 317%. One of those has no fee at all, so the cause is how the workbook's schedules map to the accounts, not the fees.
  - Tamanda's Y/N account confirmations are still blank.

  So these EIRs aren't locked. Locking needs a second person anyway, and it should wait for her confirmations.

**Slowdown fixed:** the ledger reader no longer decodes the 298k Mega Farm ledger rows on every call. It's down from about 60 seconds to 0.4 seconds for the book and 0.04 seconds per account. All tests pass.

**Bootstrap:**
- A clean install now lands pack 3 (folder) and pack 4 (a 12.4 MB zip; the CSVs are 143 MB) after the original inputs, in date order.
- It also uses the fees workbook.
- The README lists everything and says what isn't loadable yet.

Write-offs reach the system four ways, but **MAIIC's actual write-offs don't come in through any of them correctly**.

## How write-offs get into the system today

| # | Source | How it works | Where you see it | In the demo DB now |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **E-Banker ledger (the feed)** | Any posting of **transaction type 300** is classed as a write-off (`LoanBookBuildService`, `ContractInputsBuildService`, `EirLedgerCashService`). The EIR revenue engine treats it as removing the loan from the books, not as cash received | Lands via **Customer & Loan Data → Imports & Feeds → E-Banker Loads**; shows as "Write-off" in the loan's actual transactions under **EIR & Revenue Recognition → EIR Data → Cash Flows** | **2 postings** (the 2024 type-300 write-offs) |
| 2 | **Worked out, not imported** | The LGD engine and the transition matrices treat a loan that **disappears from the next month's loan book**, without being settled, as written off. The loan book reconciliation report counts loans whose **status contains "write"** | IFRS 9 Model Setup → **PD Model / LGD Model**; Reports → Loan Book Reconciliation | Follows from the loan books |
| 3 | **Old contract import** | A `write_off_date` column in the contract CSV | Contracts page at `/loan-applications/contracts`. **Not in the menu** (it's an older screen) | **0 contracts** have a write-off date |
| 4 | **E-Banker queries registered but not used** | **WO_01** reads E-Banker's write-off table (`LOAN_WRITEOFF_MASTER`), which is **empty** at MAIIC. **GL_05** returns the write-off batches through GLs 1064 and 1876 | Query Register tab | GL_05 received in pack 4 but **not loaded, and no code reads it** |

## Why MAIIC's real write-offs are missed

None of MAIIC's actual write-offs is a type-300 posting:

|---|---|---|
| **Status H loans, 29 Jun 2026** (38,492,032.54 on 20 loans, batch TRF 3) | Posted to the loan accounts as **type 305 "ACCOUNT CLOSURE"**, a repayment type, with the other side in GL 1064 | Counts **38.5m as cash collected** |

| **Status H flag** in the account master | Marks loans written off and closed | Deliberately **not** used as a write-off date (spec 3.8 says to date write-offs from the posting) |

The **write-off classifier** in spec 3.8 (review items R08 and R09) **hasn't been built**. It would:

### 3.8 Status H, and the write-offs of 2026 (added 12 October 2026)

**In plain language.** Twenty-one loan accounts carry the status code H in E-Banker's account master. The status history says they were paid up; the balances say they were not. In June 2026 Finance cleared what they still owed by a transfer into the write-off account, which E-Banker recorded as a repayment. Read at face value, the ledger turns MWK 38.5 million of losses into cash collected. This section sets out the evidence, what H means on it, and the rule the engine follows.

**What the records show.**

| Source | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Account master (`P1_02`) | 21 accounts with STATUS_CODE H, status reason "Paid Up", status dates 11 to 16 December 2025 (17 accounts) and 30 June 2026 (4) |
| Status history (`P3_13`) | No H row at all. Each of the 21 went from A to D "Paid Up" on those dates; the H is set in the master without a history entry |
| Balance history (`P2_09`, `M09_02`) | The balances did not change between December 2025 and May 2026: Lenziemill Milling owed 5,667,578.18, COMSIV 8,318,966.49, Mwachisosa Women Producers 6,676,759.40, and so on. "Paid Up" was not a repayment |
| Ledger (`P1_01`) | On 29 June 2026 one batch, TRF 3, credited MWK 38,492,032.54 to 20 of the accounts, type 305 (the repayment type), narrated "ACCOUNT CLOSURE"; no leg of the batch is on another loan account |
| Trial balance (Finance) | GL 1064 Term Loans Write Offs rose by exactly 38,492,032.54 between May and June 2026 |
| E-Banker manual (section 7.4) | A genuine account closure is posted with batch type ACCLO; this batch was a TRF transfer |
| Finance's loan books | All 21 accounts carry balances in the May 2026 loan book and are nil from June 2026 |

**What H means.** On this evidence H marks an account **written off and closed**. Finance has been asked to confirm (section 5). The other codes, for the record: A active; C closed (15 of the 46 are UAT test accounts); D closed, with the reason in the history (paid up, foreclosure, lapsed); F seen on the accounts whose balance was re-booked to another account (The Food Empire Limited, moved from MAIIC Agricultural to FInES in December 2025 and to a term loan in May 2026, each move a closure credit matched by an equal debit on the next account).

**Three accounts the batch did not settle cleanly.** Imani Investments (000104460000061): the transfer, 1,102,536.37, exceeded what was owed, and the account is **in credit by 861,723.83**. Tac-Maz Investment (000104450000038): 37,291.56 is still owed after the transfer and interest is still charged monthly. Perisha Agro and Packaging (000104450000030): not in the batch; 1,513.12 still owed.

**The write-off account over time.**

| When | GL 1064 movement | What it is | Loans |
|---|---:|---|---|
| 31 August 2024 | 22,286,434.32 | Two write-offs posted as type 300 | Micholess Creameries, Maluso Cooperative |
| January 2026 | 138,135,680.80 | Debit 1064, credit 1876 ECL Write Offs: a memorandum pair; **no loan account moved** | Not identified (asked of Finance, section 5) |
| 29 June 2026 | 38,492,032.54 | TRF 3, type 305 on the loans, debit 1064 | The 20 H accounts above |

The write-off tables of E-Banker (LOAN_WRITEOFF_MASTER, LOAN_WRITEOFF_TRANS) are empty (CT_01), so the GL and the ledger are the only record. Of the three, only the 2024 write-offs carry the write-off transaction type.

**The rule the engine follows.** A credit to a loan account is a **write-off, not a collection**, when any of these holds: its transaction type is 300; it sits in a batch whose other leg is GL 1064 (read from `GL_05`, below, and later from the monthly ledger); or it is narrated "ACCOUNT CLOSURE" in a TRF batch on an account whose status is H. The loan book build (method B) records it as written off; the LGD engine counts the amount as a loss, not a recovery, and does not treat the account as settled; the EIR stops at the write-off date with the written-off amount as derecognition, not cash received; the RBM return shows it as written off. An account in credit after a write-off (Imani) is rep

**What is asked for.** `GL_05` (pack 4, RUN 7): every leg of batch TRF 3 of 29 June 2026, and every posting to 1064 and 1876 in January 2026, in the same shape as `GL_03`. Finance: the confirmation that H means written off, the loans behind the January 2026 entry of 138,135,680.80, and what is to be done about Imani's credit and Tac-Maz's residual.

<?php

namespace App\Services\Ebanker;

/**
 * Which credits to a loan account are write-offs, not collections (specification
 * v4 section 3.8; review items R08 and R09; built 13 October 2026).
 *
 * MAIIC's write-offs are not all posted with the write-off transaction type. On
 * 29 June 2026 batch TRF 3 cleared MWK 38,492,032.54 on 20 status-H loans as type
 * 305 (the repayment type) narrated "ACCOUNT CLOSURE", with the other side debited
 * to GL 1064 Term Loans Write Offs; read at face value the ledger turns the loss
 * into cash collected. A credit to a loan account is therefore a write-off when any
 * of these holds:
 *
 *   1. its transaction type is 300, the write-off type;
 *   2. it sits in a batch (date, batch type, batch number) whose other leg debits
 *      a write-off GL (1064), read from the write-off batch legs (GL_05) and from
 *      any ledger family that carries GL legs;
 *   3. it is narrated "ACCOUNT CLOSURE" in a TRF batch on an account whose status
 *      in the account master is H (written off and closed).
 *
 * A debit is never a write-off; a reversal of a write-off arrives as a debit and is
 * left to the posting's own type. The loan book build (method B), the contract
 * inputs and the EIR's ledger cash all ask this one class, so the three agree.
 */
class WriteOffClassifier
{
    /** GL codes a write-off batch debits. */
    public const WRITE_OFF_GLS = ['1064'];

    /** Query ids that carry GL legs of batches (the write-off legs, and the year-end interest legs). */
    public const GL_LEG_QUERIES = ['GL_05', 'GL_03'];

    private ?array $batches = null;

    private ?array $statusH = null;

    public function __construct(private ?LandingZoneReader $zone = null)
    {
        $this->zone ??= new LandingZoneReader();
    }

    /** The rule that makes a posting a write-off, or null when it is not one. */
    public function rule(array $payload, ?string $rowDate, ?string $account = null): ?string
    {
        $amount = (float) str_replace(',', '', (string) ($payload['TRANSAMT'] ?? 0));
        if ($amount <= 0) {
            return null; // a debit, or nothing: never a write-off
        }
        $type = (string) ($payload['TRANTYPE'] ?? '');
        if (in_array($type, LoanBookBuildService::TYPE_WRITEOFF, true)) {
            return 'type 300';
        }
        $key = self::batchKey($rowDate, $payload);
        if ($key !== null && isset($this->batches()[$key])) {
            return 'batch ' . str_replace('|', ' ', $key) . ' debits GL ' . $this->batches()[$key];
        }
        $narrated = stripos((string) ($payload['PARTICULARS'] ?? ''), 'ACCOUNT CLOSURE') !== false;
        if ($narrated && strtoupper((string) ($payload['BATCH_TYPE'] ?? '')) === 'TRF' && $account !== null && isset($this->statusH()[$account])) {
            return 'ACCOUNT CLOSURE in a TRF batch on a status-H account';
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function isWriteOff(array $payload, ?string $rowDate, ?string $account = null): bool
    {
        return $this->rule($payload, $rowDate, $account) !== null;
    }

    /** The write-off batches: key (date|type|number) => the write-off GL it debits. */
    public function batches(): array
    {
        if ($this->batches !== null) {
            return $this->batches;
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($this->zone->family(self::GL_LEG_QUERIES) as $row) {
            $p = $row['payload'];
            $gl = trim((string) ($p['AC_GLCODE'] ?? ($p['CB_GLCODE'] ?? '')));
            $amount = (float) str_replace(',', '', (string) ($p['TRANSAMT'] ?? 0));
            if (! in_array($gl, self::WRITE_OFF_GLS, true) || $amount >= 0 || ($p['DELETE_FLAG'] ?? 'N') === 'Y') {
                continue; // only a debit to the write-off GL marks the batch
            }
            $key = self::batchKey($row['row_date'], $p);
            if ($key !== null) {
                $out[$key] = $gl;
            }
        }

        return $this->batches = $out;
    }

    /** date|batch type|batch number, the key that ties a batch's legs together. */
    public static function batchKey(?string $rowDate, array $payload): ?string
    {
        $number = trim((string) ($payload['BATCH_NUMBER'] ?? ''));
        if ($rowDate === null || $number === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return substr($rowDate, 0, 10) . '|' . strtoupper(trim((string) ($payload['BATCH_TYPE'] ?? ''))) . '|' . $number;
    }

    /** Accounts whose status in the account master is H. */
    private function statusH(): array
    {
        if ($this->statusH !== null) {
            return $this->statusH;
        }
        $out = [];
        foreach ($this->zone->accountMaster() as $account => $m) {
            if (strtoupper(trim((string) ($m['STATUS_CODE'] ?? ''))) === 'H') {
                $out[$account] = true;
            }
        }

        return $this->statusH = $out;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services\Eir;

use App\Services\AuditLoggerService;
use App\Services\Ebanker\LandingZoneReader;
use App\Services\Ebanker\WriteOffClassifier;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * The governed write-off register (specification v4 section 3.8; built 13 October
 * 2026) and the view of every write-off the system knows of.
 *
 * Two kinds of write-off reach the engines:
 *  - in the ledger: credits the WriteOffClassifier marks (type 300, a batch that
 *    debits GL 1064, an ACCOUNT CLOSURE on a status-H account); they arrive with
 *    the E-Banker pack and need no approval here, because E-Banker's own posting
 *    is the evidence;
 *  - in the register: write-offs that are not on the loan account (MUSECO,
 *    31 December 2025, in the audit's TB-to-AFS mapping and at GL level in
 *    January 2026). One person proposes with the evidence; a different person
 *    approves; on approval the write-off is written to the loan's actual
 *    transactions as a Write-off (source WRITE_OFF_REGISTER), which the EIR
 *    revenue engine treats as derecognition, not cash. A rejected or withdrawn
 *    entry never reaches the engines; reversing an approved one removes its row.
 */
class WriteOffRegisterService
{
    public const SOURCE = 'WRITE_OFF_REGISTER';

    public function propose(array $data, int $userId): int
    {
        $contract = ltrim((string) $data['contract_id'], '0');
        $loan = DB::table('loan_books')->where('contract_id', $contract)->orderByDesc('reporting_period')->first(['customer_name', 'external_identity_id']);
        if (! $loan) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Contract {$contract} is not in the loan book.");
        }
        if ((float) $data['amount'] <= 0) {
            throw new RuntimeException('The amount written off must be more than nil.');
        }
        $open = DB::table('loan_write_offs')->where('contract_id', $contract)->whereIn('status', ['PROPOSED', 'APPROVED'])->exists();
        if ($open) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Contract {$contract} already has a write-off proposed or approved in the register.");
        }
        $id = (int) DB::table('loan_write_offs')->insertGetId([
            'contract_id' => $contract, 'account' => $loan->external_identity_id ?: str_pad($contract, 15, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT), 'customer_name' => $loan->customer_name,
            'write_off_date' => $data['write_off_date'], 'amount' => round((float) $data['amount'], 2), 'reason' => $data['reason'],
            'evidence' => $data['evidence'] ?? null, 'gl_reference' => $data['gl_reference'] ?? null,
            'status' => 'PROPOSED', 'proposed_by' => $userId, 'proposed_at' => now(), 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);
        AuditLoggerService::log('Write-off Proposed', 'loan_write_offs', $id, ['new_values' => ['contract_id' => $contract, 'date' => $data['write_off_date'], 'amount' => $data['amount'], 'reason' => $data['reason']]]);

        return $id;
    }

    /** A different person approves; the write-off then reaches the loan's actual transactions. */
    public function approve(int $id, int $userId, ?string $label = null): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($id, $userId, $label) {
            $w = DB::table('loan_write_offs')->where('id', $id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            if (! $w || $w->status !== 'PROPOSED') {
                throw new RuntimeException('Only a proposed write-off can be approved.');
            }
            if ((int) $w->proposed_by === $userId) {
                throw new RuntimeException('The person who proposed a write-off cannot approve it.');
            }
            \App\Support\ReportingPeriodLock::assertOpen(substr((string) $w->write_off_date, 0, 7), 'a write-off');
            $txId = (int) DB::table('eir_actual_transactions')->insertGetId([
                'contract_id' => $w->contract_id, 'transaction_date' => $w->write_off_date, 'transaction_type' => 'Write-off',
                'principal_component' => 0, 'interest_component' => 0, 'fee_component' => 0, 'total_amount' => $w->amount,
                'source_system' => self::SOURCE, 'external_transaction_id' => 'WOR-' . $w->id,
                'source_reference' => mb_substr('Write-off register #' . $w->id . ': ' . $w->reason, 0, 199),
                'row_note' => $w->evidence, 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
            DB::table('loan_write_offs')->where('id', $id)->update(['status' => 'APPROVED', 'approved_by' => $userId, 'approver_label' => $label,
                'approved_at' => now(), 'transaction_id' => $txId, 'updated_at' => now()]);
            AuditLoggerService::log('Write-off Approved', 'loan_write_offs', $id, ['new_values' => ['contract_id' => $w->contract_id, 'amount' => (float) $w->amount, 'transaction_id' => $txId, 'label' => $label]]);
        });
    }

    /** Reject (a reviewer), withdraw (the proposer) or reverse (an approved entry, with a reason). */
    public function close(int $id, int $userId, string $action, string $reason): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($id, $userId, $action, $reason) {
            $w = DB::table('loan_write_offs')->where('id', $id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            if (! $w) {
                throw new RuntimeException('No such write-off.');
            }
            $status = match ($action) {
                'reject' => $w->status === 'PROPOSED' ? 'REJECTED' : null,
                'withdraw' => $w->status === 'PROPOSED' && (int) $w->proposed_by === $userId ? 'WITHDRAWN' : null,
                'reverse' => $w->status === 'APPROVED' ? 'REVERSED' : null,
                default => null,
            };
            if ($status === null) {
                throw new RuntimeException(match ($action) {
                    'withdraw' => 'Only the person who proposed a write-off can withdraw it, and only before it is approved.',
                    'reverse' => 'Only an approved write-off can be reversed.',
                    default => 'Only a proposed write-off can be rejected.',
                });
            }
            if ($status === 'REVERSED') {
                \App\Support\ReportingPeriodLock::assertOpen(substr((string) $w->write_off_date, 0, 7), 'reversing a write-off');
                DB::table('eir_actual_transactions')->where('id', $w->transaction_id)->where('source_system', self::SOURCE)->delete();
            }
            DB::table('loan_write_offs')->where('id', $id)->update(['status' => $status, 'closed_by' => $userId, 'closed_at' => now(), 'close_reason' => $reason, 'updated_at' => now()]);
            AuditLoggerService::log('Write-off ' . ucfirst(strtolower($status)), 'loan_write_offs', $id, ['new_values' => ['contract_id' => $w->contract_id, 'reason' => $reason]]);
        });
    }

    /** Every write-off the ledger carries, by the classifier's rule, with the loan's name. */
    public function ledgerWriteOffs(?string $toDate = null): array
    {
        $zone = new LandingZoneReader();
        $classifier = new WriteOffClassifier($zone);
        $names = DB::table('loan_books')->orderBy('reporting_period')->pluck('customer_name', 'contract_id')->all();
        $out = [];
        foreach ($zone->ledgerByAccount($toDate) as $account => $posts) {
            foreach ($posts as $p) {
                $rule = $classifier->rule($p['payload'], $p['row_date'], $account);
                if ($rule === null) {
                    continue;
                }
                $contract = ltrim((string) $account, '0');
                $out[] = ['account' => $account, 'contract_id' => $contract, 'customer_name' => $names[$contract] ?? null,
                    'date' => substr((string) $p['row_date'], 0, 10), 'amount' => round((float) str_replace(',', '', (string) $p['payload']['TRANSAMT']), 2),
                    'type' => (string) ($p['payload']['TRANTYPE'] ?? ''), 'batch' => trim(($p['payload']['BATCH_TYPE'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($p['payload']['BATCH_NUMBER'] ?? '')),
                    'narration' => (string) ($p['payload']['PARTICULARS'] ?? ''), 'rule' => $rule];
            }
        }
        usort($out, fn ($a, $b) => [$b['date'], $a['account']] <=> [$a['date'], $b['account']]);

        return $out;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Services\Eir\WriteOffRegisterService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Throwable;

/** Write-offs: those the ledger carries, and the governed register for those it does not (spec v4 s.3.8). */
class EirWriteOffController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->middleware(['auth', 'permission:eir.view']);
        $this->middleware('permission:eir.govern')->except(['index']);
    }

    public function index(WriteOffRegisterService $service)
    {
        $users = DB::table('users')->pluck('name', 'id');
        $register = DB::table('loan_write_offs')->orderByDesc('id')->get()->map(fn ($w) => (array) $w + [
            'proposed_by_name' => $users[$w->proposed_by] ?? null,
            'approved_by_name' => $w->approver_label ?: ($users[$w->approved_by] ?? null),
            'closed_by_name' => $users[$w->closed_by] ?? null,
        ]);
        $ledger = $service->ledgerWriteOffs();

        return Inertia::render('Eir/WriteOffs/Index', [
            'ledger' => $ledger,
            'register' => $register,
            'contracts' => DB::table('loan_books')->select('contract_id', 'customer_name')->distinct()->orderBy('customer_name')->get(),
            'me' => auth()->id(),
            'canGovern' => (bool) (auth()->user()?->can('eir.govern') ?? false),
            'summary' => [
                'ledger_count' => count($ledger), 'ledger_amount' => round(array_sum(array_column($ledger, 'amount')), 2),
                'approved_count' => $register->where('status', 'APPROVED')->count(), 'approved_amount' => round((float) $register->where('status', 'APPROVED')->sum('amount'), 2),
                'proposed' => $register->where('status', 'PROPOSED')->count(),
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request, WriteOffRegisterService $service)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'contract_id' => ['required', 'string', 'max:50'],
            'write_off_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'amount' => ['required', 'numeric', 'gt:0'],
            'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500'],
            'evidence' => ['required', 'string', 'max:2000'],
            'gl_reference' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
        ]);
        try {
            $id = $service->propose($data, $request->user()->id);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', "Write-off #{$id} proposed. A different person approves it before it reaches the engines.");
    }

    public function approve(Request $request, int $id, WriteOffRegisterService $service)
    {
        try {
            $service->approve($id, $request->user()->id);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', "Write-off #{$id} approved: it is on the loan's actual transactions as a write-off; re-run the EIR revenue from its month.");
    }

    public function close(Request $request, int $id, WriteOffRegisterService $service)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['action' => ['required', 'in:reject,withdraw,reverse'], 'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);
        try {
            $service->close($id, $request->user()->id, $data['action'], $data['reason']);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', "Write-off #{$id}: " . ['reject' => 'rejected', 'withdraw' => 'withdrawn', 'reverse' => 'reversed'][$data['action']] . '.');
    }
}

<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/vue3'
import AppLayout from '@/Layouts/AppLayout.vue'
import JetModal from '@/Jetstream/Modal.vue'
import KpiRow from '@/Components/Maiic/KpiRow.vue'
import ClientPager from '@/Components/ClientPager.vue'
import { confirmDialog, promptReason } from '@/Components/Maiic/notice.js'

const props = defineProps({
  ledger: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  register: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  contracts: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  me: { type: Number, default: null },
  canGovern: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  summary: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) },
})

const open = ref(false)
const ledgerPage = ref(1)
const pagedLedger = computed(() => props.ledger.slice((ledgerPage.value - 1) * 15, ledgerPage.value * 15))
const form = useForm({ contract_id: '', write_off_date: '', amount: '', reason: '', evidence: '', gl_reference: '' })

function openPropose() { form.reset(); form.clearErrors(); open.value = true }
function submit() {
  form.post(route('eir-write-offs.store'), { preserveScroll: true, onSuccess: () => { if (!Object.keys(form.errors).length) open.value = false } })
}
async function approve(w) {
  if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: `Approve write-off #${w.id}?`, message: `${w.customer_name}: ${money(w.amount)} on ${w.write_off_date}. It is written to the loan's actual transactions as a write-off.`, confirmLabel: 'Approve' }))) return
  router.post(route('eir-write-offs.approve', w.id), {}, { preserveScroll: true })
}
async function closeIt(w, action) {
  const words = { reject: 'Reject', withdraw: 'Withdraw', reverse: 'Reverse' }
  const reason = await promptReason({ title: `${words[action]} write-off #${w.id}`, message: 'Give the reason; it is kept on the register and in the audit trail.', confirmLabel: words[action] })
  if (!reason) return
  router.post(route('eir-write-offs.close', w.id), { action, reason }, { preserveScroll: true })
}

const cards = computed(() => [
  { label: 'In the ledger', value: Number(props.summary.ledger_count || 0), sub: money(props.summary.ledger_amount) },
  { label: 'Approved in the register', value: Number(props.summary.approved_count || 0), sub: money(props.summary.approved_amount) },
  { label: 'Awaiting approval', value: Number(props.summary.proposed || 0), accent: props.summary.proposed ? '#d97706' : null },
])

const money = (v) => Number(v || 0).toLocaleString('en-GB', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const label = (s) => ({ PROPOSED: 'Proposed', APPROVED: 'Approved', REJECTED: 'Rejected', WITHDRAWN: 'Withdrawn', REVERSED: 'Reversed' }[s] || s)
const badge = (s) => ({ PROPOSED: 'maiic-badge-gold', APPROVED: 'maiic-badge-green', REJECTED: 'maiic-badge-red', WITHDRAWN: 'maiic-badge-grey', REVERSED: 'maiic-badge-grey' }[s] || 'maiic-badge-grey')
</script>

    {
        $c = $this->classifier([$this->leg('2026-06-29', 'TRF', '3', '1064', -38492032.54)]);
        $credit = ['TRANTYPE' => '305', 'TRANSAMT' => '5667578.18', 'BATCH_TYPE' => 'TRF', 'BATCH_NUMBER' => '3', 'PARTICULARS' => 'By Trf ACCOUNT CLOSURE - LENZIE MILL'];

        $this->assertNotNull($c->rule($credit, '2026-06-29', '000104420000007'));
        // the same batch number on another day is another batch
        $this->assertNull($c->rule($credit, '2026-06-30', '000104420000007'));
    }

    public function test_type_300_is_a_write_off_and_an_ordinary_repayment_is_not(): void
    {
        $c = $this->classifier([]);
        $this->assertSame('type 300', $c->rule(['TRANTYPE' => '300', 'TRANSAMT' => '100'], '2024-08-31', 'A'));
        $this->assertNull($c->rule(['TRANTYPE' => '305', 'TRANSAMT' => '100', 'BATCH_TYPE' => 'CSH', 'BATCH_NUMBER' => '7'], '2026-06-29', 'A'));
        // a debit is never a write-off
        $this->assertNull($c->rule(['TRANTYPE' => '300', 'TRANSAMT' => '-100'], '2024-08-31', 'A'));
    }

    public function test_an_account_closure_on_a_status_h_account_is_a_write_off_without_the_gl_leg(): void
    {
        $c = $this->classifier([], ['000104450000038' => ['STATUS_CODE' => 'H']]);
        $credit = ['TRANTYPE' => '305', 'TRANSAMT' => '100', 'BATCH_TYPE' => 'TRF', 'BATCH_NUMBER' => '9', 'PARTICULARS' => 'ACCOUNT CLOSURE'];

        $this->assertNotNull($c->rule($credit, '2026-06-29', '000104450000038'));
        $this->assertNull($c->rule($credit, '2026-06-29', '000104450000099'));
    }

    public function test_a_register_write_off_reaches_the_engines_only_when_a_different_person_approves_it(): void
    {
        $svc = new WriteOffRegisterService();
        $id = $svc->propose(['contract_id' => '000104420000005', 'write_off_date' => '2025-12-31', 'amount' => 138135680.80,
            'reason' => 'Written off in the audit adjustments', 'evidence' => 'TB-to-AFS mapping; GL 1064/1876 batch TRF 26 of 31 Jan 2026'], 1);
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('eir_actual_transactions')->count());

        try {
            $svc->approve($id, 1);
            $this->fail('The proposer approved their own write-off.');
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('cannot approve', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $svc->approve($id, 2);
        $row = DB::table('eir_actual_transactions')->first();
        $this->assertSame('Write-off', $row->transaction_type);
        $this->assertSame(WriteOffRegisterService::SOURCE, $row->source_system);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(138135680.80, $row->total_amount, 0.001);
        $this->assertSame('APPROVED', DB::table('loan_write_offs')->value('status'));

        // a second open write-off for the same loan is refused
        $this->expectException(RuntimeException::class);
        $svc->propose(['contract_id' => '104420000005', 'write_off_date' => '2026-01-31', 'amount' => 1, 'reason' => 'x', 'evidence' => 'y'], 1);
    }

    public function test_reversing_an_approved_write_off_removes_it_from_the_engines(): void
    {
        $svc = new WriteOffRegisterService();
        $id = $svc->propose(['contract_id' => '104420000005', 'write_off_date' => '2025-12-31', 'amount' => 10, 'reason' => 'r', 'evidence' => 'e'], 1);
        $svc->approve($id, 2);
        $svc->close($id, 2, 'reverse', 'Finance confirmed it was not written off');

        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('eir_actual_transactions')->count());
        $this->assertSame('REVERSED', DB::table('loan_write_offs')->value('status'));
    }
}

179	import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3'

182	export default {
183	  components: { AppLayout, LocalPager },
184	  props: { tab: { type: String, default: 'loads' }, tabCounts: Object, loads: Array, queries: Array, builds: Array, periods: Array, routeInForce: String, methodInForce: String, locks: Array, lastLedgerDate: String, canGovern: Boolean },
185	  data() {

187	      open: null, querySearch: '',
188	      page: { loads: 1, builds: 1, periods: 1, queries: 1 },
189	      packFile: null, landing: false, building: false, build: { from: '', to: '', method: '', retire_stale: false },
190	    }
191	  },
192	  computed: {
193	    filteredQueries() {
194	      const s = this.querySearch.trim().toLowerCase()
195	      if (!s) return this.queries
196	      return this.queries.filter(q => [q.query_id, q.title, q.source_table].some(v => String(v || '').toLowerCase().includes(s)))
197	    },
198	  },
199	  methods: {
200	    pageOf(rows, key) { const p = this.page[key]; return rows.slice((p - 1) * 15, p * 15) },
201	    fmt(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString() },
202	    gateCount(l, result) { return (l.gates || []).filter(g => g.result === result).length },
203	    statusBadge(s) { return s === 'LANDED' ? 'maiic-badge-green' : (s === 'QUARANTINED' ? 'maiic-badge-red' : 'maiic-badge-grey') },
204	    landPack() {
205	      if (!this.packFile) return
206	      this.landing = true
207	      router.post(route('eir-feed.land'), { pack: this.packFile }, { forceFormData: true, onFinish: () => { this.landing = false; this.packFile = null } })
208	    },
209	    requestBuild() {
210	      this.building = true
211	      router.post(route('eir-feed.build'), this.build, { preserveScroll: true, onFinish: () => { this.building = false } })
212	    },
213	    async approve(id) {
214	      if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: 'Approve build ' + id + '?', message: 'The build is written to the loan book. The differences from the previous build are kept on the build.', confirmLabel: 'Approve and build' }))) return
215	      router.post(route('eir-feed.approve', id), {}, { preserveScroll: true })
216	    },
217	  },
218	}
219	</script>
