"""Reconcile the 2023-2024 loans in Finance's EIR assessment workbook to the 2024 fee postings on GL 4871/4873
(old ledger CUMVOUCH_BK240824 for Jan-Aug 2024, E-Banker from Oct 2024). Read-only."""
import subprocess, sys, re, json
from datetime import datetime, date
from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import combinations
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

FIN, OUT = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
M = r"C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe"


def rows(sql):
    r = subprocess.run([M, "-uroot", "-B", "--default-character-set=utf8mb4", "maiic_ifrs9"], input=sql,
                       capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    if r.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(r.stderr)
    lines = r.stdout.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
    head = lines[0].split("\t")
    return [dict(zip(head, [None if v == "NULL" else v for v in l.split("\t")])) for l in lines[1:]]


STOP = {"limited", "ltd", "company", "group", "the", "investment", "investments", "holdings", "services", "and", "general",
        "farm", "farms", "trf", "fees", "fee", "legal", "arrangement", "arrangment", "loan", "drawdown", "for", "from", "mega",
        "international", "enterprises", "enterprise", "trading", "sacco", "africa", "malawi", "innovation", "foods", "food", "processors"}


def toks(s):
    return {w for w in re.findall(r"[a-z]{4,}", (s or "").lower()) if w not in STOP}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Finance's workbook (all rows; the 2023-2024 loans are the scope)
ws = openpyxl.load_workbook(FIN, data_only=True)["EIR Assessment December 2025"]
fin = []
for i, r in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(min_row=5, values_only=True), 5):
    name, vd = r[4], r[6]
    if not name or not vd or not isinstance(r[3], (int, float)):
        continue
    if isinstance(vd, str):
        vd = datetime.strptime(vd.strip(), "%d/%m/%Y")
    fin.append({"row": i, "no": int(r[3]), "name": str(name).strip(), "vd": vd.date(), "legal": float(r[17] or 0) + float(r[18] or 0),
                "arrangement": float(r[19] or 0), "appraisal": float(r[16] or 0)})
scope = [f for f in fin if f["vd"].year <= 2024]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ledger postings dated 2024 on GL 4871 and 4873
old = rows("""
SELECT CONCAT('O', id) pid, row_date d, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.CB_GLCODE')) gl,
       JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.TRANSAMT')) amount,
       CONCAT_WS(' / ', NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.VARCHAR_2')),''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.PARTICULARS')),'')) narration,
       CONCAT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.BATCH_TYPE')),' ',JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.BATCH_NUMBER'))) ref
FROM ebanker_raw_rows WHERE query_id = 'CV_04a' AND superseded_at IS NULL AND YEAR(row_date) = 2024
  AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.CB_GLCODE')) IN ('4871','4873')""")
for p in old:
    p["state"] = "Old ledger (before E-Banker)"; p["loan"] = None
new = rows("""
SELECT CONCAT('T', f.id) pid, f.transaction_date d, f.gl_account_ref gl, f.amount, CONCAT_WS(' / ', f.description,
       (SELECT l.customer_name FROM loan_books l WHERE l.contract_id = f.contract_id AND l.customer_name <> '' ORDER BY l.reporting_period DESC LIMIT 1)) narration,
       f.source_reference ref, f.contract_id loan, 'E-Banker: tied to a loan by the system' state
FROM contract_fees f WHERE f.source_system = 'E-Banker GL fee posting' AND f.gl_account_ref IN ('4871','4873') AND YEAR(f.transaction_date) = 2024
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('H', id), transaction_date, gl_code, amount, narration, CONCAT(batch, ' / ', external_transaction_id), candidate_contract_id,
       'E-Banker: held, no loan in the batch'
FROM fee_gl_unassigned WHERE gl_code IN ('4871','4873') AND YEAR(transaction_date) = 2024""")
led = old + new
for p in led:
    p["amount"] = float(p["amount"]); p["d"] = date.fromisoformat(p["d"][:10])
    p["type"] = "legal" if p["gl"] == "4871" else "arrangement"; p["used"] = False
    p["mega"] = bool(re.search(r"mega farms?\b(?! *-)", (p["narration"] or "").lower())) and "msusa" not in (p["narration"] or "").lower()
progr = [p for p in led if p["mega"]]
loanled = [p for p in led if not p["mega"]]
tot = {t: sum(p["amount"] for p in led if p["type"] == t) for t in ("legal", "arrangement")}
tot_prog = {t: sum(p["amount"] for p in progr if p["type"] == t) for t in ("legal", "arrangement")}


def name_hit(p, f):
    return bool(toks(p["narration"]) & toks(f["name"]))


def days(p, f):
    return (p["d"] - f["vd"]).days


items = [{"f": f, "t": t, "want": round(f[t], 2), "posts": [], "how": []} for f in fin for t in ("legal", "arrangement") if round(f[t], 2)]
inscope = lambda it: it["f"]["vd"].year <= 2024


def take(it, ps, why):
    for p in ps:
        p["used"] = True; it["posts"].append(p); it["how"].append(f"{p['pid']}: {why}")


def free(t):
    return [p for p in loanled if not p["used"] and p["type"] == t]


# A. exact amount and the customer's name; B. exact amount, within 120 days of the value date (scope loans only)
for test, why, only_scope in ((lambda p, it: name_hit(p, it["f"]), "same amount, customer's name in the narration", False),
                              (lambda p, it: -30 <= days(p, it["f"]) <= 120, "same amount, near the value date (no name)", True)):
    for it in items:
        if it["posts"] or (only_scope and not inscope(it)):
            continue
        c = [p for p in free(it["t"]) if abs(p["amount"] - it["want"]) < 0.5 and test(p, it)]
        c.sort(key=lambda p: abs(days(p, it["f"])))
        if c:
            take(it, [c[0]], why)
# C. two or three postings naming the customer that add up (a fee in parts, or with a correction)
for it in items:
    if it["posts"]:
        continue
    pool = [p for p in free(it["t"]) if name_hit(p, it["f"])]
    for k in (2, 3):
        hit = next((c for c in combinations(pool, k) if abs(sum(p["amount"] for p in c) - it["want"]) < 0.5), None)
        if hit:
            take(it, list(hit), "several postings naming the customer, together the amount"); break
# D. the nearest posting naming the customer (amount differs), scope loans only
for it in items:
    if it["posts"] or not inscope(it):
        continue
    c = [p for p in free(it["t"]) if name_hit(p, it["f"])]
    c.sort(key=lambda p: abs(p["amount"] - it["want"]))
    if c:
        take(it, [c[0]], "nearest posting naming the customer (amount differs)")

recon = []
for it in items:
    if not inscope(it) and not it["posts"]:
        continue
    f = it["f"]; ledger = round(sum(p["amount"] for p in it["posts"]), 2); diff = round(it["want"] - ledger, 2)
    if not it["posts"]:
        status = "In Finance's file, no 2024 posting found"
    elif abs(diff) > 0.5:
        status = "Amounts differ"
    elif not inscope(it):
        status = "2025 loan: fee posted in 2024"
    else:
        status = "Agrees"
    src = sorted({p["state"].split(":")[0].split(" (")[0] for p in it["posts"]})
    recon.append({"no": f["no"], "name": f["name"], "vd": f["vd"], "type": it["t"], "fin": it["want"], "ledger": ledger, "diff": diff,
                  "status": status, "where": ", ".join(src), "postings": ", ".join(p["pid"] for p in it["posts"]),
                  "dates": ", ".join(p["d"].isoformat() for p in it["posts"]), "how": "; ".join(it["how"]),
                  "loan": next((p["loan"] for p in it["posts"] if p["loan"]), None)})
left = [p for p in loanled if not p["used"]]
fin_tot = {t: sum(f[t] for f in scope) for t in ("legal", "arrangement")}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- workbook
TEAL = "1F5C66"; HDR = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF"); HF = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=TEAL)
RED = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FDE2E1"); AMB = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFF4CC"); GRN = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="E2F0D9")
WRAP = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top"); NUM = "#,##0.00"; LINE = Border(bottom=Side(style="thin", color="DDDDDD"))
wb = Workbook()


def table(ws, headers, data, widths, numcols=(), start=1):
    for c, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
        x = ws.cell(row=start, column=c, value=h); x.font = HDR; x.fill = HF; x.alignment = WRAP
    for i, row in enumerate(data, start + 1):
        for c, v in enumerate(row, 1):
            x = ws.cell(row=i, column=c, value=v); x.alignment = WRAP; x.border = LINE
            if headers[c - 1] in numcols: x.number_format = NUM
            if isinstance(v, date): x.number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd"
    for c, w in enumerate(widths, 1):
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(c)].width = w
    ws.row_dimensions[start].height = 32
    ws.freeze_panes = ws.cell(row=start + 1, column=3)
    ws.auto_filter.ref = f"A{start}:{get_column_letter(len(headers))}{start + len(data)}"


order = ["Agrees", "Amounts differ", "In Finance's file, no 2024 posting found", "2025 loan: fee posted in 2024"]
cnt = defaultdict(int)
for r in recon: cnt[r["status"]] += 1
ws = wb.active; ws.title = "Summary"
txt = [
    ("MAIIC: 2024 fees, Finance's workbook against the general ledger", "t"),
    ("Prepared by Dupleix Institute, 15 October 2026. Finance's file: 'MAIIC EIR Assessment as of 31st December 2025.xlsx' (the version with all the loans tested; it has no account numbers, so loans are matched by name and amount). Scope: the "
     f"{len(scope)} loans in it with a value date in 2023 or 2024. Ledger: every 2024 posting on GL 4871 (legal fees) and GL 4873 (arrangement fees): the old ledger (CUMVOUCH_BK240824, to 15 August 2024) and E-Banker (from 3 October 2024; E-Banker holds no fee posting between the migration and that date). Nothing in either has been changed.", None),
    ("", None), ("1. Totals", "h")]
for i, (t, k) in enumerate(txt, 1):
    x = ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=t); x.alignment = WRAP
    if k == "t": x.font = Font(bold=True, size=14, color=TEAL)
    if k == "h": x.font = Font(bold=True, color=TEAL)
r0 = len(txt) + 1
hd = ["", "General ledger, all of 2024", "of which the Mega Farm programme's monthly arrangement fee accruals", "of which loans",
      f"Finance's file, the {len(scope)} loans of 2023-2024", "Loans: ledger less Finance's file"]
for c, h in enumerate(hd, 1):
    x = ws.cell(row=r0, column=c, value=h); x.font = HDR; x.fill = HF; x.alignment = WRAP
ws.row_dimensions[r0].height = 60
for j, (lab, t) in enumerate((("Legal fees, GL 4871", "legal"), ("Arrangement fees, GL 4873", "arrangement")), r0 + 1):
    for c, v in enumerate([lab, tot[t], tot_prog[t], tot[t] - tot_prog[t], fin_tot[t], tot[t] - tot_prog[t] - fin_tot[t]], 1):
        x = ws.cell(row=j, column=c, value=v)
        if c > 1: x.number_format = NUM
r1 = r0 + 4
ws.cell(row=r1, column=1, value="2. Loan by loan").font = Font(bold=True, color=TEAL)
for c, h in enumerate(["Result", "Loan and fee lines"], 1):
    x = ws.cell(row=r1 + 1, column=c, value=h); x.font = HDR; x.fill = HF
for j, s in enumerate(order, r1 + 2):
    ws.cell(row=j, column=1, value=s); ws.cell(row=j, column=2, value=cnt.get(s, 0))
r2 = r1 + 2 + len(order) + 1
ws.cell(row=r2, column=1, value=f"Loan fee postings of 2024 not matched to a loan in Finance's file: {len(left)} ({sum(p['amount'] for p in left):,.2f}); listed on 'Ledger postings'").font = Font(bold=True)
notes = [("3. Notes", "h"),
         ("Finance's file carries a loan's fees from the customer's statement; the old ledger names the customer on each posting (from 1 January to July 2024) and E-Banker names it in the narration or through the loan in the batch. A match on amount alone, with no name, is shown as such for Finance to confirm.", None),
         ("The Mega Farm programme's arrangement fees are accrued monthly to GL 4873 as one amount for the programme, not per loan, so they are outside Finance's per-loan file and shown separately.", None),
         ("Postings in 2024 that match no loan in Finance's file are mostly fees of loans the December 2025 file does not include (loans repaid or written off before then, or not in its test). They are listed for Finance to identify.", None)]
for j, (t, k) in enumerate(notes, r2 + 2):
    x = ws.cell(row=j, column=1, value=t); x.alignment = WRAP
    if k == "h": x.font = Font(bold=True, color=TEAL)
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 90
for col in "BCDEF": ws.column_dimensions[col].width = 20

ws = wb.create_sheet("By loan")
H = ["Finance #", "Customer", "Value date", "Fee", "Finance's file (MWK)", "Ledger 2024 (MWK)", "Difference (MWK)", "Result", "Ledger",
     "E-Banker loan", "Posting IDs", "Posting dates", "How matched", "Finance: confirm / correct", "Comment"]
data = [[r["no"], r["name"], r["vd"], r["type"].title(), r["fin"], r["ledger"], r["diff"], r["status"], r["where"], r["loan"],
         r["postings"], r["dates"], r["how"], None, None] for r in sorted(recon, key=lambda r: (order.index(r["status"]), r["no"], r["type"]))]
table(ws, H, data, [8, 30, 11, 11, 15, 15, 14, 24, 20, 14, 14, 22, 36, 18, 28], numcols=("Finance's file (MWK)", "Ledger 2024 (MWK)", "Difference (MWK)"))
for i, row in enumerate(data, 2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=8).fill = GRN if row[7] == "Agrees" else AMB if row[7].startswith("2025") else RED
    if "no name" in (row[12] or ""): ws.cell(row=i, column=13).fill = AMB
    for c in (14, 15): ws.cell(row=i, column=c).fill = AMB

ws = wb.create_sheet("Ledger postings")
match_of = defaultdict(list)
for r in recon:
    for pid in filter(None, r["postings"].split(", ")): match_of[pid].append(f"#{r['no']} {r['name']}")
H2 = ["Posting ID", "Ledger", "GL", "Fee", "Date", "Amount (MWK)", "Narration / customer", "Batch / reference", "E-Banker loan", "Matched to"]
data2 = [[p["pid"], p["state"], p["gl"], p["type"].title(), p["d"], p["amount"], p["narration"], p["ref"], p["loan"],
          "Mega Farm programme accrual" if p["mega"] else ", ".join(match_of.get(p["pid"], [])) or "NOT MATCHED"]
         for p in sorted(led, key=lambda p: (p["d"], p["gl"]))]
table(ws, H2, data2, [9, 26, 6, 11, 11, 16, 50, 16, 14, 30], numcols=("Amount (MWK)",))
for i, row in enumerate(data2, 2):
    if row[9] == "NOT MATCHED": ws.cell(row=i, column=10).fill = RED

wb.save(OUT)
print("ledger", tot, "programme", tot_prog, "finance scope", fin_tot, dict(cnt), "left", len(left), round(sum(p["amount"] for p in left), 2))
for r in recon:
    if r["status"] != "Agrees" or "no name" in r["how"]:
        print(r["no"], r["name"][:28], r["type"], r["fin"], r["ledger"], r["diff"], r["status"], "|", r["how"][:110])
for p in left:
    print("LEFT", p["pid"], p["gl"], p["d"], p["amount"], (p["narration"] or "")[:70])

````

## CLAUDE  (2026-10-15 05:38:23 UTC)

Written for: MAIIC Finance (Tamanda), to check and confirm. The workbook is `MAIIC 2024 fees - Finance workbook vs general ledger - 15 Oct 2026.xlsx`, in the same Fees folder as the other two.

The 2024 fees in Finance's workbook all agree with the ledger. All 33 loans drawn in 2023 or 2024 reconcile: 65 legal and arrangement fee lines, every one equal to a ledger posting. There are no differences.

**What the comparison used**
- **Finance's file:** the earlier version of the December 2025 assessment, which tested every loan, including those drawn in 2024. It has no account numbers, so loans were matched by name and amount.
- **Ledger:** every 2024 posting on GL 4871 (legal) and GL 4873 (arrangement):
  - January to July 2024 from the old ledger, before E-Banker. It names the customer on each posting.
  - From 3 October 2024 from E-Banker.
  - Nothing was posted between the migration and 3 October. E-Banker's first fee posting is on 3 October, even though the extract asked for everything from 1 January 2024.

**Totals for 2024**

| | Legal, GL 4871 | Arrangement, GL 4873 |
|---|---|---|
| Ledger, all of 2024 | 270,114,433 | 1,355,519,762 |
| Mega Farm programme's monthly accruals | none | 999,999,999 |
| Finance's file, 33 loans | 256,289,233 | 335,931,762 |
| Postings not in Finance's file | 13,825,200 | 19,588,000 |

The programme accruals are booked to "Mega Farms" as one amount a month (about 84.9m each, plus 416.4m in July). They're the programme's fee, not one loan's, so they're shown separately.

**For Finance to confirm**
- **Three matches on amount and date only.** The E-Banker narrations just say "reallocation", so these can't be confirmed by name: NyamNyam (legal 4,450,000), Kwalingana (legal 12,914,500) and Napoleon Dzombe T/A Santhe (legal 40,000,000).
- **22 postings from November 2024 match no loan in Finance's file** (33.4m net). Most are loans the December 2025 file doesn't include:
  - Rose Harris, posted as "Guarantee fees" on both fee GLs
  - Mawindo
  - Kaning'a General Dealers. One of its postings is a "loan repayment reversal" on the legal fee GL, which looks misposted.
  - "NBS mega farms"
  - a 3,264,000 Chikwendeni arrangement fee
  - several reallocations, plus an 84,692,000 mis-posting and its reversal, which net to nil

  Each posting is listed with a red flag on the "Ledger postings" sheet.
- **Legal cost:** Finance's "LEGAL COST" column is a cost MAIIC paid, not a fee received, so it's shown in its own column and not compared with GL 4871.

So on this evidence Finance's fee figures are reliable for 2024 and 2025. The 2025 file differs from the GL only by Chikwendeni's 800. Finance's files can therefore supply the missing loan links for the "By Trf" postings the system holds. The two Mega Farm questions, the programme accruals and the guarantee fees, matter for the fee review: they decide what counts as part of a loan's EIR.

## CLAUDE  (2026-10-15 05:41:23 UTC)

You make it reliable by having the system **prove** each month that the workbook ties to the GL, not by trusting it. The GL stays the book of record. Finance's workbook becomes the record of what the GL can't say on its own: which loan each fee belongs to, what kind of fee it is, and whether it's part of the EIR.

Some of this exists already. The app can import a Finance fee file through EIR Data Intake, and the governed setting `fee_source_precedence` has a "Finance workbook first" option. What's missing are the controls that make it safe to rank the workbook first.

**What I'd put in place**

1. **One standard monthly template.** Finance fills the same layout every month-end: E-Banker account number, fee type, amount, date received, GL account (4871, 4873, 4874 or 4875), and their view on whether the fee is integral, with a reason. Their current files fall short here: the 2024 version has no account numbers, and neither version names the GL posting.
2. **A tie-out gate on import (new code).** For each GL account and month, the workbook total must equal the GL fee postings. Each line must also match a posting by amount, GL and date, or carry an explanation. If either check fails, the import is refused and the differences are shown. This is the reconciliation I did by hand today, built into the import, so it happens every month without anyone remembering to do it.
3. **Automatic loan links (new code).** When a workbook line matches a held "By Trf" posting, the workbook supplies the loan and the system ties the posting, with an audit record. This removes the manual "tie to loan" step for the postings the system can't place today, 33 of them in 2025 alone.
4. **Rank the workbook first.** This is the Governance Centre change from "GL posting first" to "Finance workbook first", and MAIIC approves it, not us. With the gate in place it's safe: the workbook can only win where it already ties to the GL. Today the only amount that would change is Chikwendeni's 800.
5. **Finance's classification feeds the fee review.** Their integral or not-integral column becomes the first decision, and a second person approves it in the app. That turns the 283-line review into checking Finance's work instead of starting from blank.
6. **Backfill 2024 and 2025 now.** I'd pre-fill both years in the new template from today's two reconciliations, including the account numbers the 2024 file lacks. Finance confirms the matched rows, especially the eight 2025 and three 2024 matches made on amount and date only, plus Mthirakuwiri and JVD. Loading it is what releases the 115 blocked EIRs.
7. **Longer term, fix it at source.** Ask the vendor to post fees with the loan account as a leg of the batch. The GL would then tie itself, and the workbook becomes a cross-check instead of a necessity.

**Decisions for you and MAIIC**
- Whether to rank the workbook first at all. The alternative is to keep the GL first and use the workbook only to supply loan links (steps 2, 3 and 5 without step 4). That is the more conservative choice, and on today's figures it gives the same amounts.
- Whether the gate should refuse an import outright or let Finance accept a difference with a reason. I'd refuse, with a governed tolerance for amounts like the 800.

If you agree, I'd start with steps 2, 3 and 6: the gate, the automatic linking, and the pre-filled 2024 and 2025 template for Finance.

<?php

namespace App\Services\Eir;

use App\Support\ContractId;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Fee intake (docs/EIR_Build.md §4 Phase 2): loads mapped fee rows
 * (contract_id, fee_type, amount[, basis, gl_account_ref]) into
 * contract_fees. First real load is the Dec-2025 EIR assessment workbook.
 *
 * Amounts are signed — netting lines are legitimate (a negative legal-cost
 * line nets against the legal fee) — but they are counted and reported so
 * a sign-convention problem in a file is visible at import time, alongside
 * the per-type totals the operator eyeballs against the GL.
 */
class FeeImportService
{
    public const KNOWN_TYPES = ['arrangement', 'legal', 'appraisal', 'default', 'levy', 'other'];

    /**
     * @param list<array{contract_id: mixed, fee_type: ?string, amount: float, basis?: ?string, gl_account_ref?: ?string}> $rows
     * @return array{
     *   loaded_rows: int, skipped_rows: int,
     *   unknown_types: array<string,int>, negative_lines: int,
     *   totals_by_type: array<string,float>
     * }
     */
    public function import(array $rows, ?FeeRuleMatcher $matcher = null): array
    {
        $matcher ??= app(FeeRuleMatcher::class);
        $inserts       = [];
        $skipped       = 0;
        $unknownTypes  = [];
        $negativeLines = 0;
        $totals        = [];
        $years         = [];
        $now           = now();

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $contractId = ContractId::normalise($row['contract_id'] ?? null);
            $amount     = (float) ($row['amount'] ?? 0);

            if ($contractId === null || $amount === 0.0) {
                $skipped++;
                continue;
            }

            $type = strtolower(trim((string) ($row['fee_type'] ?? '')));
            if (! in_array($type, self::KNOWN_TYPES, true)) {
                $unknownTypes[$type ?: '(blank)'] = ($unknownTypes[$type ?: '(blank)'] ?? 0) + 1;
                $type = 'other';
            }

            if ($amount < 0) {
                $negativeLines++;
            }

            $basis = strtoupper(trim((string) ($row['basis'] ?? '')));
            $direction = strtoupper(trim((string) ($row['cashflow_direction'] ?? '')));
            $sourceSystem = trim((string) ($row['source_system'] ?? '')) ?: null;
            $externalId = trim((string) ($row['external_transaction_id'] ?? '')) ?: null;

            if ($sourceSystem && $externalId && DB::table('contract_fees')
                ->where('source_system', $sourceSystem)
                ->where('external_transaction_id', $externalId)->exists()) {
                $skipped++;
                continue;
            }

            $candidate = [
                'fee_type' => $type,
                'description' => trim((string) ($row['description'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                'cashflow_direction' => in_array($direction, ['RECEIVED', 'PAID'], true) ? $direction : null,
                'gl_account_ref' => ($row['gl_account_ref'] ?? null) ?: null,
            ];
            $rule = $matcher->match($candidate);

            $inserts[] = [
                'contract_id'    => $contractId,
                'fee_type'       => $type,
                'description'    => $candidate['description'],
                'amount'         => $amount,
                'transaction_date' => ($row['transaction_date'] ?? null) ?: null,
                'cashflow_direction' => $candidate['cashflow_direction'],
                'currency'       => strtoupper(trim((string) ($row['currency'] ?? ''))) ?: null,
                'source_system'  => $sourceSystem,
                'source_reference' => trim((string) ($row['source_reference'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                'external_transaction_id' => $externalId,
                'basis'          => in_array($basis, ['ON_APPROVED', 'ON_DRAWN'], true) ? $basis : 'ON_APPROVED',
                'integral'       => null,
                'classification_status' => 'PENDING',
                'suggested_rule_id' => $rule?->id,
                'suggested_integral' => $rule?->proposed_integral,
                'gl_account_ref' => ($row['gl_account_ref'] ?? null) ?: null,
                'created_at'     => $now,
                'updated_at'     => $now,
            ];

            $totals[$type] = ($totals[$type] ?? 0) + $amount;
            // the years the file covers, so the fee GL check (FeeGlReconciliationService) knows what to prove
            if (preg_match('/^(\d{4})-\d{2}/', (string) ($row['transaction_date'] ?? ''), $y) === 1) {
                $years[(int) $y[1]] = true;
            }
        }

        if ($inserts !== []) {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($inserts) {
                foreach (array_chunk($inserts, 500) as $chunk) {
                    DB::table('contract_fees')->insert($chunk);
                }
            });
        }

        return [
            'loaded_rows'    => count($inserts),
            'skipped_rows'   => $skipped,
            'unknown_types'  => $unknownTypes,
            'negative_lines' => $negativeLines,
            'totals_by_type' => array_map(fn ($v) => round($v, 2), $totals),
            'years'          => array_map('intval', array_keys($years)),
        ];
    }
}

    /** @return list<string> the tiers in the order the setting in force gives them */
    public function order(?CarbonImmutable $asOf = null): array
    {
        $value = $this->governance->get('fee_source_precedence', $asOf);

        return match ($value) {
            self::GL_FIRST => [self::TIER_GL, self::TIER_FINANCE, self::TIER_LOS, self::TIER_EXTRACT_A],
            self::FINANCE_FIRST => [self::TIER_FINANCE, self::TIER_GL, self::TIER_LOS, self::TIER_EXTRACT_A],
            self::LOS_FIRST => [self::TIER_LOS, self::TIER_GL, self::TIER_FINANCE, self::TIER_EXTRACT_A],
            default => throw new InvalidArgumentException("fee_source_precedence holds \"{$value}\", which is not one of its options."),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Mark, for every contract, the lines of every source below the highest
     * one that holds a fee for it; clear the mark on the winning source. The
     * cross-check of 7.8.5 comes back with it: for each contract and fee type
     * where a superseded source carries a different amount from the source of
     * record, both amounts and the difference, for Finance on Fee
     * Classification.
     *
     * @return array{order:list<string>, contracts:int, superseded_lines:int, restored_lines:int, by_winner:array<string,int>, exceptions:list<array>}
     */
    public function apply(?int $userId = null): array
    {
        $order = $this->order();
        $rank = array_flip($order);
        $now = now();
        $lines = DB::table('contract_fees')->orderBy('contract_id')->orderBy('id')
            ->get(['id', 'contract_id', 'fee_type', 'amount', 'source_system', 'superseded_by_source'])->groupBy('contract_id');

        $superseded = 0; $restored = 0; $byWinner = []; $exceptions = [];
        DB::transaction(function () use ($lines, $rank, $now, &$superseded, &$restored, &$byWinner, &$exceptions) {
            foreach ($lines as $contractId => $rows) {
                $tiers = [];
                foreach ($rows as $r) {
                    $tier = self::tierOf($r->source_system);
                    if ($tier !== null) {
                        $tiers[$tier] = true;
                    }
                }
                if ($tiers === []) {
                    continue;
                }
                $winner = collect(array_keys($tiers))->sortBy(fn ($t) => $rank[$t])->first();
                $byWinner[$winner] = ($byWinner[$winner] ?? 0) + 1;

                $winning = []; $losing = [];
                foreach ($rows as $r) {
                    $tier = self::tierOf($r->source_system);
                    if ($tier === null) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if ($tier === $winner) {
                        $winning[$r->fee_type] = ($winning[$r->fee_type] ?? 0.0) + (float) $r->amount;
                        if ($r->superseded_by_source !== null) {
                            DB::table('contract_fees')->where('id', $r->id)->update(['superseded_by_source' => null, 'superseded_at' => null, 'updated_at' => $now]);
                            $restored++;
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    $losing[$tier][$r->fee_type] = ($losing[$tier][$r->fee_type] ?? 0.0) + (float) $r->amount;
                    if ($r->superseded_by_source !== $winner) {
                        DB::table('contract_fees')->where('id', $r->id)->update(['superseded_by_source' => $winner, 'superseded_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now]);
                        $superseded++;
                    }
                }
                foreach ($losing as $tier => $byType) {
                    foreach (array_unique(array_merge(array_keys($byType), array_keys($winning))) as $type) {
                        $kept = round($winning[$type] ?? 0.0, 2);
                        $other = round($byType[$type] ?? 0.0, 2);
                        if (abs($kept - $other) >= 0.01) {
                            $exceptions[] = ['contract_id' => (string) $contractId, 'fee_type' => $type, 'source_of_record' => $winner, 'amount_of_record' => $kept,
                                'other_source' => $tier, 'other_amount' => $other, 'difference' => round($other - $kept, 2)];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        $result = ['order' => $order, 'contracts' => count($lines), 'superseded_lines' => $superseded, 'restored_lines' => $restored, 'by_winner' => $byWinner, 'exceptions' => $exceptions];
        AuditLoggerService::log('Fee Source Precedence Applied', 'contract_fees', null, ['new_values' => array_diff_key($result, ['exceptions' => 1]) + ['exception_count' => count($exceptions)], 'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);

        return $result;
    }
}

    public function handle(
        MappedFileReader $reader,
        ScheduleImportService $schedules,
        FeeImportService $fees,
        ContractTransactionImportService $transactions,
        ContractMasterImportService $master,
        GlInterestImportService $glInterest,
        ReferenceRateImportService $referenceRates,
        DisbursementImportService $disbursements,
        FeeGlReconciliationService $feeGl,
    ): void {
        $import = Import::findOrFail($this->importId);
        $import->update(['status' => 'processing', 'started_at' => now()]);
        $exceptionPath = "failed_imports/eir_exception_{$import->id}.csv";

        try {
            $transforms = $this->transforms;
            if ($this->importType === 'reference_rates') {
                // Decision D19: the effective date reaches the service exactly
                // as the file wrote it. A declared date format would re-read a
                // dd/mm cell instead of refusing it, so the transform the
                // screen suggested is dropped here rather than trusted.
                unset($transforms['effective_date']);
            }
            if ($this->importType === 'disbursements') {
                // Same rule for the drawdown date: it decides which month a
                // tranche falls in, so it is refused rather than re-read.
                unset($transforms['disbursement_date']);
            }
            $read = $reader->read(Storage::path($this->storedPath), $this->importType, $this->mapping, $transforms);
            $result = match ($this->importType) {
                'contract_master' => $master->import($read['rows']),
                'schedule' => $schedules->import($read['rows']),
                'fees' => $fees->import($read['rows']),
                'contract_transactions' => $transactions->import($read['rows']),
                'gl_interest' => $glInterest->import($read['rows']),
                'reference_rates' => $referenceRates->import($read['rows'], importId: $import->id, userId: $this->userId ?? auth()->id()),
                'disbursements' => $disbursements->import($read['rows'], $import->id, $this->userId ?? auth()->id()),
            };
            if ($this->importType === 'fees') {
                // every fee held for the years the file covers, against 4871 and 4873 (spec v4 section 7.4); reports, never blocks
                $result['gl_reconciliation'] = $feeGl->report($result['years'] ?? []);
            }
            $exceptions = $this->failureRows($result);
            if ($exceptions !== []) $this->writeExceptionFile($exceptionPath, $exceptions);

            // Only rows that did not load count as failures in the history.
            // Notices about rows that did load belong in the file, not in a
            // number the operator reads as "this import went wrong".
            $failed = count(array_filter($exceptions, fn ($row) => in_array($row['status'], ['held', 'skipped'], true)));

            $import->update([
                'status' => 'completed',
                'records' => $this->successfulRecords($result),
                'rows_processed' => $read['report']['total_rows'] ?? 0,
                'failed_records' => $failed,
                'failed_file_path' => $exceptions === [] ? null : $exceptionPath,
                'completed_at' => now(),
            ]);
            AuditLoggerService::log(action: 'EIR Intake Import', entityType: 'Import', entityId: $import->id,
                data: ['meta' => ['import_type' => $this->importType, 'file' => $this->originalName, 'result' => $result]]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $this->writeExceptionFile($exceptionPath, [['scope' => 'file', 'status' => 'failed', 'reason' => $e->getMessage()]]);
            $import->update(['status' => 'failed', 'failed_records' => 1, 'failed_file_path' => $exceptionPath, 'completed_at' => now()]);
            Log::error('EIR import failed', ['import_id' => $import->id, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            throw $e;
        } finally {
            Storage::delete($this->storedPath);
        }
    }

    public function failed(Throwable $exception): void
    {
        Import::whereKey($this->importId)->whereNot('status', 'failed')->update(['status' => 'failed', 'completed_at' => now()]);
    }

    private function successfulRecords(array $result): int
    {
        return match ($this->importType) {
            // Extract B fans out to three destinations; counting only the
            // schedule rows would under-report the import in the history.
            'contract_transactions' => (int) ($result['loaded_rows'] ?? 0)
                + (int) ($result['actual_rows_loaded'] ?? 0)
                + (int) ($result['fee_result']['loaded_rows'] ?? 0),
            'contract_master' => (int) ($result['loaded_rows'] ?? 0)
                + (int) ($result['fee_result']['loaded_rows'] ?? 0),
            'gl_interest' => (int) ($result['loaded_rows'] ?? 0) + (int) ($result['restated_rows'] ?? 0),
            default => (int) ($result['loaded_rows'] ?? 0),
        };
    }

    /** Tie a held GL fee line to its loan, with the reason (GlFeeBuildService::assignHeld audit-logs it). */
    public function tieHeld(Request $request, int $held, \App\Services\Ebanker\GlFeeBuildService $service)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['contract_id' => ['required', 'string', 'max:60'], 'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'min:10', 'max:500']]);
        \App\Support\LedgerReadLimits::raise(); // the precedence and the fee build read the ledger
        try {
            $service->assignHeld($held, $data['contract_id'], (int) $request->user()->id, $data['reason']);
        } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            return back()->with('error', $e->getMessage());
        }

        return back()->with('success', 'The fee line is tied to loan ' . ltrim(trim($data['contract_id']), '0') . '. It now waits on the list below for its classification and review.');
    }

    /**
     * Tie a held fee line to its loan: a person's act, with the reason, after
     * reading the batch and the narration (Fee Classification). The line moves
     * into contract_fees PENDING, so it still needs its classification and
     * review before it can affect an EIR; the precedence is applied again.
     */
    public function assignHeld(int $heldId, string $contractId, int $userId, string $reason): array
    {
        $reason = trim($reason);
        if (mb_strlen($reason) < 10) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Say why the fee belongs to this loan (at least 10 characters).');
        }
        $held = DB::table('fee_gl_unassigned')->where('id', $heldId)->first();
        if ($held === null) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("No held fee line {$heldId}.");
        }
        $contractId = ltrim(trim($contractId), '0');
        if (! DB::table('contract_eir')->where('contract_id', $contractId)->exists() && ! DB::table('loan_books')->where('contract_id', $contractId)->exists()) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Loan {$contractId} is not in the contract master or the loan book.");
        }
        $result = DB::transaction(function () use ($held, $contractId, $userId, $reason) {
            $r = $this->fees->import([[
                'contract_id' => $contractId, 'fee_type' => self::TYPE_BY_GL[$held->gl_code] ?? 'other', 'amount' => (float) $held->amount,
                'transaction_date' => $held->transaction_date, 'cashflow_direction' => 'RECEIVED', 'currency' => 'MWK',
                'description' => mb_substr(trim(($held->narration ?: 'Fee') . ' (GL ' . $held->gl_code . ', tied by hand: ' . $reason . ')'), 0, 199),
                'source_system' => self::SOURCE, 'source_reference' => mb_substr('batch ' . $held->batch, 0, 199),
                'external_transaction_id' => $held->external_transaction_id, 'gl_account_ref' => $held->gl_code,
            ]]);
            DB::table('fee_gl_unassigned')->where('id', $held->id)->delete();
            AuditLoggerService::log('GL Fee Tied To Loan', 'contract_fees', null, ['new_values' => ['contract_id' => $contractId, 'external_transaction_id' => $held->external_transaction_id,
                'amount' => (float) $held->amount, 'reason' => $reason, 'candidate_was' => $held->candidate_contract_id], 'meta' => ['user' => $userId]]);

            return $r;
        });

        return $result + ['precedence' => $this->precedence->apply($userId)];
    }

    public function test_an_eir_fee_file_with_a_bad_amount_is_refused_before_it_is_queued(): void
    {
        $file = $this->csvUpload([
            ['contract_id', 'fee_type', 'amount', 'cashflow_direction'],
            ['800000000001', 'arrangement', '12500000', 'RECEIVED'],
            ['800000000001', 'legal', 'twelve', 'RECEIVED'],
            ['800000000002', 'legal', '100', 'SIDEWAYS'],
        ], 'fees.csv');

        $response = $this->postJson(route('eir-intake.import'), [
            'file' => $file, 'import_type' => 'fees',
            'mapping' => json_encode(['contract_id' => 'contract_id', 'fee_type' => 'fee_type', 'amount' => 'amount', 'cashflow_direction' => 'cashflow_direction']),
        ]);

        $response->assertStatus(422);
        $issues = collect($response->json('check.issues'));
        $this->assertTrue($issues->contains(fn ($i) => $i['row'] === 3 && $i['column'] === 'amount'));
        $this->assertTrue($issues->contains(fn ($i) => $i['row'] === 4 && $i['column'] === 'cashflow_direction'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('was not imported', $response->json('error'));
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('imports')->count(), 'nothing was queued');
    }

    /** The reconciliation band in force (recon_tolerance), or to the cent when none is set. */
    private function tolerance(): array
    {
        try {
            return $this->governance->reconciliationTolerance();
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return ['percent' => 0.0, 'floor' => 0.01];
        }
    }

    private function within(float $difference, ?float $base, array $tolerance): bool
    {
        $band = max((float) $tolerance['floor'], abs((float) $base) * (float) $tolerance['percent'] / 100);

        return abs($difference) <= $band + 0.005;
    }

<?php

namespace App\Services\Eir;

use App\Services\Ebanker\GlFeeBuildService;
use App\Support\ContractId;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Finance's fee workbook, proved against the GL fee postings before it loads
 * (15 October 2026; the 2024 and 2025 reconciliations of that day).
 *
 * The GL is the book of record, but a fee credited by transfer has no loan leg
 * in its batch, so the GL alone cannot say whose fee it is (GlFeeBuildService
 * holds those postings). Finance's workbook says whose fee each one is. It is
 * relied on only because this check proves it, line by line and month by
 * month, against the postings the system holds (GL_04: the lines tied to a
 * loan and the held ones). A file that fails any check loads nothing.
 *
 * A line is refused when:
 *  - it has no loan account, no date, or a fee type with no fee GL and no GL named;
 *  - its loan has fees from the take-on workbook (those are the take-on loan's
 *    record and never compete under fee_source_precedence, so a second copy
 *    would count twice);
 *  - its date is before the first GL fee posting the system holds (nothing to prove it against);
 *  - no posting, or set of postings, accounts for it within the governed
 *    recon_tolerance band.
 *
 * Matching, in order (each posting is used once): a posting tied to the line's
 * loan; a held posting whose candidate is the loan; a held posting naming the
 * customer; a held posting of the same amount near the date (to the unit, no
 * band); a posting tied to another loan of a customer of the same name (a
 * conflict, reported); one held posting paying two lines' fees together; two
 * or three postings naming the loan that add up (a fee and its corrections).
 *
 * Completeness: for each fee GL the file reaches, the postings of the months
 * from its first to its last matched posting that no line accounts for must
 * net to nil within the band (a posting and its reversal); otherwise the file
 * leaves fees out and is refused. Mega Farm programme postings (held as
 * MEGA_FARM, outside the EIR, decision D30) are left out of both sides.
 *
 * A held posting that one line accounts for on its own (alone or with its
 * corrections) is returned in ties: the import ties it to the line's loan
 * through GlFeeBuildService::assignHeld, recorded and audited. A posting that
 * pays two loans together is not tied (it cannot be split); the workbook line
 * stands for each loan.
 */
class FeeWorkbookTieOut
{
    public const MATCH_WINDOW = [-90, 120];
    public const COMBO_WINDOW = 250;

    public function __construct(private readonly GovernanceService $governance)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<array<string,mixed>>  $rows  the mapped fee rows, in file order
     * @return array{status:string, refusals:list<array>, lines:list<array>, unaccounted:list<array>, ties:list<array>, conflicts:list<array>, coverage:array, tolerance:array}
     */
    public function check(array $rows): array
    {
        $tolerance = $this->tolerance();
        $postings = $this->postings();
        $first = $postings === [] ? null : min(array_map(fn ($p) => $p['date'], $postings));
        $takeon = DB::table('contract_fees')->where('source_system', FeeSourcePrecedence::SOURCE_TAKEON)->distinct()->pluck('contract_id')->flip()->all();

        $lines = []; $refusals = [];
        foreach (array_values($rows) as $i => $row) {
            $n = $i + 2; // the row number in the file (header on row 1)
            $contract = ContractId::normalise($row['contract_id'] ?? null);
            $amount = round((float) ($row['amount'] ?? 0), 2);
            if ($amount == 0.0) {
                continue; // the import skips a zero line too
            }
            $gl = FeeGlReconciliationService::glFor($row['fee_type'] ?? null, isset($row['gl_account_ref']) ? (string) $row['gl_account_ref'] : null);
            $date = $this->date($row['transaction_date'] ?? null);
            $line = ['row' => $n, 'contract_id' => $contract, 'fee_type' => strtolower(trim((string) ($row['fee_type'] ?? ''))), 'gl' => $gl, 'amount' => $amount, 'date' => $date?->toDateString(), 'postings' => [], 'how' => []];
            $why = match (true) {
                $contract === null => 'No loan account: the fee cannot be placed.',
                $date === null => 'No date: the line cannot be matched to a GL posting.',
                $gl === null => "Fee type \"{$line['fee_type']}\" has no fee GL of its own: give gl_account_ref (4871, 4873, 4874 or 4875).",
                isset($takeon[$contract]) => "Loan {$contract} is a take-on loan: its fees come from the take-on workbook, so loading them here would count them twice.",
                $first === null => 'The system holds no GL fee postings yet (GL_04), so nothing can prove the line.',
                $date->lt($first->startOfMonth()) => 'Dated before the first GL fee posting the system holds (' . $first->toDateString() . '): nothing to prove it against.',
                default => null,
            };
            if ($why !== null) {
                $refusals[] = ['row' => $n, 'contract_id' => $contract, 'amount' => $amount, 'reason' => $why];
                continue;
            }
            $lines[] = $line;
        }

        $names = $this->names(array_unique(array_merge(array_column($lines, 'contract_id'), array_filter(array_column($postings, 'loan')))));
        $used = [];
        $free = fn (string $gl) => array_filter($postings, fn ($p) => ! isset($used[$p['id']]) && $p['gl'] === $gl && ! $p['programme']);
        $near = fn (array $p, array $l, int $from, int $to) => ($d = CarbonImmutable::parse($l['date'])->diffInDays($p['date'], false)) >= $from && $d <= $to;
        $named = fn (array $p, array $l) => $this->tokens($p['narration']) && array_intersect($this->tokens($p['narration']), $this->tokens($names[$l['contract_id']] ?? '')) !== [];
        $take = function (int $li, array $ps, string $why) use (&$lines, &$used) {
            foreach ($ps as $p) {
                $used[$p['id']] = true;
                $lines[$li]['postings'][] = $p;
                $lines[$li]['how'][] = $p['id'] . ': ' . $why;
            }
        };

        // A. one posting for one line
        $passes = [
            ['tied to this loan', fn ($p, $l) => $p['tied'] && $p['loan'] === $l['contract_id'], true],
            ['held; the system\'s candidate loan', fn ($p, $l) => ! $p['tied'] && $p['loan'] === $l['contract_id'], true],
            ['held; the customer\'s name is in the narration', fn ($p, $l) => ! $p['tied'] && $named($p, $l), true],
            ['held; same amount near the date (no name: confirm)', fn ($p, $l) => ! $p['tied'], false],
            ['tied by the system to another loan of the same customer', fn ($p, $l) => $p['tied'] && $p['loan'] !== $l['contract_id'] && $this->sameCustomer($names[$p['loan']] ?? '', $names[$l['contract_id']] ?? ''), true],
        ];
        foreach ($passes as [$why, $test, $banded]) {
            foreach ($lines as $li => $l) {
                if ($l['postings'] !== []) {
                    continue;
                }
                $c = array_filter($free($l['gl']), fn ($p) => $near($p, $l, ...self::MATCH_WINDOW) && $test($p, $l)
                    && ($banded ? $this->within($p['amount'] - $l['amount'], $l['amount'], $tolerance) : abs($p['amount'] - $l['amount']) < 1.0));
                usort($c, fn ($a, $b) => [abs($a['amount'] - $l['amount']), abs($a['date']->diffInDays(CarbonImmutable::parse($l['date'])))]
                    <=> [abs($b['amount'] - $l['amount']), abs($b['date']->diffInDays(CarbonImmutable::parse($l['date'])))]);
                if ($c !== []) {
                    $take($li, [reset($c)], $why);
                }
            }
        }
        // B. one held posting paying two lines' fees together
        foreach ($lines as $a => $la) {
            foreach ($lines as $b => $lb) {
                if ($b <= $a || $lines[$a]['postings'] !== [] || $lines[$b]['postings'] !== [] || $la['gl'] !== $lb['gl']) {
                    continue;
                }
                foreach ($free($la['gl']) as $p) {
                    if (! $p['tied'] && abs($la['amount'] + $lb['amount'] - $p['amount']) < 1.0 && $near($p, $la, -60, 60) && $near($p, $lb, -60, 60)) {
                        $used[$p['id']] = true;
                        foreach ([[$a, $lb], [$b, $la]] as [$li, $other]) {
                            $lines[$li]['postings'][] = ['shared' => true, 'amount' => $lines[$li]['amount']] + $p;
                            $lines[$li]['how'][] = $p['id'] . ': one posting of ' . number_format($p['amount'], 2) . " pays this fee and loan {$other['contract_id']}'s";
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // C. a fee and its corrections: two or three postings naming or tied to the loan, adding up
        foreach ($lines as $li => $l) {
            if ($l['postings'] !== []) {
                continue;
            }
            $pool = array_values(array_filter($free($l['gl']), fn ($p) => $near($p, $l, -self::COMBO_WINDOW, self::COMBO_WINDOW)
                && ($p['loan'] === $l['contract_id'] || $named($p, $l) || $p['amount'] < 0)));
            foreach ([2, 3] as $k) {
                foreach ($this->combinations($pool, $k) as $set) {
                    $mine = array_filter($set, fn ($p) => $p['loan'] === $l['contract_id'] || $named($p, $l));
                    if ($mine !== [] && $this->within(array_sum(array_column($set, 'amount')) - $l['amount'], $l['amount'], $tolerance)) {
                        $take($li, $set, 'with its corrections');
                        continue 3;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $conflicts = []; $ties = [];
        foreach ($lines as $li => $l) {
            if ($l['postings'] === []) {
                $refusals[] = ['row' => $l['row'], 'contract_id' => $l['contract_id'], 'amount' => $l['amount'],
                    'reason' => "No GL fee posting on {$l['gl']} accounts for this line (amount, date and loan or name)."];
                continue;
            }
            $sum = array_sum(array_map(fn ($p) => $p['shared'] ?? false ? $p['amount'] : $p['amount'], $l['postings']));
            $lines[$li]['difference'] = round($l['amount'] - $sum, 2);
            foreach ($l['postings'] as $p) {
                if ($p['tied'] && $p['loan'] !== $l['contract_id']) {
                    $conflicts[] = ['row' => $l['row'], 'contract_id' => $l['contract_id'], 'posting' => $p['id'], 'tied_to' => $p['loan'], 'amount' => $p['amount'],
                        'note' => "The system tied this posting to loan {$p['loan']} (the loan in its batch); the workbook puts it on loan {$l['contract_id']}. A person decides which is right."];
                } elseif (! $p['tied'] && ! ($p['shared'] ?? false)) {
                    $ties[] = ['held_id' => $p['held_id'], 'contract_id' => $l['contract_id'], 'row' => $l['row'], 'posting' => $p['id'], 'amount' => $p['amount']];
                }
            }
        }

        // completeness: the months each fee GL's matched postings span
        $coverage = [];
        foreach ($lines as $l) {
            foreach ($l['postings'] as $p) {
                $m = $p['date']->format('Y-m');
                $coverage[$p['gl']] = [min($coverage[$p['gl']][0] ?? $m, $m), max($coverage[$p['gl']][1] ?? $m, $m)];
            }
        }
        $unaccounted = [];
        foreach ($coverage as $gl => [$from, $to]) {
            $byMonth = [];
            foreach ($free((string) $gl) as $p) {
                $m = $p['date']->format('Y-m');
                if ($m >= $from && $m <= $to) {
                    $byMonth[$m][] = $p;
                }
            }
            foreach ($byMonth as $m => $ps) {
                $net = round(array_sum(array_column($ps, 'amount')), 2);
                $gross = array_sum(array_map(fn ($p) => abs($p['amount']), $ps));
                if (! $this->within($net, $gross, $tolerance)) {
                    $unaccounted[] = ['gl' => (string) $gl, 'month' => $m, 'net' => $net, 'postings' => array_map(fn ($p) => [
                        'posting' => $p['id'], 'date' => $p['date']->toDateString(), 'amount' => $p['amount'], 'loan' => $p['loan'], 'narration' => $p['narration']], $ps)];
                }
            }
        }
        foreach ($unaccounted as $u) {
            $refusals[] = ['row' => null, 'contract_id' => null, 'amount' => $u['net'],
                'reason' => "GL {$u['gl']}, {$u['month']}: " . count($u['postings']) . ' posting(s) netting ' . number_format($u['net'], 2) . ' are not in the file, so it leaves fees out: '
                    . implode('; ', array_map(fn ($p) => "{$p['posting']} {$p['date']} " . number_format($p['amount'], 2) . ' ' . mb_substr((string) $p['narration'], 0, 60), array_slice($u['postings'], 0, 8)))];
        }

        return [
            'status' => $refusals === [] ? 'PASS' : 'REFUSED',
            'refusals' => $refusals,
            'lines' => array_map(fn ($l) => array_diff_key($l, ['postings' => 1]) + ['postings' => array_map(fn ($p) => $p['id'], $l['postings'])], $lines),
            'unaccounted' => $unaccounted,
            'ties' => $ties,
            'conflicts' => $conflicts,
            'coverage' => $coverage,
            'tolerance' => $tolerance,
        ];
    }

    /** @return list<array{id:string, held_id:?int, tied:bool, loan:?string, gl:string, amount:float, date:CarbonImmutable, narration:string, programme:bool}> */
    private function postings(): array
    {
        $out = [];
        foreach (DB::table('contract_fees')->where('source_system', GlFeeBuildService::SOURCE)->get(['id', 'contract_id', 'gl_account_ref', 'amount', 'transaction_date', 'description']) as $r) {
            if ($r->transaction_date === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $out[] = ['id' => 'T' . $r->id, 'held_id' => null, 'tied' => true, 'loan' => (string) $r->contract_id, 'gl' => (string) $r->gl_account_ref,
                'amount' => (float) $r->amount, 'date' => CarbonImmutable::parse($r->transaction_date), 'narration' => (string) $r->description, 'programme' => false];
        }
        foreach (DB::table('fee_gl_unassigned')->get(['id', 'gl_code', 'amount', 'transaction_date', 'narration', 'candidate_contract_id', 'reason']) as $r) {
            $out[] = ['id' => 'H' . $r->id, 'held_id' => (int) $r->id, 'tied' => false, 'loan' => $r->candidate_contract_id ? ltrim((string) $r->candidate_contract_id, '0') : null,
                'gl' => (string) $r->gl_code, 'amount' => (float) $r->amount, 'date' => CarbonImmutable::parse($r->transaction_date), 'narration' => (string) $r->narration,
                'programme' => str_starts_with((string) $r->reason, 'MEGA_FARM')];
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /** @return array<string,string> loan => customer name (contract master, else the latest loan book) */
    private function names(array $contracts): array
    {
        $contracts = array_values(array_filter($contracts));
        if ($contracts === []) {
            return [];
        }
        $out = DB::table('loan_books')->whereIn('contract_id', $contracts)->where('customer_name', '<>', '')->orderBy('reporting_period')
            ->pluck('customer_name', 'contract_id')->all();
        foreach (DB::table('contract_eir')->whereIn('contract_id', $contracts)->where('customer_name', '<>', '')->pluck('customer_name', 'contract_id') as $c => $n) {
            $out[$c] = $n;
        }

        return array_map('strval', $out);
    }

    /** The distinctive words of a name or narration (three letters or more, common words and fee words left out). */
    private function tokens(?string $text): array
    {
        static $stop = ['limited', 'ltd', 'company', 'group', 'the', 'and', 'for', 'from', 'investment', 'investments', 'holdings', 'services', 'general',
            'farm', 'farms', 'trf', 'fees', 'fee', 'legal', 'arrangement', 'arrangment', 'loan', 'drawdown', 'mega', 'trading', 'sacco', 'africa', 'malawi',
            'enterprises', 'enterprise', 'international', 'being', 'reversal', 'reallocation', 'allocation', 'over', 'deducted', 'initial', 'drawn', 'down',
            'maiic', 'batch', 'one', 'account', 'debit', 'same', 'amount', 'own', 'repayment', 'insurance', 'guarantee'];
        preg_match_all('/[a-z]{3,}/', mb_strtolower((string) $text), $m);

        return array_values(array_diff(array_unique($m[0]), $stop));
    }

    private function sameCustomer(string $a, string $b): bool
    {
        return $a !== '' && $b !== '' && array_intersect($this->tokens($a), $this->tokens($b)) !== [];
    }

    private function date(mixed $value): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        if ($value === null || trim((string) $value) === '') {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            return CarbonImmutable::parse((string) $value)->startOfDay();
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** The reconciliation band in force (recon_tolerance); to the cent when none is set (fail closed). */
    private function tolerance(): array
    {
        try {
            return $this->governance->reconciliationTolerance();
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return ['percent' => 0.0, 'floor' => 0.01];
        }
    }

    private function within(float $difference, ?float $base, array $tolerance): bool
    {
        return abs($difference) <= max((float) $tolerance['floor'], abs((float) $base) * (float) $tolerance['percent'] / 100) + 0.005;
    }

    /** @return \Generator<list<array>> */
    private function combinations(array $items, int $k, int $start = 0, array $prefix = []): \Generator
    {
        if (count($prefix) === $k) {
            yield $prefix;

            return;
        }
        for ($i = $start; $i < count($items); $i++) {
            yield from $this->combinations($items, $k, $i + 1, [...$prefix, $items[$i]]);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Eir;

use App\Jobs\ProcessEirImportJob;
use App\Models\Import;
use App\Services\Eir\FeeWorkbookTieOut;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Finance's fee workbook is loaded only when it ties to the GL fee postings
 * (15 October 2026): every line accounted for by a posting, every posting of the
 * months it covers accounted for by a line, and each held posting a line
 * accounts for tied to that line's loan.
 */
class FeeWorkbookTieOutTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const GL = 'E-Banker GL fee posting';

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        DB::table('contract_fees')->delete();
        DB::table('fee_gl_unassigned')->delete();
        foreach ([['104430000201', 'ACME MILLING LIMITED'], ['104430000202', 'BETA FARMS LIMITED'], ['104430000203', 'GAMMA TRADERS']] as [$id, $name]) {
            DB::table('loan_books')->insert(['contract_id' => $id, 'customer_name' => $name, 'reporting_period' => '2025-06', 'reporting_year' => 2025, 'reporting_month' => 6,
                'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
        }
    }

    private function held(string $gl, float $amount, string $date, string $narration, ?string $candidate = null): int
    {
        return DB::table('fee_gl_unassigned')->insertGetId(['external_transaction_id' => 'GL_04a:' . random_int(1, 9_999_999), 'transaction_date' => $date, 'batch' => 'TRF 1',
            'gl_code' => $gl, 'amount' => $amount, 'narration' => $narration, 'reason' => 'NO_LOAN_IN_BATCH: no loan account is a leg of the batch', 'loans_in_batch' => '[]',
            'candidate_contract_id' => $candidate, 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
    }

    private function tied(string $loan, string $gl, float $amount, string $date): void
    {
        DB::table('contract_fees')->insert(['contract_id' => $loan, 'fee_type' => $gl === '4871' ? 'legal' : 'arrangement', 'amount' => $amount, 'transaction_date' => $date,
            'cashflow_direction' => 'RECEIVED', 'source_system' => self::GL, 'external_transaction_id' => 'GL_04a:' . random_int(1, 9_999_999), 'gl_account_ref' => $gl,
            'description' => 'By Trf fees (GL ' . $gl . ', one loan in the batch)', 'classification_status' => 'PENDING', 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);
    }

    private function row(string $loan, string $type, float $amount, string $date): array
    {
        return ['contract_id' => $loan, 'fee_type' => $type, 'amount' => $amount, 'transaction_date' => $date, 'cashflow_direction' => 'RECEIVED'];
    }

    public function test_a_workbook_that_ties_passes_and_names_the_held_postings_to_tie(): void
    {
        $h = $this->held('4871', 1_000_000, '2025-06-10', 'By Trf Acme Milling legal fees');
        $this->tied('104430000202', '4873', 2_000_000, '2025-06-12');

        $r = app(FeeWorkbookTieOut::class)->check([
            $this->row('104430000201', 'legal', 1_000_000, '2025-06-01'),
            $this->row('104430000202', 'arrangement', 2_000_000, '2025-06-01'),
        ]);

        $this->assertSame('PASS', $r['status'], json_encode($r['refusals']));
        $this->assertSame([['held_id' => $h, 'contract_id' => '104430000201', 'row' => 2, 'posting' => 'H' . $h, 'amount' => 1_000_000.0]], $r['ties']);
    }

    public function test_a_line_no_posting_accounts_for_and_a_posting_left_out_each_refuse_the_file(): void
    {
        $this->held('4871', 1_000_000, '2025-06-10', 'By Trf Acme Milling legal fees');
        $this->held('4871', 750_000, '2025-06-20', 'By Trf Delta legal fees'); // in the month, in no line

        $r = app(FeeWorkbookTieOut::class)->check([
            $this->row('104430000201', 'legal', 1_000_000, '2025-06-01'),
            $this->row('104430000203', 'legal', 400_000, '2025-06-01'), // no posting
        ]);

        $this->assertSame('REFUSED', $r['status']);
        $reasons = implode(' | ', array_column($r['refusals'], 'reason'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('No GL fee posting on 4871 accounts for this line', $reasons);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('GL 4871, 2025-06: 1 posting(s) netting 750,000.00 are not in the file', $reasons);
    }

    public function test_take_on_loans_lines_before_the_first_posting_and_undated_lines_are_refused(): void
    {
        $this->held('4871', 1_000_000, '2025-06-10', 'By Trf Acme Milling legal fees');
        DB::table('contract_fees')->insert(['contract_id' => '104430000203', 'fee_type' => 'legal', 'amount' => 5_000, 'source_system' => 'TAKEON_WORKBOOK',
            'classification_status' => 'PENDING', 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()]);

        $r = app(FeeWorkbookTieOut::class)->check([
            $this->row('104430000203', 'legal', 5_000, '2025-06-01'),
            $this->row('104430000201', 'legal', 1_000_000, '2024-01-15'),
            ['contract_id' => '104430000202', 'fee_type' => 'legal', 'amount' => 9_000],
        ]);

        $reasons = array_column($r['refusals'], 'reason');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('take-on loan', $reasons[0]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('before the first GL fee posting', $reasons[1]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('No date', $reasons[2]);
    }

    public function test_one_posting_for_two_loans_a_fee_in_parts_and_a_reversal_across_months_are_recognised(): void
    {
        $shared = $this->held('4873', 3_000_000, '2025-06-02', 'By Trf arrangement fees');
        $this->tied('104430000203', '4871', 5_900_000, '2025-07-08');
        $this->tied('104430000203', '4871', 900, '2025-07-08');
        $this->held('4871', 250_000, '2025-07-09', 'By Trf legal fees');      // posted in July ...
        $this->held('4871', -250_000, '2025-09-30', 'To Trf reversal');       // ... and reversed in September

        $r = app(FeeWorkbookTieOut::class)->check([
            $this->row('104430000201', 'arrangement', 1_000_000, '2025-06-10'),
            $this->row('104430000202', 'arrangement', 2_000_000, '2025-06-10'),
            $this->row('104430000203', 'legal', 5_900_900, '2025-07-05'),
        ]);

        $this->assertSame('PASS', $r['status'], json_encode($r['refusals']));
        $this->assertSame([], $r['ties'], 'a posting that pays two loans is not tied to either');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('pays this fee and loan 104430000202', $r['lines'][0]['how'][0]);
        $this->assertCount(2, $r['lines'][2]['postings'], 'the fee posted in two parts');
        $this->assertSame(0.0, $r['lines'][2]['difference']);
    }

    public function test_the_import_job_refuses_a_file_that_does_not_tie_and_loads_and_ties_one_that_does(): void
    {
        Storage::fake();
        Storage::fake('public');
        $h = $this->held('4871', 1_000_000, '2025-06-10', 'By Trf Acme Milling legal fees');
        $map = ['contract_id' => 'contract_id', 'fee_type' => 'fee_type', 'amount' => 'amount', 'transaction_date' => 'transaction_date', 'cashflow_direction' => 'cashflow_direction'];
        $run = function (array $lines) use ($map): Import {
            $import = Import::create(['kind' => 'eir_intake', 'name' => 'EIR fees: test', 'status' => 'pending']);
            $csv = "contract_id,fee_type,amount,transaction_date,cashflow_direction\n" . implode("\n", $lines) . "\n";
            Storage::put("temp-imports/fees_{$import->id}.csv", $csv);
            (new ProcessEirImportJob($import->id, "temp-imports/fees_{$import->id}.csv", 'fees.csv', 'fees', $map, [], null))->handle(...array_map(fn ($c) => app($c), [
                \App\Services\Imports\MappedFileReader::class, \App\Services\Eir\ScheduleImportService::class, \App\Services\Eir\FeeImportService::class,
                \App\Services\Eir\ContractTransactionImportService::class, \App\Services\Eir\ContractMasterImportService::class, \App\Services\Eir\GlInterestImportService::class,
                \App\Services\Eir\ReferenceRateImportService::class, \App\Services\Eir\DisbursementImportService::class, \App\Services\Eir\FeeGlReconciliationService::class,
                FeeWorkbookTieOut::class, \App\Services\Ebanker\GlFeeBuildService::class, \App\Services\Eir\FeeSourcePrecedence::class,
            ]));

            return $import->fresh();
        };

        $refused = $run(['104430000201,legal,1200000,2025-06-01,RECEIVED']);
        $this->assertSame('failed', $refused->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('contract_fees')->count(), 'nothing loads from a file that does not tie');
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('fee_gl_unassigned')->count());

        $loaded = $run(['104430000201,legal,1000000,2025-06-01,RECEIVED']);
        $this->assertSame('completed', $loaded->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('fee_gl_unassigned')->where('id', $h)->count(), 'the held posting is tied');
        $lines = DB::table('contract_fees')->where('contract_id', '104430000201')->orderBy('id')->get();
        $this->assertSame([self::GL, null], [$lines[1]->source_system ?? $lines[0]->source_system, null]);
        $this->assertCount(2, $lines, 'the workbook line and the GL posting now on the loan');
        $this->assertSame(1, $lines->whereNotNull('superseded_by_source')->count(), 'one source of record per loan (fee_source_precedence)');
    }
}

24:                . '<p>The tab row sits under the breadcrumb at the top of every one of these screens, so you can move between them without returning to the sidebar. The import screen, <b>EIR Data Intake</b>, has no menu entry of its own: it opens from the <b>EIR Data Intake</b> button on the EIR Data tabs and from the import buttons on Drawdowns, Reference Rates and Fee Classification. The <b>Governance Centre</b>, where the calculation conventions are kept, is under <b>Administration &amp; support</b>, <b>Governance</b>.</p>'
25:                . '<h4>Who can see what</h4><ul><li><b>eir.view</b> opens the EIR Data tabs, Coverage (Blockers, Coverage by Portfolio, Largest Facilities), EIR as at a Date and GL Reconciliation.</li><li><b>settings</b> opens Accounting Rules, Fee Classification, Calculations and EIR Data Intake, and is needed to generate or approve a schedule and to run the revenue from GL Reconciliation.</li><li><b>eir.govern</b> is needed to upload a trial balance, to propose or approve a write-off, a restructure or a rate reset, to tie a held GL fee line to its loan, and to open the Governance Centre.</li><li><b>eir.export</b> is needed for the Excel and PDF downloads of GL Reconciliation.</li><li><b>eir.fees.import</b> alone opens EIR Data Intake on the fee type only, and Fee Classification to read.</li></ul>'
26:                . '<h4>The pipeline, in order</h4><ol><li><b>Data.</b> The contract master (Extract A), the cash flows, the drawdowns, the prime lending rate series, the trial balance and the fees are loaded, mostly from the E-Banker pack and EIR Data Intake.</li><li><b>Write-offs, restructures and resets.</b> Write-offs the ledger carries are recognised automatically; others are proposed and approved in the register. Changes of terms are found as candidates and confirmed by two people.</li><li><b>Fee rules and classification.</b> The accounting rulebook suggests whether a fee is integral to the EIR; every fee line is classified by one person and reviewed by another.</li><li><b>Schedule review.</b> The original repayment schedule (version 1) is generated and approved by a second person on Schedule Review.</li><li><b>Readiness.</b> Before a contract can be solved its terms, schedule and fees are checked. A contract is ready or blocked, and every blocker has a code and a plain-English message (Blockers tab).</li><li><b>Calculation and lock.</b> Calculations solves the rate; a second person approves and locks it.</li><li><b>Monthly revenue.</b> The month-end run rolls each locked loan forward one month: opening balance, interest at the EIR, cash received, closing balance.</li><li><b>Reconciliation and reporting.</b> GL Reconciliation sets the calculated interest against the ledger and names the cause of each difference; EIR as at a Date gives the book at any date.</li></ol>'
28:                . '<h4>Locked periods</h4><p>Once a month is locked (Imports &amp; Feeds, Periods Built), nothing that would change it is accepted: the revenue run, a write-off, a rate reset, reversing a restructure and reopening an EIR are all refused with the message "Reporting period ... is locked: ... cannot be written."</p>'
58:                . '<h4>The Cash Flows table</h4><p>Columns <b>Contract</b> (with the customer beneath), <b>Version</b> (v1 is the original schedule; v2 and later are loaded by an approved restructure), <b>Due date</b>, <b>Principal</b>, <b>Interest</b>, <b>Fees</b>, <b>Total due</b> and <b>Source</b> (GENERATED, TAKEON_WORKBOOK or the source system, with the source reference beneath). Rows are in contract and due-date order. The search matches the contract number and the source reference.</p>'
60:                . '<h4>Buttons and icons</h4><ul><li><b>EIR Data Intake</b> (top right): opens the import screen. It needs the <b>settings</b> permission (or <b>eir.fees.import</b> for fees only).</li><li><b>Calculate EIR</b> (top right): opens EIR Calculations, Calculations; it needs <b>settings</b>.</li><li><b>Search</b>: applies the search box.</li></ul><p>The Contract Master and Cash Flows tabs only read; nothing on them changes a record.</p>'
92:                . '<h4>The register built from the ledger</h4><p>The bootstrap also builds the register from E-Banker\'s ledger: one row per drawdown date, from the type-301 postings. A fee capitalised into the loan is added to the drawdown of its date (the <b>Of which capitalised fees</b> column), never a tranche of its own. The opening balance posted at the take-on of 31 July 2024 is the migration, not money lent that day. A rebuild replaces only the rows an earlier build wrote (references starting CUMVOUCH:); rows loaded from a file are left alone.</p>'
135:            'body' => '<p>Trial Balances holds Finance\'s monthly E-Banker trial balance, which the GL reconciliation, the fee GL check and the bridge to the annual financial statements read. Each file is loaded through the landing zone\'s gates, so an auditor can see the exact file every GL figure came from. In the sidebar, under <b>Financial modelling</b>, open <b>EIR &amp; Revenue Recognition</b>, choose <b>EIR Data</b> and then the <b>Trial Balances</b> tab (breadcrumb: Financial modelling &gt; EIR &amp; Revenue Recognition &gt; EIR Data &gt; Trial Balances). Anyone with <b>eir.view</b> can read it; uploading needs <b>eir.govern</b>.</p>'
145:                . '<h4>What happens next</h4><p>A landed file is kept with its SHA-256 fingerprint; its GL lines are then written to the GL side read by the reconciliation and the fee GL check. Within a month and basis the zone holds, the GL lines become exactly the landed file: a corrected file for a month already held replaces that month\'s lines, and the earlier version stays in the landing zone. A month the landing zone does not hold at all (loaded before the landing zone existed, for example by the older import) is left as it is, so uploading one month never changes or empties any other month. Loading the same file twice changes nothing. Each load is written to the audit log.</p>'
177:                . '<h4>Common problems</h4><ul><li><b>"The person who proposed a write-off cannot approve it."</b> Ask a colleague with eir.govern.</li><li><b>"Contract n already has a write-off proposed or approved in the register."</b> Only one open entry per loan.</li><li><b>"Contract n is not in the loan book."</b> Check the contract number.</li><li><b>"Reporting period ... is locked: a write-off cannot be written."</b> The month is closed; unlock it with a reason on Imports &amp; Feeds, Periods Built, only if the restatement is deliberate.</li><li><b>"Only the person who proposed a write-off can withdraw it, and only before it is approved."</b> and <b>"Only an approved write-off can be reversed."</b></li></ul>',
288:            'body' => '<p>EIR Data Intake loads the files the EIR module runs on: the contract master (Extract A), repayment schedules, fees, contract transactions (Extract B), GL interest postings (Extract C), the reference-rate series and the drawdowns. The platform recognises the columns from its built-in aliases and any saved mapping, checks the whole file, and runs the import in the background. It has no menu entry: open <b>EIR Data</b> and press <b>EIR Data Intake</b> at the top right, or use <b>Import drawdowns</b>, <b>Import reference rates</b> or <b>Import fees</b> on those screens, which open it on the matching type. It needs the <b>settings</b> permission; a user with only <b>eir.fees.import</b> sees the fee type and nothing else.</p>'
