### 7.8.8 Finance's workbook proved against the GL postings (added 15 October 2026)

On 15 October 2026 Finance's two workbooks were reconciled to the fee GLs posting by posting. The 2024 file (the version of the December 2025 assessment that holds every loan tested) agrees for all 33 loans drawn in 2023 and 2024, 65 lines, with no difference; the old ledger (`CUMVOUCH_BK240824`) carries January to July 2024 and E-Banker (`GL_04`) from 3 October 2024, with no fee posting in between. The 2025 file (34 loans) agrees with the GL totals except 800 on Chikwendeni's legal fee (1,808,000 against 1,808,800), and supplies the loan for the 29 held "By Trf" postings the batch cannot place. On that evidence the workbook becomes the record of whose fee each posting is, but only through a gate, never by trust (`FeeWorkbookTieOut`, run by the EIR Data Intake import of type fees before anything loads):

1. Every line needs its loan, its date and a fee GL (`gl_account_ref`, or 4873 and 4871 for arrangement and legal fees). A line for a take-on loan is refused (those fees come from the take-on workbook and never compete, so a second copy would count twice), as is a line dated before the first `GL_04` posting held.
2. Every line must be accounted for by the postings: to the unit first (a posting tied to the loan, a held posting whose candidate is the loan, a held posting naming the customer, a fee in two or three parts or with its corrections, one held posting paying two lines' fees, the same amount near the date with no name, a posting the system tied to another loan of the same customer), then within `recon_tolerance`.
3. The file must be complete: for each fee GL it reaches, the postings of the months from its first to its last matched posting that no line accounts for must net to nil (a posting and its reversal cancel, in whichever months they fall). Mega Farm programme postings (held as `MEGA_FARM`, decision D30) are outside both sides.
4. Any failure refuses the whole file; the exception file lists every reason. A file that ties loads, and each held posting a single line accounts for is tied to that line's loan through `GlFeeBuildService::assignHeld`, with the file and row as the reason, all in one transaction; `fee_source_precedence` is then applied. A posting paying two loans is not tied (it cannot be split): the workbook line stands for each loan. Matches on amount and date only, differences within the band and postings the system had tied to another loan are written to the exception file as notes for Finance.

Run against the December 2025 file on 15 October 2026 (read only): PASS, 67 lines, 27 held postings to tie, two conflicts (Mthirakuwiri's 19 June 2025 fees, tied by the batch to 104430000077, which the workbook puts on 104460000110) and Chikwendeni's 800 within the band. Changing `fee_source_precedence` to "Finance workbook first" remains MAIIC's decision in the Governance Centre; with the gate in place it changes no amount the GL does not already support.

        "        $takeon = [];\n"
        "        foreach (DB::table('contract_fees')->where('source_system', FeeSourcePrecedence::SOURCE_TAKEON)->get(['contract_id', 'fee_type', 'amount']) as $t) {\n"
        "            $takeon[$t->contract_id][strtolower((string) $t->fee_type)][] = (float) $t->amount;\n"
        "        }\n")
old2 = """                isset($takeon[$contract]) => "Loan {$contract} is a take-on loan: its fees come from the take-on workbook, so loading them here would count them twice.","""
new2 = """                $this->repeatsTakeon($takeon[$contract][$line['fee_type']] ?? [], $amount, $tolerance) => "Loan {$contract} is a take-on loan and the take-on workbook already holds this {$line['fee_type']} fee: loading it here would count it twice.","""
assert old1 in s and old2 in s
s = s.replace(old1, new1).replace(old2, new2)
old3 = "    private function sameCustomer(string $a, string $b): bool"
new3 = """    /** Whether a line repeats a fee of the take-on workbook: the same loan and type, the same amount within the band. */
    private function repeatsTakeon(array $amounts, float $amount, array $tolerance): bool
    {
        foreach ($amounts as $a) {
            if ($this->within($a - $amount, $a, $tolerance)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function sameCustomer(string $a, string $b): bool"""

 *    would count twice);""", """ *  - it repeats a fee the take-on workbook holds for its loan (same type, same

 *    compete under fee_source_precedence, so a second copy would count twice.
 *    A later fee on a take-on loan (posted after the migration) is proved like any other;""")
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)

"""Pre-filled fee workbook uploads for Finance (15 Oct 2026): the 2025 file ready to load through EIR Data Intake (type fees),
and October-December 2024 to complete. Each is run through the system's gate (FeeWorkbookTieOut, read only) first."""
import csv, json, subprocess, sys, datetime, os
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

OUTDIR = sys.argv[1]
S = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
APP = r"C:\xampp\htdocs\MAICC-IFRS9"
FIN25 = r"C:\Users\DELL\OneDrive\2026\Projects\MAIIC\2. Documents from clients\EIR Assesment\MAIIC EIR Assessment as of 31st December 2025 with account numbers.xlsx"
FIN24 = r"C:\Users\DELL\OneDrive\2026\Projects\MAIIC\2. Documents from clients\EIR Assesment\MAIIC EIR Assessment as of 31st December 2025.xlsx"
COLS = ["contract_id", "fee_type", "amount", "transaction_date", "gl_account_ref", "cashflow_direction", "currency", "description",
        "source_system", "source_reference", "external_transaction_id"]
GL = {"legal": "4871", "arrangement": "4873"}


def gate(rows, tag):
    a, b = os.path.join(S, f"gate_{tag}_in.json"), os.path.join(S, f"gate_{tag}_out.json")
    json.dump(rows, open(a, "w"))
    subprocess.run(["php", os.path.join(S, "tieout_json.php"), a, b], cwd=APP, check=True)
    return json.load(open(b))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2025: Finance's file with account numbers
ws = openpyxl.load_workbook(FIN25, data_only=True).active
rows25, meta25 = [], []
for i, r in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(min_row=5, values_only=True), 5):
    if not r[3] or not str(r[3]).strip().isdigit():
        continue
    vd = r[7] if not isinstance(r[7], str) else datetime.datetime.strptime(r[7].strip(), "%d/%m/%Y")
    for t, col in (("legal", 18), ("arrangement", 20)):
        if not r[col]:
            continue
        rows25.append({"contract_id": str(r[3]).strip(), "fee_type": t, "amount": round(float(r[col]), 2), "transaction_date": vd.date().isoformat(),
                       "gl_account_ref": GL[t], "cashflow_direction": "RECEIVED", "currency": "MWK",
                       "description": f"{t.title()} fee, {str(r[5] or r[4]).strip()} (Finance EIR assessment 31 Dec 2025)",
                       "source_system": "MAIIC Finance EIR assessment 2025",
                       "source_reference": f"MAIIC EIR Assessment as of 31st December 2025 with account numbers.xlsx, row {i}",
                       "external_transaction_id": f"FIN-EIR2025-R{i}-{t.upper()}"})
        meta25.append({"customer": str(r[5] or r[4]).strip(), "row": i})
g25 = gate(rows25, "2025")
notes25 = {}
for l in g25["lines"]:
    notes25[l["row"]] = ("; ".join(l["how"]), l.get("difference", 0))
conf25 = {c["row"]: c["note"] for c in g25["conflicts"]}
tie25 = {t["row"]: t["posting"] for t in g25["ties"]}
csv25 = os.path.join(OUTDIR, "MAIIC fee workbook upload - 2025 - ready - 15 Oct 2026.csv")
with open(csv25, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=COLS)
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(rows25)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Oct-Dec 2024: Finance's lines of loans drawn in the E-Banker period
ws = openpyxl.load_workbook(FIN24, data_only=True)["EIR Assessment December 2025"]
ACCT = {  # name in Finance's file -> (account, basis)
    "Agwenda Investment Limited": ("104430000064", "tied by the system (the loan in the batch)"),
    "Eye Care Centre Limited": ("104460000105", "the system's candidate loan (name and drawdown date)"),
    "Microloan Foundation Officer": ("104430000069", "tied by the system (the loan in the batch)"),
    "Chimwemwe Mafeni Transport": ("104460000104", "tied by the system (the loan in the batch)"),
    "NyamNyam Processors Limited": ("104430000068", "TO CONFIRM: 'Nyamunyamu processors limited', in the loan book from November 2024 (MWK 200m); 104430000067 'Nyamnyam processors limited' was opened 20 Nov 2024"),
    "Premium Foods Limited": ("104460000107", "TO CONFIRM: 'Premium meat suppliers', opened 31 Dec 2024 (MWK 75m); 105810000002 of the same name was opened 19 Dec 2024"),
    "Kwalingana Investments Limited": ("", "NEEDED: no E-Banker account under this name"),
    "Napoleon dzombe T/A Santhe Business Park": ("", "NEEDED: no E-Banker account under this name"),
}
rows24, meta24 = [], []
for i, r in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(min_row=5, values_only=True), 5):
    name, vd = (str(r[4]).strip() if r[4] else None), r[6]
    if not name or not isinstance(vd, datetime.datetime) or vd.date() < datetime.date(2024, 10, 1) or vd.year > 2024:
        continue
    acct, basis = ACCT.get(name, ("", "NEEDED"))
    for t, col in (("legal", 17), ("arrangement", 19)):
        if not r[col]:
            continue
        rows24.append({"contract_id": acct, "fee_type": t, "amount": round(float(r[col]), 2), "transaction_date": vd.date().isoformat(),
                       "gl_account_ref": GL[t], "cashflow_direction": "RECEIVED", "currency": "MWK",
                       "description": f"{t.title()} fee, {name} (Finance EIR assessment, all loans tested)",
                       "source_system": "MAIIC Finance EIR assessment 2025", "source_reference": f"MAIIC EIR Assessment as of 31st December 2025.xlsx, row {i}",
                       "external_transaction_id": f"FIN-EIR2024-R{i}-{t.upper()}"})
        meta24.append({"customer": name, "basis": basis})
g24 = gate(rows24, "2024q4")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the review workbook
TEAL = "1F5C66"; HDR = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF"); HF = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=TEAL)
RED = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FDE2E1"); AMB = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFF4CC"); GRN = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="E2F0D9")
Q = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F8CBAD")
WRAP = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top"); NUM = "#,##0.00"; LINE = Border(bottom=Side(style="thin", color="DDDDDD"))


def table(ws, headers, data, widths, numcols=(), start=1, inputs=()):
    for c, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
        x = ws.cell(row=start, column=c, value=h); x.font = HDR if h not in inputs else Font(bold=True); x.fill = HF if h not in inputs else AMB; x.alignment = WRAP
    for i, row in enumerate(data, start + 1):
        for c, v in enumerate(row, 1):
            x = ws.cell(row=i, column=c, value=v); x.alignment = WRAP; x.border = LINE
            if headers[c - 1] in numcols: x.number_format = NUM
            if headers[c - 1] in inputs: x.fill = AMB
    for c, w in enumerate(widths, 1):
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(c)].width = w
    ws.row_dimensions[start].height = 32
    ws.freeze_panes = ws.cell(row=start + 1, column=3)
    ws.auto_filter.ref = f"A{start}:{get_column_letter(len(headers))}{start + len(data)}"


wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active; ws.title = "Read me"
txt = [
    ("MAIIC fee workbook: the files to upload", "t"),
    ("Prepared by Dupleix Institute for MAIIC Finance, 15 October 2026. The IFRS 9 system now loads Finance's fee workbook only when it ties to the GL fee postings, line by line and month by month. These are Finance's own figures, put in the layout the system's fee import reads.", None),
    ("", None),
    ("1. 2025: ready to load", "h"),
    (f"File: '{os.path.basename(csv25)}' ({len(rows25)} lines, from 'MAIIC EIR Assessment as of 31st December 2025 with account numbers.xlsx'). Checked against the system's gate today: {g25['status']}. "
     f"On loading, {len(g25['ties'])} GL postings the system holds without a loan are tied to their loans. Please read the '2025 lines' sheet before loading, in particular the matches made on amount and date only, the two Mthirakuwiri postings and Q1 (Chikwendeni).", None),
    ("How to load: EIR & Revenue Recognition > EIR Data > EIR Data Intake (or Fee Classification > Import fees), type 'Fees and transaction costs', choose the CSV, check the column mapping (each column has the system's own name), Check file, then Import. If the gate refuses the file, nothing loads and the exception file in the import history says why.", None),
    ("", None),
    ("2. October to December 2024: to complete before loading", "h"),
    (f"Finance's lines for the {len({m['customer'] for m in meta24})} loans drawn from October 2024 (from 'MAIIC EIR Assessment as of 31st December 2025.xlsx', which has no account numbers). Gate today: {g24['status']}, for two reasons, both on the '2024 Oct-Dec' sheet: "
     "four loans need their E-Banker account confirmed or given, and November 2024 has GL fee postings that are not in Finance's file (other loans' fees and reallocation journals). The system needs every fee posting of a month in the file, so please say whose each one is (or that it is not a loan fee).", None),
    ("", None),
    ("3. Loans drawn before October 2024", "h"),
    ("Their fees are in the take-on workbook MAIIC completed on 13 October 2026 and stay there; the system refuses a line that repeats one. E-Banker holds no fee posting before 3 October 2024.", None),
]
for i, (t, k) in enumerate(txt, 1):
    x = ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=t); x.alignment = WRAP
    if k == "t": x.font = Font(bold=True, size=14, color=TEAL)
    if k == "h": x.font = Font(bold=True, color=TEAL)
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 120

ws = wb.create_sheet("2025 lines")
H = ["CSV row", "Loan", "Customer", "Fee", "Amount (MWK)", "Date", "How the system matched it", "Difference (MWK)", "Held posting tied on loading", "To look at", "Finance: OK to load?", "Comment"]
data = []
for k, (row, m) in enumerate(zip(rows25, meta25), 2):
    how, diff = notes25.get(k, ("", 0))
    look = []
    if "no name" in how: look.append("Matched on amount and date only: please confirm the loan")
    if k in conf25: look.append(conf25[k])
    if row["contract_id"].lstrip("0") == "106050000002" and row["fee_type"] == "legal": look.append("Q1 FOR TAMANDA: 1,808,000 here, 1,808,800 on GL 4871, 4,830,000 in the loan system")
    data.append([k, row["contract_id"], m["customer"], row["fee_type"].title(), row["amount"], row["transaction_date"], how, diff or None, tie25.get(k), "; ".join(look) or None, None, None])
table(ws, H, data, [7, 16, 28, 11, 15, 11, 50, 12, 12, 50, 12, 28], numcols=("Amount (MWK)", "Difference (MWK)"), inputs=("Finance: OK to load?", "Comment"))
for i, row in enumerate(data, 2):
    if row[9]:
        ws.cell(row=i, column=10).fill = Q if "Q1" in row[9] else RED

ws = wb.create_sheet("2024 Oct-Dec")
H = ["File row", "Loan (E-Banker account)", "Customer", "Fee", "Amount (MWK)", "Value date", "Where the account comes from", "Gate today", "Finance: account", "Comment"]
ref24 = {r["row"]: r["reason"] for r in g24["refusals"] if r["row"]}
how24 = {l["row"]: "; ".join(l["how"]) for l in g24["lines"]}
data = []
for k, (row, m) in enumerate(zip(rows24, meta24), 2):
    data.append([k, row["contract_id"] or None, m["customer"], row["fee_type"].title(), row["amount"], row["transaction_date"], m["basis"],
                 ref24.get(k) or how24.get(k) or "", None, None])
table(ws, H, data, [7, 18, 32, 11, 15, 11, 50, 50, 18, 28], numcols=("Amount (MWK)",), inputs=("Finance: account", "Comment"))
for i, row in enumerate(data, 2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=7).fill = GRN if not ("NEEDED" in row[6] or "CONFIRM" in row[6]) else (RED if "NEEDED" in row[6] else AMB)
r0 = len(data) + 4
ws.cell(row=r0, column=1, value="GL fee postings of October to December 2024 that are in none of Finance's lines (the system needs each one accounted for)").font = Font(bold=True, color=TEAL)
H2 = ["Posting", "Date", "GL", "Amount (MWK)", "Narration", "Loan the system has or the name suggests", "Finance: whose fee is it (loan), or why it is not a loan fee"]
NAMEHINT = {"rose harris": "104450000047 Rose Harris Investment (opened 2022)", "mawindo": "104450000026 Mawindo Enterprise (opened 2022)",
            "kaning": "104450000048 Kaning'a General Dealer (take-on loan)", "chikwendeni": "104450000028 Chikwendeni General Dealers (opened 2022)",
            "santhe": "Santhe (no E-Banker account found)", "kwalingana": "Kwalingana (no E-Banker account found)", "nyamnyam": "104430000068 or 104430000067 (NyamNyam)"}
lst = []
for u in g24["unaccounted"]:
    for p in u["postings"]:
        n = (p["narration"] or "").lower()
        hint = p["loan"] or next((v for k2, v in NAMEHINT.items() if k2 in n), "")
        lst.append([p["posting"], p["date"], u["gl"], p["amount"], p["narration"], hint, None])
for c, h in enumerate(H2, 1):
    x = ws.cell(row=r0 + 1, column=c, value=h); x.font = HDR if c < 7 else Font(bold=True); x.fill = HF if c < 7 else AMB; x.alignment = WRAP
for i, row in enumerate(lst, r0 + 2):
    for c, v in enumerate(row, 1):
        x = ws.cell(row=i, column=c, value=v); x.alignment = WRAP; x.border = LINE
        if c == 4: x.number_format = NUM
        if c == 7: x.fill = AMB
ws.cell(row=r0 + 2 + len(lst) + 1, column=1, value="A posting and its reversal (for example the 84,692,000 mis-posting of 30 November 2024 and its reversal) cancel and are not listed.").alignment = WRAP

out = os.path.join(OUTDIR, "MAIIC fee workbook uploads - for Finance - 15 Oct 2026.xlsx")
wb.save(out)
print("2025", g25["status"], len(rows25), "lines, ties", len(g25["ties"]), "conflicts", len(g25["conflicts"]))
print("2024q4", g24["status"], len(rows24), "lines; refusals", len(g24["refusals"]), "; unaccounted postings", sum(len(u["postings"]) for u in g24["unaccounted"]))
print(out); print(csv25)

````

            // the shipped text is versioned: with HELP_SEED_REFRESH=1 the seeded articles' body and steps are
            // brought up to date by chapter and title (an article a person authored in the system is left alone)
            if (! filter_var(config('maiic.help_seed_refresh'), FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOL)) {
                $this->command?->info('Manual already has content; seeder skipped (HELP_SEED_REFRESH=1 refreshes the shipped text).');

                return;
            }
            $refreshed = 0;
            foreach ($this->content() as $chapterTitle => $articles) {
                $category = HelpCategory::manual(self::MANUAL)->where('title', $chapterTitle)->first();
                if ($category === null) {
                    continue;
                }
                foreach ($articles as $title => $spec) {
                    $article = HelpArticle::where('help_category_id', $category->id)->where('title', $title)->first();
                    if ($article === null || $article->updated_by !== 'System seed') {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $article->update(['body' => $spec['body'] ?? '']);

## CLAUDE  (2026-10-15 06:19:51 UTC)

Written for: MAIIC Finance, for the two upload files and the review workbook. The rest of this message is for you.

The gate and the automatic loan links are built, and the 2025 file is ready for Finance to load. The October to December 2024 file can't load until Finance supplies the missing accounts and explains some November 2024 postings. I haven't loaded anything into production, because loading is Finance's step.

**What's built** (`336cca8` and `c343409`, pushed to the branch and master)
- **The gate.** Finance's fee file now has to tie to the GL fee postings before anything loads.
  - Every line must match a posting by amount, loan or customer name, and date. It still matches when one fee was posted in parts or corrected later, or when one posting paid two loans' fees.
  - Every fee posting in the months the file covers must be in the file. A posting and its reversal cancel out.
  - If anything fails, nothing loads and the exception file gives each reason.
- **Automatic loan links.** When the file passes, each "By Trf" posting the system couldn't place is tied to the loan Finance names, with an audit record. This replaces the manual "tie to loan" step.
- **The take-on rule.** I refuse only a line that repeats a fee the take-on workbook already holds. My first version refused every take-on loan, which would have blocked genuine later fees such as Kaning'a's November 2024 postings.
- **Tests and documents.** Five new tests, plus 34 in the related areas, all pass. The full suite has no failures beyond those that already fail on master. The import screen's instructions, the user manual (refreshed on production) and spec section 7.8.8 all describe the gate.

**Files for Finance**, in `MAIIC\3. Project Execution\Fees 2025 - workbook, GL and design`:
- **`MAIIC fee workbook upload - 2025 - ready - 15 Oct 2026.csv`** holds Finance's 67 lines in the import layout, and it passes the gate. I loaded it on a throwaway copy of production, which I've since dropped:
  - It loaded cleanly and tied 27 held postings to their loans.
  - Nothing was counted twice: 61 lines step aside for the matching GL lines.
  - A second load changed nothing.
- **`MAIIC fee workbook uploads - for Finance - 15 Oct 2026.xlsx`** explains the 2025 lines and what to check before loading. It also holds the October to December 2024 lines still to complete:
  - Kwalingana and Napoleon Dzombe T/A Santhe have no E-Banker account I could find.
  - NyamNyam (067 or 068) and Premium Foods ("Premium meat suppliers", 107) need confirming.
  - 16 November 2024 postings need Finance to say whose they are: Rose Harris, Mawindo, Chikwendeni's 2022 loan, NBS, and several reallocation journals.

**Chikwendeni's 800** is now Q1 on a "Questions for Tamanda" sheet at the front of the 2025 reconciliation workbook. Three figures disagree: 1,808,000 in Finance's file, 1,808,800 on the GL, and 4,830,000 in the loan system. The row is highlighted on the "By loan" sheet. It's also flagged in the upload file's notes.

**Still with MAIIC**
- **Mthirakuwiri.** The batch put the 19 June 2025 fees on loan 077, but Finance says they belong to loan 110. Until someone decides, loan 077 carries both its own fees and these.
- **Rule 8** in the fee rulebook still needs narrowing before it's approved. As written it treats the two "General dealers" customers' legal fees as not part of the EIR.
- Switching the governance setting to "Finance workbook first" is MAIIC's decision. With the gate in place, today's amounts don't change either way.

"""Scan a Claude Code session log for credentials and write a redacted copy (15 October 2026).

    python redact_session_log.py <session.jsonl> [<redacted copy.jsonl>]

Without a second argument it only reports what it found. The patterns cover GitHub tokens,
password= pairs (git credential output), bearer tokens, AWS and Google keys, private keys,
Laravel APP_KEYs, OpenAI-style keys, OAuth refresh tokens and client secrets.

import re
import sys
from collections import Counter

    "google key": r"AIza[0-9A-Za-z\-_]{35}",
    "private key": r"-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----",
    "app key": r"APP_KEY=base64:[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}",
    "sk key": r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}",
    "refresh token": r"refresh_token\\*\"?\s*[:=]\s*\\*\"?[A-Za-z0-9\-_./]{10,}",
    "client secret": r"client_secret\\*\"?\s*[:=]\s*\\*\"?[A-Za-z0-9\-_]{10,}",
}
RX = {k: re.compile(v) for k, v in PATTERNS.items()}


def redact(line: str, found: Counter) -> str:
    for k, rx in RX.items():
        def sub(m, k=k):
            found[k] += 1
            return f"[REDACTED {k}]"
        line = rx.sub(sub, line)
    return line


if __name__ == "__main__":
    src = sys.argv[1]
    dst = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
    found = Counter()
    out = open(dst, "w", encoding="utf-8") if dst else None
    with open(src, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for line in fh:
            red = redact(line, found)
            if out:
                out.write(red)
    if out:
        out.close()
    print("found:", dict(found) or "nothing")

"""Export the Claude Code session of 9 to 15 October 2026 (the UI rework, packs 8 to 10, the go-live build,
the production database and Finance's fees) to PDF and Markdown.

    python build_transcript_golive.py <output folder>

Same layout as build_transcript_integration.py (2026-10-14), with two differences for a log seven times
larger (114 MB): credentials are redacted (redact_session_log.py), and a tool input or result longer than
the cap keeps its beginning and end with the cut marked. The whole log, redacted, is kept beside the
transcript on OneDrive.
"""
import json, re, os, html, sys
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.platypus import BaseDocTemplate, PageTemplate, Frame, Paragraph, Spacer, Preformatted

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from redact_session_log import redact  # noqa: E402

SESSION = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".claude", "projects", "c--xampp-htdocs-Stress-Testing-App", "c9a0f915-2064-4f18-9b98-77857ef71421.jsonl")
OUTDIR = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "."
NAME = "Claude_Session_Transcript_UI_GoLive_and_Fees_2026-10-15"
TITLE = "Claude session transcript: MAIIC UI, go-live, production database and fees"
START_MARK = "pull all maic changes"
CAP_RESULT, CAP_INPUT = 12_000, 24_000
found = {}

rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(SESSION, encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]


def user_text(r):
    c = r.get("message", {}).get("content")
    if isinstance(c, str):
        return c
    return "\n".join(b.get("text", "") for b in c if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "text")


start = next(i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r.get("type") == "user" and START_MARK in user_text(r).lower())
end = len(rows)


def clean_user(t):
    for tag in ("system-reminder", "ide_opened_file", "ide_selection"):
        t = re.sub(rf"<{tag}>.*?</{tag}>", "", t, flags=re.S)
    return t.strip()


def result_text(content):
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    out = []
    for b in content or []:
        if b.get("type") == "text":
            out.append(b.get("text", ""))
        elif b.get("type") == "image":
            out.append("[image output: not reproduced in this transcript]")
    return "\n".join(out)


def cap(t, n):
    if len(t) <= n:
        return t
    head, tail = int(n * 0.75), int(n * 0.2)
    return t[:head] + f"\n\n[... {len(t) - head - tail:,} characters cut here; the full text is in the session log kept with this transcript ...]\n\n" + t[-tail:]


class _C(dict):
    def __missing__(self, k):
        return 0


counter = _C()


def safe(t):
    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter()
    t = redact(t, c)
    for k, v in c.items():
        counter[k] += v
    return t


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- collect events
events = []
tool_names = {}
for r in rows[start:end]:
    typ = r.get("type")
    if typ not in ("user", "assistant") or r.get("isMeta"):
        continue
    ts = (r.get("timestamp") or "")[:19].replace("T", " ")
    if r.get("isCompactSummary"):
        events.append(("note", f"Context summary written when the conversation was compacted  ({ts} UTC)", safe(cap(user_text(r), CAP_RESULT))))
        continue
    c = r.get("message", {}).get("content")
    blocks = [{"type": "text", "text": c}] if isinstance(c, str) else (c or [])
    for b in blocks:
        bt = b.get("type")
        if typ == "user" and bt == "text":
            raw = b.get("text", "")
            if "<task-notification>" in raw or "SYSTEM NOTIFICATION" in raw:
                events.append(("note", f"System notification  ({ts} UTC)", safe(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", clean_user(raw)).strip())))
                continue
            t = clean_user(raw)
            if t:
                events.append(("user", f"USER  ({ts} UTC)", safe(t)))
        elif typ == "user" and bt == "tool_result":
            name = tool_names.get(b.get("tool_use_id"), "tool")
            body = re.sub(r"<system-reminder>.*?</system-reminder>", "", result_text(b.get("content")), flags=re.S).rstrip()
            events.append(("result", f"Result of {name}" + ("  [error]" if b.get("is_error") else ""), safe(cap(body, CAP_RESULT)) or "(no output)"))
        elif typ == "assistant" and bt == "text":
            if b.get("text", "").strip():
                events.append(("assistant", f"CLAUDE  ({ts} UTC)", safe(b["text"].strip())))
        elif typ == "assistant" and bt == "tool_use":
            tool_names[b.get("id")] = b.get("name")
            inp = b.get("input", {})
            parts = []
            for k in ("description", "file_path", "path", "pattern", "skill", "offset", "limit"):
                if k in inp:
                    parts.append(f"{k}: {inp[k]}")
            for k in ("command", "content", "old_string", "new_string", "prompt", "script"):
                if k in inp:
                    parts.append(f"--- {k} ---\n{inp[k]}")
            other = {k: v for k, v in inp.items() if k not in ("description", "file_path", "path", "pattern", "skill", "offset", "limit", "command", "content", "old_string", "new_string", "prompt", "script")}
            if other:
                parts.append(json.dumps(other, indent=1)[:4000])
            events.append(("tool", f"Tool call: {b.get('name')}", safe(cap("\n".join(parts), CAP_INPUT))))

HEADER = f"""This is the record of a Claude Code session that ran from 9 to 15 October 2026 on the MAIIC IFRS 9 system (repository MAICC-IFRS9). It is saved so that another member of staff, with or without an AI tool, can follow what was done, in what order, and why. The conversation was compacted several times; each compaction summary is reproduced where it was written.

It starts at "pull all maic changes and put the db and run any necessary commands" and runs to the saving of this transcript. The work falls into six stages, in time order:
1. 9 October: the changes pulled and the database set up; the user interface reworked (navigation, coloured tabs, the dashboard, the macro statistics, scenario, overlay and forward-looking pages); the pack 3 data.
2. 13 October: the dashboard's ECL build-up and its charts with their own period selectors; the maintenance page and its specification; the forward-looking screens improved; the write-off routes; S&P internal grades; the sidebar, breadcrumbs and the sample files and checks on every import; pack 8 reviewed and pack 9 drafted.
3. 13 to 14 October (overnight): the whole system audited end to end against the specifications and the packs; the results for every period compared with MAIIC's December 2025 model and written up in Downloads; the bootstrap proved reproducible; the documentation audited; everything pushed to master.
4. 14 October: packs 9 and 10 received and landed; pack 10 drafted and its results reviewed; the collateral haircuts from the December 2025 ECL model.
5. 14 to 15 October: the production database backed up to OneDrive and replaced by a fresh bootstrap (98 checks, 0 FAIL), audited against the backup; two install defects fixed (settings, S&P grades).
6. 15 October: what is outstanding; the 324 fee lines in a workbook for Finance; Finance's 2024 and 2025 fee workbooks reconciled to the GL; the fee workbook gate (FeeWorkbookTieOut) built, with the upload files for Finance; Chikwendeni's 800 as a question for Tamanda.

What is included: every user message, every reply shown to the user, every tool call with its input (commands, scripts and file contents) and every tool result. A tool input longer than {CAP_INPUT:,} characters or a result longer than {CAP_RESULT:,} keeps its beginning and end, with the cut marked; the whole log is kept, redacted, beside this transcript on OneDrive.

What is left out: the assistant's internal reasoning, automatic system reminders, image outputs, and credentials (two Laravel application keys found by redact_session_log.py are replaced by [REDACTED ...]).

How to follow it: the scripts the session ran are in docs/build-files/2026-10-15 in the repository, with a README, and in OneDrive under Query Requests to MAIIC/Build files/2026-10-15. The commits are on master, 220a5a6 to c343409.

Times are UTC. Source: the session log {os.path.basename(SESSION)}, entries {start} to {end - 1}. Events: {len(events)}."""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- markdown
md = [f"# {TITLE}\n", HEADER, "\n---\n"]
for kind, title, body in events:
    if kind in ("user", "assistant"):
        md.append(f"\n## {title}\n\n{body}\n")
    else:
        md.append(f"\n**{title}**\n\n````\n{body}\n````\n")
open(os.path.join(OUTDIR, NAME + ".md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(md))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- pdf
F = r"C:\Windows\Fonts"
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Seg", F + r"\segoeui.ttf")); pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Seg-B", F + r"\segoeuib.ttf"))
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Seg-I", F + r"\segoeuii.ttf")); pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Seg-BI", F + r"\segoeuiz.ttf"))
pdfmetrics.registerFontFamily("Seg", normal="Seg", bold="Seg-B", italic="Seg-I", boldItalic="Seg-BI")
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Mono", F + r"\consola.ttf"))
NAVY = colors.HexColor("#1B2A41"); ORANGE = colors.HexColor("#E07B00"); GREY = colors.HexColor("#5B6470"); LINE = colors.HexColor("#C9D1DB")
st_title = ParagraphStyle("t", fontName="Seg-B", fontSize=20, leading=25, textColor=NAVY, spaceAfter=8)
st_p = ParagraphStyle("p", fontName="Seg", fontSize=9.5, leading=13.5, spaceAfter=5)
st_user = ParagraphStyle("u", fontName="Seg-B", fontSize=10.5, leading=14, textColor=colors.white, backColor=NAVY, borderPadding=(3, 5, 3, 5), spaceBefore=12, spaceAfter=7, keepWithNext=1)
st_asst = ParagraphStyle("a", fontName="Seg-B", fontSize=10.5, leading=14, textColor=colors.white, backColor=ORANGE, borderPadding=(3, 5, 3, 5), spaceBefore=12, spaceAfter=7, keepWithNext=1)
st_tool = ParagraphStyle("tl", fontName="Seg-B", fontSize=8.5, leading=11, textColor=GREY, spaceBefore=7, spaceAfter=2, keepWithNext=1)
st_mono = ParagraphStyle("m", fontName="Mono", fontSize=6.6, leading=8.3, textColor=colors.HexColor("#202020"))
st_h = ParagraphStyle("h", fontName="Seg-B", fontSize=10.5, leading=14, textColor=NAVY, spaceBefore=6, spaceAfter=3)
BAD = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\ufffe\uffff]")


def esc(t):
    return html.escape(BAD.sub("", t), quote=False)


def inline(t):
    t = esc(t)
    t = re.sub(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*", r"<b>\1</b>", t)
    t = re.sub(r"`([^`]+)`", r'<font name="Mono" size="8.5">\1</font>', t)
    return t


def mono(story, text, cols=128):
    lines = BAD.sub("", text.replace("\t", "    ").replace("\r", "")).split("\n")
    for i in range(0, len(lines), 70):
        story.append(Preformatted("\n".join(lines[i:i + 70]), st_mono, maxLineLength=cols, splitChars=" ,;|/\\", newLineChars=""))


def prose(story, text):
    buf = []

    def flush():
        if buf:
            mono(story, "\n".join(buf)); story.append(Spacer(1, 4)); buf.clear()
    in_code = False
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        s = line.rstrip()
        if s.strip().startswith("```"):
            in_code = not in_code; continue
        if in_code or s.lstrip().startswith("|"):
            buf.append(s); continue
        flush()
        if not s.strip():
            continue
        m = re.match(r"^(#{1,4})\s+(.*)", s)
        if m:
            story.append(Paragraph(inline(m.group(2)), st_h)); continue
        m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([-*]|\d+\.)\s+(.*)", s)
        if m:
            ind = 10 + 10 * (len(m.group(1)) // 2)
            mark = "•" if m.group(2) in "-*" else m.group(2)
            story.append(Paragraph(f"{mark} {inline(m.group(3))}", ParagraphStyle("b", parent=st_p, leftIndent=ind, firstLineIndent=-9, spaceAfter=2)))
            continue
        story.append(Paragraph(inline(s), st_p))
    flush()


story = [Paragraph(TITLE, st_title)]
for para in HEADER.split("\n\n"):
    for ln in para.split("\n"):
        story.append(Paragraph(inline(ln), st_p))
story.append(Spacer(1, 6))
for kind, title, body in events:
    if kind == "user":
        story.append(Paragraph(esc(title), st_user)); prose(story, body)
    elif kind == "assistant":
        story.append(Paragraph(esc(title), st_asst)); prose(story, body)
    else:
        story.append(Paragraph(esc(title), st_tool)); mono(story, body); story.append(Spacer(1, 3))


def footer(canvas, doc):
    canvas.saveState(); canvas.setStrokeColor(LINE); canvas.setLineWidth(0.5)
    canvas.line(14 * mm, 12 * mm, A4[0] - 14 * mm, 12 * mm)
    canvas.setFont("Seg", 7.5); canvas.setFillColor(GREY)
    canvas.drawString(14 * mm, 8 * mm, TITLE + "  ·  9 to 15 October 2026  ·  for review")
    canvas.drawRightString(A4[0] - 14 * mm, 8 * mm, f"Page {doc.page}"); canvas.restoreState()


out = os.path.join(OUTDIR, NAME + ".pdf")
doc = BaseDocTemplate(out, pagesize=A4, leftMargin=14 * mm, rightMargin=14 * mm, topMargin=13 * mm, bottomMargin=17 * mm,
                      title=TITLE + " (complete)", author="Dupleix Institute (Claude Code session)")
doc.addPageTemplates([PageTemplate(id="p", frames=[Frame(doc.leftMargin, doc.bottomMargin, doc.width, doc.height, id="f",
                                                         leftPadding=0, rightPadding=0, topPadding=0, bottomPadding=0)], onPage=footer)])
doc.build(story)
kinds = {}
for k, _, _ in events:
    kinds[k] = kinds.get(k, 0) + 1
print("events", kinds, "| chars", sum(len(b) for _, _, b in events), "| redacted", dict(counter))
print("first:", events[0][1], "| last:", events[-1][1])
print("written", out)

# Build files, 9 to 14 October 2026

These are the scripts behind the work in `Claude_Session_Transcript_Feeds_and_Integration_2026-10-14` (packs 3 to 10, the December 2025 ECL models against the RBM DFI Directive, and the E-Banker integration pack). Each script is reproduced in full in the transcript at the point where it ran. Paths inside the scripts are those of the Dupleix workstation; change them before re-running elsewhere. Scripts that read a database read only the throwaway bootstrap database (`--env=bootstrap`), never production.

## Renderers (shared)

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `spec_render.py` | Turns a Markdown document with a front-matter block into .docx and .pdf. As of 14 October it also places a logo (`logo:`), fully justifies text (`justify: yes`), builds a table of contents with page numbers (`toc: yes`), places figures (`![caption](file.png)`), keeps short tables and figures whole on one page, never splits a table row and never breaks a word across a table column. Usage: `python spec_render.py "<document>.md"` |
| `sql_to_pdf.py` | Turns a pack's all-runs .sql sheet into the PDF given to MAIIC ICT |
| `build_transcript_integration.py` | Builds this session's transcript (.md and .pdf) from the session log |

# Build files, 9 to 15 October 2026

These are the scripts behind the work in `docs/sessions/Claude_Session_Transcript_UI_GoLive_and_Fees_2026-10-15` (the user-interface rework, packs 8 to 10, the go-live build, the production database and Finance's fees). Each script is reproduced in the transcript at the point where it ran. They are copied as they were run, from the session's working folder: paths inside them are those of the Dupleix workstation, so change them before re-running elsewhere. Two folders of the working area are left out because they were only snapshots of this repository's own code (`head`, `fcca5af`), as are files over 200 KB.

Scripts that read a database read the working copy they name (`DB_DATABASE=...`), never production unless the script says so; the ones that wrote to production on 15 October are listed under "Production database".

## The transcript

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `build_transcript_golive.py` | Builds the transcript (.md and .pdf) from the session log: `python build_transcript_golive.py <output folder>`. Tool inputs over 24,000 and results over 12,000 characters keep their beginning and end, with the cut marked; messages sent while a turn was running are included |
| `redact_session_log.py` | Finds credentials in a session log and writes a redacted copy: `python redact_session_log.py <log.jsonl> [<copy.jsonl>]`. Used for the transcript and for the raw log kept on OneDrive (two Laravel application keys found) |

## Finance's fees (15 October, `tools/`)

| Script | Output (OneDrive `MAIIC/3. Project Execution/Fees 2025 - workbook, GL and design`) |
|---|---|
| `make_fee_review.py` | `MAIIC fee classification review - 324 lines - 15 Oct 2026.xlsx`: every fee line with the rule that would match it (the app's `FeeRuleMatcher` reproduced), flags, the GL against loan-system pairs and the per-loan view |
| `make_fee_recon_2025.py` | `MAIIC 2025 fees - Finance workbook vs general ledger - 15 Oct 2026.xlsx`: Finance's 34 loans against the 2025 postings on GL 4871 and 4873, with the "Questions for Tamanda" sheet (Q1, Chikwendeni's 800) |
| `make_fee_recon_2024.py` | `MAIIC 2024 fees - Finance workbook vs general ledger - 15 Oct 2026.xlsx`: the 33 loans of 2023 and 2024 against the old ledger (`CV_04a`) and E-Banker (`GL_04`); the Mega Farm programme accruals shown apart |
| `make_fee_upload_files.py` | `MAIIC fee workbook upload - 2025 - ready - 15 Oct 2026.csv` and `MAIIC fee workbook uploads - for Finance - 15 Oct 2026.xlsx`, each run first through the system's gate (`tieout_json.php`) |
| `tieout_json.php`, `tieout_dry.php` | Run `FeeWorkbookTieOut::check` (read only) on a JSON list of fee rows |
| `run_fee_import.php` | Runs the real fee import job on a throwaway database (it refuses `maiic_ifrs9`); used to prove the 2025 file loads, ties 27 held postings and is idempotent |

## Production database (14 to 15 October)

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `promote_newprod.sql` | Carried the administrator's login and the 14 tickets into the fresh bootstrap before it replaced production (the swap itself was a set of `RENAME TABLE` statements, in the transcript) |
| `smoke_pages.php` | Opens every parameter-free GET page as user 1 and reports any status of 400 or more. Leave out `/migrate` and `/cache`: they run commands when opened |
| `tmp-pa/scan.py` | Scans every text column of a database for machine-specific paths (drive letters, xampp, OneDrive, localhost) |
| `tmp-pa/counts.py` | Compares the row counts of two databases table by table |
| `tmp-pa/sp_extract.py` | Takes the two S&P grading sheets of the December 2025 ECL model as values (`docs/bootstrap/models`) |

## Packs 8 to 10 (`tools/`, `packs1/`)

`make_pack9.py`, `make_pack9_bootstrap.py`, `make_pack10.py`, `make_pack10_followup.py` make the pack run sheets and the unsent emails; `packs1/` lands the packs, builds the manifests, checks the take-on tie and sets the golden numbers (`set_golden.php`); `octinputs/queries` holds the pack SQL as sent.

## The rest, by folder

| Folder | Content |
|---|---|
| `ui_stage1/`, `ui_breadcrumbs/`, `book/`, `dashboard_charts/` | The navigation, tabs, sidebar, breadcrumbs, dashboard and its charts: the patches and the page captures used to check them |
| `imports/`, `imports_shots/`, `ingest_check/` | The sample files, instructions and checks on every import, and the landing-zone checks |
| `docs_audit/`, `inst/`, `specaudit14/` | The documentation audit (help coverage, screenshots, the installation guide edits) and the specification audit |
| `rv/`, `rv3/`, `reports_dl/`, `rep/` | The results review for every period against MAIIC's December 2025 model (the report in Downloads) and the reports checked |
| `e123/`, `restructure/`, `gaps/`, `ctl/`, `pv/`, `pv47/`, `segments/`, `fli/` | The go-live build: GL fee legs, restructures, the gaps closed, controls, the PD and LGD work, the forward-looking chain |
| `uat/`, `octtools/` | The click-through tests of the screens and the next-period checks |
| top level | Probes and patches run during the session (`edit_*.py`, `patch_*.py`, `*probe*.php`, `chk*.php`) |
